    p.Character = q

    if q then
        p.Humanoid = q:WaitForChild('Humanoid', 5)
        p.RootPart = q:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or q.PrimaryPart
        p.Backpack = n and n:WaitForChild('Backpack', 5)
        p.Camera = a and a.CurrentCamera

        if p.Config.AutoFarmCoins then
            p.ToggleAutoFarm(true)
        end
    else
        p.Humanoid = nil
        p.RootPart = nil
        p.Backpack = nil
        p.Camera = nil
    end
end

function p.ToggleFly(t)
    if t ~= nil then
        p.Config.FlyEnabled = t
    end
    if q then
        DisconnectConnection(q)

        q = nil
    end
    if p.RootPart then
        for u, v in ipairs(p.RootPart:GetChildren())do
            if v.Name == 'CandyFlyGyro' or v.Name == 'CandyFlyVel' then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end

        if p.Humanoid then
            p.Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        end
    end
    if p.Config.FlyEnabled then
        if p.Character and p.RootPart and p.Humanoid then
            local u, v, w = p.RootPart, a.CurrentCamera, Instance.new'BodyGyro'

            w.Name = 'CandyFlyGyro'
            w.P = 90000
            w.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            w.CFrame = u.CFrame
            w.Parent = u

            local x = Instance.new'BodyVelocity'

            x.Name = 'CandyFlyVel'
            x.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            x.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            x.Parent = u
            q = TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not p.Config.FlyEnabled then
                    p.ToggleFly(false)

                    return
                end
                if p.Character and p.RootPart and p.RootPart.Parent and p.Humanoid and p.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    p.Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
                    w.CFrame = v.CFrame

                    local y = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

                    if r and r.GetMoveVector then
                        pcall(function()
                            y = r:GetMoveVector()
                        end)
                    end

                    local z = 0

                    if e:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                        z = 1
                    end
                    if e:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
                        z = -1
                    end

                    local A = p.Config.FlySpeed

                    if y.Magnitude > 0 or z ~= 0 then
                        x.Velocity = v.CFrame.RightVector * y.X * A + v.CFrame.LookVector * -y.Z * A + Vector3.new(0, z * A, 0)
                    else
                        x.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    end
                else
                    if q then
                        DisconnectConnection(q)

                        q = nil
                    end

                    pcall(function()
                        w:Destroy()
                        x:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end))
        end
    end
end

    end

            if not p.Config.SpeedGlitch then
                return
            end

            local v = p.Character or (n and n.Character)

            if not v then
                return
            end

            local w, x = p.Humanoid or v:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid', p.RootPart or v:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or v.PrimaryPart

            if not w or not x or w.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            if w.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                return
            end

            local y = w.MoveDirection

            if y.Magnitude < 0.05 then
                return
            end

            local z = tonumber(p.Config.SpeedGlitchSpeed) or 50

            if z <= 0 then
                z = 50
            end

            local A = x.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local B = Vector3.new(y.X * z, A.Y, y.Z * z)

            x.AssemblyLinearVelocity = B

            pcall(function()
                x.Velocity = B
            end)
        end))
    end

function p.ToggleSpin(w)

        p.Config.SpinEnabled = w and true or false
    end
    if v then
        DisconnectConnection(v)

        v = nil
    end

    local x = p.Humanoid or (n and n.Character and n.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid')

    if not p.Config.SpinEnabled then
        if x then
            pcall(function()
                x.AutoRotate = true
            end)
        end

        u = 0

        return
    end

    v = TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function(y)
        if not p.Config.SpinEnabled then
            return
        end

        local z = p.Character or (n and n.Character)
        local A, B = p.Humanoid or (z and z:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'), p.RootPart or (z and z:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart')

        if not z or not A or not B or A.Health <= 0 then
            return
        end

        A.AutoRotate = false

        local C = tonumber(p.Config.SpinSpeed) or 20

        if C < 0 then
            C = 0
        end

        u = u + math.rad(C * 60) * (y or 0.016)

        if u > math.pi * 2 then
            u = u % (math.pi * 2)
        end

        local D, E = B.Position, B.AssemblyLinearVelocity

        B.CFrame = CFrame.new(D) * CFrame.Angles(0, u, 0)

        pcall(function()
            B.AssemblyLinearVelocity = E
        end)
    end))
end

local function GunBeam_GetType()
    return (p.Config and p.Config.GunBeamType) or 'Neon Fat'
end
local function GunBeam_GetColor()
    local x = p.Config and p.Config.GunBeamColor

    if typeof(x) == 'Color3' then
        return x
    end

    return Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255)
end
local function GunBeam_GetThickness()
    local x = p.Config and tonumber(p.Config.GunBeamThickness)

    if not x or x <= 0 then
        return 1
    end

    return math.clamp(x, 0.2, 4)
end
local function GunBeam_GetDuration()
    local x = p.Config and tonumber(p.Config.GunBeamDuration)

    if not x or x <= 0 then
        return 0.22
    end

    return math.clamp(x, 0.05, 2)
end
local function gbNeonLaser(x, y, z, A)
    local B = (y - x).Magnitude

    if B < 1 then
        return
    end

    local C, D, E = z or GunBeam_GetThickness(), GunBeam_GetDuration(), Instance.new'Part'

    E.Anchored = true
    E.CanCollide = false
    E.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    E.Color = A or GunBeam_GetColor()
    E.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    E.Size = Vector3.new(B, C, C)
    E.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(x, y) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -B / 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
    E.Parent = a and a.Terrain or workspace.Terrain

    f:Create(E, TweenInfo.new(D, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = Vector3.new(B, 0, 0),
        Transparency = 1,
    }):Play()
    task.delay(D + 0.05, function()
        pcall(function()
            E:Destroy()
        end)
    end)
end

    }):Play()

            A:Destroy()
            B:Destroy()
        end)
    end)
end
local function gbZigzagLightning(x, y, z)
    local A = (y - x).Magnitude
    local B, C = math.clamp(math.floor(A / 6), 4, 12), x

    for D = 1, B do
        local E = D / B
        local F = x:Lerp(y, E)

        if D < B then
            F = F + Vector3.new(math.random(-2, 2), math.random(-2, 2), math.random(-2, 2))
        end

        local G = (F - C).Magnitude

        if G >= 0.05 then
            local H = Instance.new'Part'

            H.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            H.Color = z
            H.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            H.Size = Vector3.new(G, 0.4, 0.4)
            H.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(C, F) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -G / 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
            H.Anchored = true
            H.CanCollide = false
            H.Parent = a and a.Terrain or workspace.Terrain

            f:Create(H, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = Vector3.new(G, 0, 0),
                Transparency = 1,
            }):Play()
            task.delay(0.28, function()
                pcall(function()
                    H:Destroy()
                end)
            end)
        end

        C = F
    end
end

    local z, A = GunBeam_GetColor(), Instance.new'Part'

    A.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    A.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    A.Color = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15)
    A.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    A.Position = x
    A.Anchored = true
    A.CanCollide = false
    A.Parent = a and a.Terrain or workspace.Terrain

    local B = Instance.new'Part'

    B.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    B.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    B.Color = z
    B.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    B.Position = x
    B.Anchored = true
    B.CanCollide = false
    B.Parent = a and a.Terrain or workspace.Terrain

    local C = Instance.new'PointLight'

    C.Color = z
    C.Range = 14
    C.Brightness = 3
    C.Parent = B

    local D, E = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

    f:Create(A, D, {
        Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4),
    }):Play()
    f:Create(B, D, {
        Size = Vector3.new(5.5, 5.5, 5.5),
    }):Play()
    task.delay(0.3, function()
        f:Create(A, E, {
            Size = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
            Transparency = 1,
        }):Play()
        f:Create(B, E, {
            Size = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
            Transparency = 1,
        }):Play()
        f:Create(C, E, {
            Brightness = 0,
            Range = 0,
        }):Play()
        task.delay(0.52, function()
            pcall(function()
                A:Destroy()
                B:Destroy()
            end)
        end)
    end)
end
local function gbHandleBeam(x)
    if not x or not x:IsA'Beam' then
        return
    end
    if not p.Config or not p.Config.GunBeamEnabled then
        return
    end

    local y = GunBeam_GetType()

    if y == 'Default' then
        return
    end

    local z, A

    if x.Attachment0 and x.Attachment1 then
        z = x.Attachment0.WorldPosition
        A = x.Attachment1.WorldPosition
    end
    if not z or not A then
        return
    end

    local B = (A - z)

    if B.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        return
    end

    B = B.Unit

    local C, D = GunBeam_GetColor(), GunBeam_GetThickness()

    if y == 'Neon Fat' then
        x.Width0 = 1.8 * D
        x.Width1 = 1.2 * D
        x.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, C),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C),
        }

        gbNeonLaser(z, A, D)
    elseif y == 'Nuke' then
        x.Width0 = 1.4 * D
        x.Width1 = 0.8 * D
        x.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, C),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C),
        }

        gbNeonLaser(z, A, 0.8 * D)
        gbNukeExplosion(A, B, C)
    elseif y == 'Zigzag Light' then
        x.Width0 = 0.1
        x.Width1 = 0.1

        gbZigzagLightning(z, A, C)
    elseif y == 'Orbital Strike' then
        x.Width0 = 1.5 * D
        x.Width1 = 0.8 * D
        x.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, C),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C),
        }

        gbNeonLaser(z, A, 0.8 * D)
        gbOrbitalStrike(A, C)
    elseif y == 'Black Hole' then
        x.Width0 = 1.2 * D
        x.Width1 = 0.6 * D
        x.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, C),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C),
        }

        gbNeonLaser(z, A, 0.7 * D)
        gbBlackHole(A, B)
    elseif y == 'Rainbow RGB' then
        x.Width0 = 1.8 * D
        x.Width1 = 1.2 * D
        x.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
        }

        gbNeonLaser(z, A, D, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
    end
end

function p.ToggleGunBeam(x)
    if x ~= nil then
        p.Config.GunBeamEnabled = x and true or false
    end
    if w.conn then
        DisconnectConnection(w.conn)

        w.conn = nil
    end
    if p.Config.GunBeamEnabled then
        w.conn = TrackConnection(a.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(y)
            if y:IsA'Beam' and p.Config.GunBeamEnabled and GunBeam_GetType() ~= 'Default' then
                task.wait()
                pcall(gbHandleBeam, y)
            end
        end))

        task.spawn(function()
            for y, z in ipairs(a:GetDescendants())do
                if z:IsA'Beam' and p.Config.GunBeamEnabled and GunBeam_GetType() ~= 'Default' then
                    pcall(gbHandleBeam, z)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end
function p.SetGunBeamType(x)
    p.Config.GunBeamType = tostring(x or 'Neon Fat')

    if p.Config.GunBeamEnabled then
        p.ToggleGunBeam(true)
    end
end
function p.SetGunBeamColor(x)
    if typeof(x) == 'Color3' then
        p.Config.GunBeamColor = x
    end
end
function p.SetGunBeamThickness(x)
    local y = tonumber(x) or 1

    p.Config.GunBeamThickness = math.clamp(y, 0.2, 4)
end
function p.SetGunBeamDuration(x)
    local y = tonumber(x) or 0.22

    p.Config.GunBeamDuration = math.clamp(y, 0.05, 2)
end

if n then
    TrackConnection(n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if p.Config.SpinEnabled then
            task.wait(0.1)
            p.ToggleSpin(true)
        end
    end))
end

function p.Rejoin()
    if i and n then
        pcall(function()
            i:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, n)
        end)
    end
end
function p.ServerHop()
    if not i or not n then
        return
    end

    local x = 'https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/' .. game.PlaceId .. '/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100'
    local y, z = pcall(function()
        return h:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(x))
    end)

    if y and z and z.data then
        for A, B in ipairs(z.data)do
            if B.id ~= game.JobId and B.playing < B.maxPlayers then
                i:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, B.id, n)

                return
            end
        end
    end

    i:Teleport(game.PlaceId, n)
end

local function FindMap()
    for x, y in ipairs(a:GetChildren())do
        if (y:FindFirstChild'CoinContainer' or y:FindFirstChild'CoinAreas') and y:FindFirstChild'Spawns' then
            return y
        end
    end
    for x, y in ipairs(a:GetChildren())do
        if y:FindFirstChild'Spawns' and (y:FindFirstChild'GunDrop' or y:FindFirstChild'CoinContainer' or y:FindFirstChild'CoinAreas') then
            return y
        end
    end

    return nil
end
local function FindGunDrop()
    local function resolve(x)
        if not x or not x.Parent then
            return nil, nil
        end
        if x:IsA'BasePart' then
            return x, x
        end
        if x:IsA'Model' or x:IsA'Folder' then
            local y = x:FindFirstChild'Handle' or x:FindFirstChild'Gun' or x:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)

            if y and y:IsA'BasePart' then
                return y, x
            end
        end

        return nil, nil
    end

    local x = FindMap()

    if x then
        local y = x:FindFirstChild'GunDrop'

        if y then
            local z, A = resolve(y)

            if z then
                return z, A or y
            end
        end

        for z, A in ipairs(x:GetDescendants())do
            if A.Name == 'GunDrop' then
                local B, C = resolve(A)

                if B then
                    return B, C or A
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for y, z in ipairs(a:GetChildren())do
        local A = z:FindFirstChild'GunDrop'

        if A then
            local B, C = resolve(A)

            if B then
                return B, C or A
            end
        end
    end

    local y = a:FindFirstChild('GunDrop', true)

    if y then
        local z, A = resolve(y)

        if z then
            return z, A or y
        end
    end

    return nil, nil
end

function p.TeleportToMap()
    local x = p.Character or (p.RootPart and p.RootPart.Parent)

    if not x then
        return
    end

    local y = FindMap()

    if not y then
        return
    end

    local z = y:FindFirstChild'Spawns'

    if not z then
        return
    end

    local A = {}

    for B, C in ipairs(z:GetChildren())do
        if C:IsA'BasePart' then
            table.insert(A, C)
        end
    end

    local B = #A > 0 and A[math.random(1, #A)] or (z:FindFirstChild'Spawn' or z:FindFirstChild'PlayerSpawn')

    if B and B:IsA'BasePart' then
        x:PivotTo(B.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 5, 0))
    end
end

local function FindLobby()
    for x, y in ipairs(a:GetChildren())do
        if y:FindFirstChild'Lobby' then
            return y.Lobby
        end
        if y.Name:lower() == 'lobby' then
            return y
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function p.TeleportToLobby()
    local x = p.Character or (p.RootPart and p.RootPart.Parent)

    if not x then
        return
    end

    local y = FindLobby()

    if not y then
        return
    end

    local z = y:FindFirstChild'Spawns'

    if not z then
        return
    end

    local A = {}

    for B, C in ipairs(z:GetChildren())do
        if C:IsA'BasePart' then
            table.insert(A, C)
        end
    end

    local B = #A > 0 and A[math.random(1, #A)] or z:FindFirstChild'SpawnLocation'

    if B and B:IsA'BasePart' then
        x:PivotTo(B.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 5, 0))
    end
end
function p.GetPlayerByName(x)
    if not x then
        return nil
    end

    for y, z in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
        if z.Name:lower() == x:lower() then
            return z
        end
    end

    return nil
end
function p.FindMurderer()
    if p.PlayerData then
        for x, y in pairs(p.PlayerData)do
            if y.Role == 'Murderer' then
                local z = p.GetPlayerByName(x)

                if z then
                    return z
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for x, y in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
        local z = y:FindFirstChild'Backpack'

        if (z and z:FindFirstChild'Knife') or (y.Character and y.Character:FindFirstChild'Knife') then
            return y
        end
    end

    return nil
end
function p.FindSheriff()
    if p.PlayerData then
        for x, y in pairs(p.PlayerData)do
            if y.Role == 'Sheriff' or y.Role == 'Hero' then
                local z = p.GetPlayerByName(x)

                if z then
                    return z
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for x, y in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
        local z = y:FindFirstChild'Backpack'

        if (z and z:FindFirstChild'Gun') or (y.Character and y.Character:FindFirstChild'Gun') then
            return y
        end
    end

    return nil
end
function p.FindInnocent(x)
    if x and p.PlayerData then
        local y = p.PlayerData[x.Name]

        return y and y.Role == 'Innocent'
    end

    return false
end

local x = c:FindFirstChild'Remotes'
local y = x and x:FindFirstChild'Gameplay'
local z = y and y:FindFirstChild'PlayerDataChanged'

local function Hub_BindPlayerDataChanged(A)
    if not A or not A.OnClientEvent then
        return
    end

    TrackConnection(A.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(B)
        if typeof(B) == 'table' then
            p.PlayerData = B
        end
    end))
end

if z then
    Hub_BindPlayerDataChanged(z)
else
    task.spawn(function()
        local A = x or c:WaitForChild('Remotes', 5)

        if not A then
            return
        end

        x = A

        local B = y or A:WaitForChild('Gameplay', 5)

        if not B then
            return
        end

        y = B

        local C = z or B:WaitForChild('PlayerDataChanged', 5)

        if C then
            z = C

            Hub_BindPlayerDataChanged(C)
        end
    end)
end

local A = {}

do
    local B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R = false, Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255), 'ForceField', {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, nil, false, {}, nil, nil, 1.012, 0.025, {
        Head = true,
        UpperTorso = true,
        LowerTorso = true,
        Torso = true,
        LeftUpperArm = true,
        LeftLowerArm = true,
        LeftHand = true,
        RightUpperArm = true,
        RightLowerArm = true,
        RightHand = true,
        LeftUpperLeg = true,
        LeftLowerLeg = true,
        LeftFoot = true,
        RightUpperLeg = true,
        RightLowerLeg = true,
        RightFoot = true,
        ['Left Arm'] = true,
        ['Right Arm'] = true,
        ['Left Leg'] = true,
        ['Right Leg'] = true,
    }

    local function chams_deformable(S)
        if S:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'WrapLayer' then
            return true
        end
        if R[S.Name] then
            return false
        end
        if S:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'Bone' then
            return true
        end

        local T, U = pcall(function()
            return S.HasSkinnedMesh
        end)

        return T and U == true
    end
    local function chams_shell(S, T)
        local U = S.Archivable

        if not U then
            if not pcall(function()
                S.Archivable = true
            end) then
                return nil
            end
        end

        local V, W = pcall(function()
            return S:Clone()
        end)

        if not U then
            pcall(function()
                S.Archivable = U
            end)
        end
        if not V or not W then
            return nil
        end

        for X, Y in W:GetChildren()do
            if not Y:IsA'DataModelMesh' then
                Y:Destroy()
            end
        end

        local X = W:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'DataModelMesh'

        if X then
            pcall(function()
                X.Scale = X.Scale * T
            end)
            pcall(function()
                X.TextureId = ''
            end)
        else
            W.Size = W.Size * T
        end

        pcall(function()
            W.TextureID = ''
        end)
        pcall(function()
            W.MaterialVariant = ''
        end)

        W.CanCollide = false
        W.CanQuery = false
        W.CanTouch = false
        W.Massless = true
        W.CastShadow = false
        W.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0

        return W
    end
    local function chrom_ensure()
        if O and O.Parent then
            return
        end

        local S = Instance.new'ScreenGui'

        S.Name = tostring(math.random(1e6, 9e6))
        S.ResetOnSpawn = false
        S.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        S.DisplayOrder = 100

        pcall(function()
            S.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or g or game:GetService'CoreGui'
        end)

        N = Instance.new'ViewportFrame'
        N.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        N.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        N.BorderSizePixel = 0
        N.Ambient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        N.LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        N.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)
        N.CurrentCamera = a.CurrentCamera or workspace.CurrentCamera
        N.Parent = S

        local T = game:GetService'Lighting':FindFirstChildOfClass'Sky'

        if T then
            pcall(function()
                T:Clone().Parent = N
            end)
        end

        O = Instance.new'WorldModel'
        O.Parent = N
    end
    local function flat_clear(S)
        if S.model then
            S.model:Destroy()
        end
        if S.occ then
            S.occ:Destroy()
        end
        if S.los then
            for T = 1, #S.los do
                S.los[T]:Destroy()
            end
        end

        S.model, S.occ, S.los, S.count, S.key = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
    end
    local function flat_apply(S, T, U, V)
        local W = U[1]

        if S.key ~= W or S.count ~= #T or not S.model or not S.model.Parent then
            flat_clear(S)

            local X = Instance.new'Model'

            X.Name = '\0'

            for Y = 1, #T do
                local Z = T[Y]
                local _ = not chams_deformable(Z) and chams_shell(Z, 0.99) or nil

                if _ then
                    _.Anchored = false
                    _.CFrame = Z.CFrame
                    _.Parent = X

                    local aa = Instance.new'WeldConstraint'

                    aa.Part0 = _
                    aa.Part1 = Z
                    aa.Parent = _
                end
            end

            X.Parent = a

            local aa = Instance.new'Highlight'

            aa.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            aa.OutlineTransparency = 1
            aa.Adornee = X
            aa.Parent = X

            local Y = {}

            for Z = 1, #U do
                local _ = Instance.new'Highlight'

                _.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
                _.OutlineTransparency = 1
                _.Adornee = U[Z]
                _.Parent = X
                Y[Z] = _
            end

            S.model, S.occ, S.los = X, aa, Y
            S.count, S.key = #T, W
        end

        S.occ.FillColor = V
        S.occ.FillTransparency = 0

        for aa = 1, #S.los do
            S.los[aa].FillColor = V
            S.los[aa].FillTransparency = 0
        end
    end
    local function chrom_clear(aa)
        if aa.model then
            aa.model:Destroy()
        end

        aa.model, aa.entries, aa.count, aa.key, aa.col = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
    end
    local function chrom_apply(aa, S, T, U)
        if aa.key ~= T or aa.count ~= #S or not aa.model or not aa.model.Parent then
            chrom_clear(aa)
            chrom_ensure()

            local V = Instance.new'Model'

            V.Name = '\0'

            local W = {}

            for X = 1, #S do
                local Y = S[X]
                local Z = not chams_deformable(Y) and chams_shell(Y, P) or nil

                if Z then
                    Z.Anchored = true
                    Z.Material = Enum.Material.Foil
                    Z.Reflectance = 0.12
                    Z.Transparency = Q
                    Z.Color = U
                    Z.CFrame = Y.CFrame
                    Z.Parent = V
                    W[#W + 1] = {Y, Z}
                end
            end

            V.Parent = O
            aa.model, aa.entries = V, W
            aa.count, aa.key, aa.col = #S, T, U
        elseif aa.col ~= U then
            aa.col = U

            local V = aa.entries

            if V then
                for W = 1, #V do
                    V[W][2].Color = U
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function chrom_sync(aa)
        local S = aa.entries

        if not S then
            return
        end

        for T = 1, #S do
            local U, V = S[T][1], S[T][2]

            if U.Parent then
                V.CFrame = U.CFrame

                local W = math.max(U.Transparency, U.LocalTransparencyModifier) >= 1
                local X = W and 1 or Q

                if V.Transparency ~= X then
                    V.Transparency = X
                end
            elseif V.Transparency ~= 1 then
                V.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
    local function sc_restore()
        for aa, S in pairs(H)do
            if aa and aa.Parent then
                aa.Material = S[1]
                aa.Color = S[2]
            end
        end

        H = {}

        for aa, S in pairs(I)do
            if aa then
                pcall(function()
                    aa.Parent = S
                end)
            end
        end

        I = {}
        L = false
    end
    local function sc_detach(aa)
        aa.Parent = nil
    end
    local function sc_parts_for(aa)
        if K ~= aa then
            K = aa
            L = false

            for S = 1, #M do
                pcall(function()
                    M[S]:Disconnect()
                end)
            end

            table.clear(M)

            local function dirty()
                L = false
            end

            M[1] = aa.DescendantAdded:Connect(dirty)
            M[2] = aa.DescendantRemoving:Connect(dirty)
        end
        if not L then
            table.clear(J)
            table.clear(G)

            local S, T = 0, 0

            for U, V in aa:GetDescendants()do
                if V:IsA'BasePart' and V.Name ~= 'HumanoidRootPart' then
                    S = S + 1
                    J[S] = V
                elseif V:IsA'SurfaceAppearance' then
                    T = T + 1
                    G[T] = V
                end
            end

            L = true
        end

        return J
    end
    local function surfs_detach(aa, S)
        for T = 1, #aa do
            local U = aa[T]

            if U.Parent and not S[U] then
                S[U] = U.Parent

                pcall(sc_detach, U)
            end
        end
    end
    local function sc_apply()
        local aa = n and n.Character

        if not aa then
            return
        end

        local S = sc_parts_for(aa)

        if D == 'Flat' then
            chrom_clear(F)

            if next(H) or next(I) then
                sc_restore()
            end

            flat_apply(E, S, {aa}, C)
        elseif D == 'Chromatic' then
            flat_clear(E)

            if next(H) or next(I) then
                sc_restore()
            end

            chrom_apply(F, S, aa, C)
        else
            flat_clear(E)
            chrom_clear(F)
            surfs_detach(G, I)

            for T = 1, #S do
                local U = S[T]

                if U.Parent then
                    if not H[U] then
                        H[U] = {
                            U.Material,
                            U.Color,
                        }
                    end

                    U.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                    U.Color = C
                end
            end
        end
    end

    getgenv().SELF_CHAMS_CLEAN = function(aa, S)
        if not B or not aa or not S then
            return
        end

        local T, U = S:GetDescendants(), aa:GetDescendants()

        if #T ~= #U then
            return
        end

        local V = {}

        for W = 1, #T do
            local X, Y = T[W], U[W]

            V[X] = Y

            if X:IsA'BasePart' and Y:IsA'BasePart' then
                local Z = H[X]

                if Z then
                    Y.Material = Z[1]
                    Y.Color = Z[2]
                end
            end
        end

        for W, X in pairs(I)do
            local Y = V[X]

            if Y then
                pcall(function()
                    local Z = W:Clone()

                    Z.Parent = Y
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    getgenv().SELF_CHAMS_FIXCLONE = function(aa)
        if type(aa) ~= 'table' then
            return
        end

        local S = {}

        for T = 1, #aa do
            local U = aa[T]
            local V, W = U and U[1], U and U[2]

            if V and W and W.Parent then
                S[V] = W

                local X = H[V]

                if X then
                    W.Material = X[1]
                    W.Color = X[2]
                end
            end
        end

        for T, U in pairs(I)do
            local V = S[U]

            if V and not V:FindFirstChildOfClass'SurfaceAppearance' then
                pcall(function()
                    local W = T:Clone()

                    W.Parent = V
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local aa, S, T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z, _, ab, ac, ad, ae, af, ag, ah, aj, ak = false, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0), 'ForceField', {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, nil, false, {}, {}, true, nil, nil, 0, false

    local function tc_mark_dirty()
        ac = false
        af = true
    end
    local function tc_restore()
        for al, am in pairs(X)do
            if al and al.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    al.Material = am[1]
                    al.Color = am[2]
                end)
            end
        end

        table.clear(X)

        for al, am in pairs(Y)do
            if al then
                pcall(function()
                    al.Parent = am
                end)
            end
        end

        table.clear(Y)
        flat_clear(U)
        chrom_clear(V)

        ac = false
        af = true
        ag = nil
        ah = nil
    end
    local function tc_unbind_tools()
        for al = 1, #ae do
            pcall(function()
                ae[al]:Disconnect()
            end)
        end

        table.clear(ae)
    end
    local function tc_bind_tool(al)
        if not al or not al:IsA'Tool' then
            return
        end

        ae[#ae + 1] = al.DescendantAdded:Connect(tc_mark_dirty)
        ae[#ae + 1] = al.DescendantRemoving:Connect(tc_mark_dirty)
    end
    local function tc_parts_for(al)
        if ab ~= al then
            ab = al

            tc_unbind_tools()

            for am = 1, #ad do
                pcall(function()
                    ad[am]:Disconnect()
                end)
            end

            table.clear(ad)

            if al then
                ad[1] = al.ChildAdded:Connect(function(am)
                    if am:IsA'Tool' then
                        tc_bind_tool(am)
                        tc_mark_dirty()
                    end
                end)
                ad[2] = al.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(am)
                    if am:IsA'Tool' then
                        tc_mark_dirty()
                    end
                end)
            end

            tc_mark_dirty()
        end
        if not ac then
            table.clear(Z)
            table.clear(W)
            table.clear(_)
            tc_unbind_tools()

            local am, an, ao = 0, 0, 0

            if al then
                for ap, aq in al:GetChildren()do
                    if aq:IsA'Tool' then
                        ao = ao + 1
                        _[ao] = aq

                        tc_bind_tool(aq)

                        for ar, as in aq:GetDescendants()do
                            if as:IsA'BasePart' then
                                am = am + 1
                                Z[am] = as
                            elseif as:IsA'SurfaceAppearance' then
                                an = an + 1
                                W[an] = as
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            ac = true
            af = true
        end

        return Z
    end
    local function tc_apply(al)
        local am = n and n.Character

        if not am then
            if next(X) or next(Y) or U.model or V.model then
                tc_restore()
            end

            return
        end

        local an, ao, ap = tc_parts_for(am), ag ~= T, ah ~= S

        if not al and not af and not ao and not ap then
            if T ~= 'Chromatic' then
                return
            end
        end
        if #an == 0 then
            if next(X) or next(Y) or U.model or V.model then
                tc_restore()
            end

            af = false
            ag = T
            ah = S

            return
        end
        if T == 'Flat' then
            if ag ~= 'Flat' then
                chrom_clear(V)

                if next(X) or next(Y) then
                    for aq, ar in pairs(X)do
                        if aq and aq.Parent then
                            pcall(function()
                                aq.Material = ar[1]
                                aq.Color = ar[2]
                            end)
                        end
                    end

                    table.clear(X)

                    for aq, ar in pairs(Y)do
                        if aq then
                            pcall(function()
                                aq.Parent = ar
                            end)
                        end
                    end

                    table.clear(Y)
                end
            end

            flat_apply(U, an, _, S)
        elseif T == 'Chromatic' then
            if ag ~= 'Chromatic' then
                flat_clear(U)

                if next(X) or next(Y) then
                    for aq, ar in pairs(X)do
                        if aq and aq.Parent then
                            pcall(function()
                                aq.Material = ar[1]
                                aq.Color = ar[2]
                            end)
                        end
                    end

                    table.clear(X)

                    for aq, ar in pairs(Y)do
                        if aq then
                            pcall(function()
                                aq.Parent = ar
                            end)
                        end
                    end

                    table.clear(Y)
                end
            end

            chrom_apply(V, an, _[1], S)
        else
            if ag ~= 'ForceField' then
                flat_clear(U)
                chrom_clear(V)
            end

            surfs_detach(W, Y)

            for aq = 1, #an do
                local ar = an[aq]

                if ar and ar.Parent then
                    local as = X[ar]

                    if not as then
                        X[ar] = {
                            ar.Material,
                            ar.Color,
                        }
                        ar.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                        ar.Color = S
                    elseif ap or ar.Material ~= Enum.Material.ForceField or ar.Color ~= S then
                        if ar.Material ~= Enum.Material.ForceField then
                            ar.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                        end
                        if ar.Color ~= S then
                            ar.Color = S
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        af = false
        ag = T
        ah = S
    end
    local function tc_sync_from_config()
        local al = p.Config

        if not al then
            return
        end

        local am, an, ao = al.ToolChams and true or false, al.ToolChamsType or 'ForceField', al.ToolChamsColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)

        if am ~= aa or an ~= T or ao ~= S then
            af = true
        end

        aa = am
        T = an
        S = ao

        if not aa then
            if ak then
                tc_restore()
            end

            ak = false

            return
        end

        ak = true
    end
    local function sc_sync_from_config()
        local al = p.Config

        if not al then
            return
        end

        B = al.SelfChams and true or false
        D = al.SelfChamsType or 'ForceField'
        C = al.SelfChamsColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)

        if not B then
            flat_clear(E)
            chrom_clear(F)
            sc_restore()
        end
    end

    TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        sc_sync_from_config()

        if B then
            sc_apply()
        end

        tc_sync_from_config()

        if aa then
            aj = aj + 1

            local al = (T == 'Chromatic' and (aj % 4 == 0)) or (aj % 4 == 0)

            if af or al then
                tc_apply(af)
            end
        elseif ak then
            tc_restore()

            ak = false
        end
    end))
    TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local al = (B and D == 'Chromatic') or (aa and T == 'Chromatic')

        if not al then
            return
        end
        if not O then
            return
        end

        local am = a.CurrentCamera or workspace.CurrentCamera

        if N and N.CurrentCamera ~= am then
            N.CurrentCamera = am
        end
        if B and D == 'Chromatic' then
            chrom_sync(F)
        end
        if aa and T == 'Chromatic' then
            chrom_sync(V)
        end
    end))

    if n then
        TrackConnection(n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            L = false
            K = nil
            ac = false
            ab = nil
            af = true
            ag = nil
            ah = nil

            pcall(tc_unbind_tools)
            task.wait(0.4)

            if B then
                sc_apply()
            end
            if aa then
                tc_apply(true)
            end
        end))
    end
end
do
    local aa, ab, ac = {
        'Torso',
        'Left Arm',
        'Right Arm',
        'Left Leg',
        'Right Leg',
        'LeftUpperArm',
        'RightUpperArm',
        'LeftLowerArm',
        'RightLowerArm',
        'LeftUpperLeg',
        'RightUpperLeg',
        'LeftLowerLeg',
        'RightLowerLeg',
        'LeftFoot',
        'RightFoot',
        'LeftHand',
        'RightHand',
    }, 400, {
        folder = nil,
        conn = nil,
        spawned = {},
        enabled = false,
        accum = 0,
        color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        lifetime = 2,
        rate = 20,
        orbSize = 0.35,
        drift = 4,
        minSpeed = 2,
    }

    local function ptEnsureFolder()
        if ac.folder and ac.folder.Parent then
            return
        end

        local ad = Instance.new'Folder'

        ad.Name = 'CandyBodyTrail'
        ad.Parent = a
        ac.folder = ad
    end
    local function ptSpawn(ad)
        local ae = Instance.new'Part'

        ae.Size = Vector3.new(ac.orbSize, ac.orbSize, ac.orbSize)
        ae.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        ae.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        ae.Color = ac.color
        ae.Anchored = true
        ae.CanCollide = false
        ae.CanQuery = false
        ae.CanTouch = false
        ae.CastShadow = false
        ae.Transparency = 0
        ae.Position = ad
        ae.Parent = ac.folder

        local af = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 + 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2)

        if af.Magnitude > 0 then
            af = af.Unit
        end

        ac.spawned[#ac.spawned + 1] = {
            part = ae,
            bornAt = os.clock(),
            startPos = ad,
            drift = af * ac.drift * (0.5 + math.random()),
        }
    end
    local function ptUpdate(ad)
        if not ac.enabled then
            return
        end

        ptEnsureFolder()

        local ae = n and n.Character

        if ae then
            local af, ag, ah = ae:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', ae:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid', false

            if af and ag and ag.Health > 0 then
                local aj = Vector3.new(af.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, af.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)

                ah = aj.Magnitude >= ac.minSpeed
            end
            if ah then
                ac.accum = ac.accum + ad

                local aj = 1 / math.max(ac.rate, 1)

                while ac.accum >= aj do
                    ac.accum = ac.accum - aj

                    for ak, al in ipairs(aa)do
                        local am = ae:FindFirstChild(al)

                        if am and am:IsA'BasePart' then
                            ptSpawn(am.Position)
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                ac.accum = 0
            end
        end

        local af, ag = os.clock(), a.CurrentCamera or workspace.CurrentCamera
        local ah = ag and ag.CFrame.Position or nil

        for aj = #ac.spawned, 1, -1 do
            local ak = ac.spawned[aj]
            local al = ak.part

            if not al or not al.Parent then
                table.remove(ac.spawned, aj)
            else
                local am = af - ak.bornAt

                if am >= ac.lifetime then
                    al:Destroy()
                    table.remove(ac.spawned, aj)
                else
                    local an = am / ac.lifetime
                    local ao = 1 - (1 - an) * (1 - an)

                    al.CFrame = CFrame.new(ak.startPos + ak.drift * ao)
                    al.Transparency = an

                    local ap = ac.orbSize * (1 - an * 0.7)

                    al.Size = Vector3.new(ap, ap, ap)

                    if ah and (al.Position - ah).Magnitude > ab then
                        al.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function ptClear()
        for ad, ae in ipairs(ac.spawned)do
            if ae.part and ae.part.Parent then
                ae.part:Destroy()
            end
        end

        ac.spawned = {}

        if ac.folder then
            pcall(function()
                ac.folder:Destroy()
            end)

            ac.folder = nil
        end
    end
    local function ptSetEnabled(ad)
        ac.enabled = ad and true or false

        if ac.enabled then
            ptEnsureFolder()

            if not ac.conn then
                ac.conn = TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function(ae)
                    ptUpdate(ae or (1.6666666666666665E-2))
                end))
            end
        else
            ptClear()
        end
    end
    local function syncFromConfig()
        local ad = p.Config

        if not ad then
            return
        end

        ac.color = ad.BodyTrailColor or ac.color
        ac.lifetime = tonumber(ad.BodyTrailLifetime) or ac.lifetime
        ac.rate = tonumber(ad.BodyTrailRate) or ac.rate
        ac.orbSize = tonumber(ad.BodyTrailOrbSize) or ac.orbSize
        ac.drift = tonumber(ad.BodyTrailDrift) or ac.drift
        ac.minSpeed = tonumber(ad.BodyTrailMinSpeed) or ac.minSpeed

        local ae = ad.BodyTrail and true or false

        if ae ~= ac.enabled then
            ptSetEnabled(ae)
        end
    end

    TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        syncFromConfig()
    end))

    getgenv().BodyTrail = {
        Toggle = function(ad)
            if p.Config then
                if ad == nil then
                    p.Config.BodyTrail = not p.Config.BodyTrail
                else
                    p.Config.BodyTrail = ad and true or false
                end
            end

            syncFromConfig()
        end,
        Apply = function()
            if p.Config then
                p.Config.BodyTrail = true
            end

            syncFromConfig()
        end,
        Remove = function()
            if p.Config then
                p.Config.BodyTrail = false
            end

            syncFromConfig()
        end,
    }
end

getgenv().ClearESP = function()
    pcall(function()
        if getgenv().CandyRoleBoxESP_Clear then
            getgenv().CandyRoleBoxESP_Clear()
        end
    end)

    for aa, ab in pairs(A)do
        for ac, ad in pairs(ab)do
            if typeof(ad) ~= 'table' then
                if ad and ad.Remove then
                    ad:Remove()
                end
            else
                for ae, af in ipairs(ad)do
                    af:Remove()
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.clear(A)

    for aa, ab in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
        local ac = ab.Character

        if ac then
            local ad = ac:FindFirstChild'CandyHighlight'

            if ad then
                pcall(function()
                    ad:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            local ae = ac:FindFirstChild'CandyInfoESP'

            if ae then
                pcall(function()
                    ae:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    do
        local aa, ab = FindGunDrop()

        if ab then
            local ac = ab:FindFirstChild'CandyGunHighlight'

            if ac then
                pcall(function()
                    ac:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            local ad = ab:FindFirstChild'CandyGunInfo'

            if ad then
                pcall(function()
                    ad:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

do
    pcall(function()
        if setfflag then
            setfflag('AdornShadingAPI', 'true')
        end
    end)

    local aa = {
        enabled = false,
        target = 'Other',
        mainColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
        glowColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        mainTrans = 0.5,
        glowTrans = -1,
        sizeOffset = 0.03,
        xray = true,
        refresh = 0.35,
        lastTick = 0,
        tracked = {},
        conn = nil,
    }

    local function removeAdorns(ab)
        if not ab then
            return
        end

        for ac, ad in ipairs(ab:GetChildren())do
            if ad.Name == 'CandyAdornChams' or ad.Name == 'CandyAdornGlow' then
                pcall(function()
                    ad:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end

        aa.tracked[ab] = nil
    end
    local function clearAll()
        for ab in pairs(aa.tracked)do
            removeAdorns(ab)
        end

        table.clear(aa.tracked)

        for ab, ac in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
            local ad = ac.Character

            if ad then
                for ae, af in ipairs(ad:GetChildren())do
                    if af:IsA'BasePart' then
                        removeAdorns(af)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function createAdornment(ab, ac, ad, ae, af, ag, ah)
        ah = ah or {}

        local aj

        if ac == 'Cylinder' then
            aj = Instance.new'CylinderHandleAdornment'
            aj.Height = ab.Size.Y + (ah.HeightOffset or 0)
            aj.Radius = (ab.Size.X * 0.5) + (ah.RadiusOffset or 0)
            aj.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
        else
            aj = Instance.new'BoxHandleAdornment'
            aj.Size = ab.Size + (ag or Vector3.zero)
        end

        aj.Name = ah.Name or 'CandyAdornChams'
        aj.AlwaysOnTop = true
        aj.ZIndex = af or 1
        aj.Adornee = ab
        aj.Color3 = ad
        aj.Transparency = ae or 0

        if ah.Shading then
            pcall(function()
                aj.Shading = ah.Shading
            end)
        end

        aj.Parent = ab

        return aj
    end
    local function shouldApply(ab)
        if not ab then
            return false
        end
        if aa.target == 'Self' then
            return ab == n
        elseif aa.target == 'All' then
            return true
        else
            return ab ~= n
        end
    end
    local function applyToPart(ab)
        if not ab or not ab:IsA'BasePart' then
            return
        end
        if ab.Transparency >= 1 then
            return
        end
        if ab.Name == 'HumanoidRootPart' then
            return
        end

        removeAdorns(ab)

        local ac, ad, ae, af = ab.Name == 'Head' or ab.Name == 'FakeHead', Vector3.new(aa.sizeOffset, aa.sizeOffset, aa.sizeOffset), aa.xray and Enum.AdornShading.XRayShaded or nil, Color3.new(math.clamp(aa.glowColor.R * 5, 0, 5), math.clamp(aa.glowColor.G * 5, 0, 5), math.clamp(aa.glowColor.B * 5, 0, 5))
        local ag, ah = createAdornment(ab, ac and 'Cylinder' or 'Box', af, aa.glowTrans, ac and 10 or 9, ad, {
            Name = 'CandyAdornGlow',
            Shading = ae,
        }), createAdornment(ab, ac and 'Cylinder' or 'Box', aa.mainColor, aa.mainTrans, 10, ad * 0.67, {
            Name = 'CandyAdornChams',
        })

        aa.tracked[ab] = {
            glow = ag,
            main = ah,
        }
    end
    local function refresh()
        if not aa.enabled then
            clearAll()

            return
        end

        local ab = {}

        for ac, ad in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
            if shouldApply(ad) then
                local ae = ad.Character

                if ae then
                    for af, ag in ipairs(ae:GetChildren())do
                        if ag:IsA'BasePart' and ag.Transparency < 1 and ag.Name ~= 'HumanoidRootPart' then
                            ab[ag] = true

                            if not aa.tracked[ag] or not aa.tracked[ag].main or not aa.tracked[ag].main.Parent then
                                applyToPart(ag)
                            else
                                local ah, aj, ak = aa.tracked[ag], ag.Name == 'Head' or ag.Name == 'FakeHead', Vector3.new(aa.sizeOffset, aa.sizeOffset, aa.sizeOffset)

                                if ah.glow and ah.glow.Parent then
                                    ah.glow.Color3 = Color3.new(math.clamp(aa.glowColor.R * 5, 0, 5), math.clamp(aa.glowColor.G * 5, 0, 5), math.clamp(aa.glowColor.B * 5, 0, 5))
                                    ah.glow.Transparency = aa.glowTrans

                                    if ah.glow:IsA'BoxHandleAdornment' then
                                        ah.glow.Size = ag.Size + ak
                                    end
                                end
                                if ah.main and ah.main.Parent then
                                    ah.main.Color3 = aa.mainColor
                                    ah.main.Transparency = aa.mainTrans

                                    if ah.main:IsA'BoxHandleAdornment' then
                                        ah.main.Size = ag.Size + (ak * 0.67)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for ac in pairs(aa.tracked)do
            if not ab[ac] or not ac.Parent then
                removeAdorns(ac)
            end
        end
    end
    local function syncFromConfig()
        local ab = p.Config

        if not ab then
            return
        end

        local ac = ab.AdornChams and true or false

        aa.target = tostring(ab.AdornChamsTarget or 'Other')

        if aa.target ~= 'Self' and aa.target ~= 'All' and aa.target ~= 'Other' then
            aa.target = 'Other'
        end
        if typeof(ab.AdornChamsMainColor) == 'Color3' then
            aa.mainColor = ab.AdornChamsMainColor
        end
        if typeof(ab.AdornChamsGlowColor) == 'Color3' then
            aa.glowColor = ab.AdornChamsGlowColor
        end

        aa.mainTrans = tonumber(ab.AdornChamsMainTrans) or 0.5
        aa.glowTrans = tonumber(ab.AdornChamsGlowTrans)

        if aa.glowTrans == nil then
            aa.glowTrans = -1
        end

        aa.sizeOffset = tonumber(ab.AdornChamsSizeOffset) or 0.03
        aa.xray = ab.AdornChamsXRay ~= false
        aa.refresh = math.clamp(tonumber(ab.AdornChamsRefresh) or 0.35, 0.1, 2)

        if ac ~= aa.enabled then
            aa.enabled = ac

            if not aa.enabled then
                clearAll()
            else
                refresh()
            end
        end
    end

    TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        syncFromConfig()

        if not aa.enabled then
            return
        end

        local ab = os.clock()

        if ab - aa.lastTick >= aa.refresh then
            aa.lastTick = ab

            pcall(refresh)
        end
    end))

    if b then
        TrackConnection(b.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(ab)
            local ac = ab.Character

            if ac then
                for ad, ae in ipairs(ac:GetChildren())do
                    if ae:IsA'BasePart' then
                        removeAdorns(ae)
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
    end
    if n then
        TrackConnection(n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.4)

            if aa.enabled then
                pcall(refresh)
            end
        end))
    end

    getgenv().CandyAdornChams_Clear = clearAll
end
