            id = '1297856838',
            rot = CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0),
            pos = CFrame.new(0, -0.3, 0),
        },
    }, {}, {}

    for ad in pairs(aa)do
        ac[#ac + 1] = ad
    end

    table.sort(ac)

    local function loadGunAsset(ad)
        local ae = tostring(ad)

        if ab[ae] then
            return ab[ae]:Clone()
        end

        local af, ag = pcall(function()
            return game:GetObjects('rbxassetid://' .. ae)
        end)

        if af and type(ag) == 'table' and ag[1] then
            ab[ae] = ag[1]

            return ag[1]:Clone()
        end

        return nil
    end
    local function restoreGun(ad)
        if not ad or not ad:IsA'Tool' or ad.Name ~= 'Gun' then
            return
        end

        local ae = ad:FindFirstChild'CustomGunModel'

        if ae then
            pcall(function()
                ae:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        for af, ag in ipairs(ad:GetDescendants())do
            if ag:IsA'BasePart' then
                ag.Transparency = 0
            elseif ag:IsA'Decal' or ag:IsA'Texture' then
                ag.Transparency = 0
            end
        end
    end
    local function applyGunModel(ad)
        if not ad or not ad:IsA'Tool' or ad.Name ~= 'Gun' then
            return
        end
        if not (p.Config and p.Config.CustomGunModel) then
            restoreGun(ad)

            return
        end

        local ae = aa[tostring(p.Config.CustomGunModelName or 'AWP')]

        if not ae then
            return
        end

        local af = n and n.Character

        if not af or ad.Parent ~= af then
            return
        end

        local ag = af:FindFirstChild'RightHand' or af:FindFirstChild'Right Arm'

        if not ag then
            return
        end

        local ah = ad:FindFirstChild'CustomGunModel'

        if ah then
            pcall(function()
                ah:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        local aj = loadGunAsset(ae.id)

        if not aj then
            return
        end

        aj.Name = 'CustomGunModel'

        for ak, al in ipairs(ad:GetDescendants())do
            if al:IsA'BasePart' and not al:IsDescendantOf(aj) then
                al.Transparency = 1
            elseif (al:IsA'Decal' or al:IsA'Texture') and not al:IsDescendantOf(aj) then
                al.Transparency = 1
            end
        end

        local ak = (aj:IsA'BasePart' and aj) or aj.PrimaryPart or aj:FindFirstChild'Handle' or aj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)

        if not ak then
            aj:Destroy()

            return
        end

        for al, am in ipairs(aj:GetDescendants())do
            if am:IsA'BasePart' then
                am.CanCollide = false
                am.Anchored = false
                am.Massless = true
            end
        end

        if aj:IsA'BasePart' then
            aj.CanCollide = false
            aj.Anchored = false
            aj.Massless = true
        end

        local al

        if af:FindFirstChild'UpperTorso' then
            al = CFrame.new(0, -0.25, -0.1) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
        else
            al = CFrame.new(0, -1, -0.1) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
        end

        local am = ag.CFrame * al * ae.rot * ae.pos

        if aj:IsA'Model' then
            aj:PivotTo(am)
        elseif aj:IsA'BasePart' then
            aj.CFrame = am
        end

        local an = Instance.new'WeldConstraint'

        an.Part0 = ag
        an.Part1 = ak
        an.Parent = ak

        for ao, ap in ipairs(aj:GetDescendants())do
            if ap:IsA'BasePart' and ap ~= ak then
                local aq = Instance.new'WeldConstraint'

                aq.Part0 = ak
                aq.Part1 = ap
                aq.Parent = ap
            end
        end

        aj.Parent = ad
    end
    local function refreshGunModels()
        local ad = p.Config and p.Config.CustomGunModel

        local function handleContainer(ae)
            if not ae then
                return
            end

            local af = ae:FindFirstChild'Gun'

            if af then
                if ad then
                    applyGunModel(af)
                else
                    restoreGun(af)
                end
            end
        end

        if n then
            handleContainer(n:FindFirstChild'Backpack')
            handleContainer(n.Character)
        end
    end
    local function bindGunContainer(ad)
        if not ad then
            return
        end

        local function bindTool(ae)
            if not ae or not ae:IsA'Tool' or ae.Name ~= 'Gun' then
                return
            end

            ae.Equipped:Connect(function()
                if p.Config and p.Config.CustomGunModel then
                    task.wait(0.02)
                    applyGunModel(ae)
                end
            end)
            ae.Unequipped:Connect(function()
                local af = ae:FindFirstChild'CustomGunModel'

                if af then
                    pcall(function()
                        af:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end)

            if p.Config and p.Config.CustomGunModel and ae.Parent == (n and n.Character) then
                applyGunModel(ae)
            end
        end

        ad.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ae)
            if ae:IsA'Tool' and ae.Name == 'Gun' then
                task.wait(0.05)
                bindTool(ae)
            end
        end)

        local ae = ad:FindFirstChild'Gun'

        if ae then
            bindTool(ae)
        end
    end

    if n then
        task.spawn(function()
            local ad = n:FindFirstChild'Backpack' or n:WaitForChild('Backpack', 8)

            if ad then
                bindGunContainer(ad)
            end
            if n.Character then
                bindGunContainer(n.Character)
            end

            TrackConnection(n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ae)
                task.wait(0.1)
                bindGunContainer(ae)

                if p.Config and p.Config.CustomGunModel then
                    task.wait(0.15)
                    refreshGunModels()
                end
            end))
        end)
    end

    getgenv().CandyCustomGunModel_Refresh = refreshGunModels
    getgenv().CandyCustomGunModel_Names = ac
    getgenv().CandyCustomGunModel_Apply = applyGunModel
    getgenv().CandyCustomGunModel_Restore = restoreGun
end
do
    local aa = {
        gui = nil,
        entries = {},
        rotation = -45,
        lastTick = tick(),
        conn = nil,
    }

    local function ensureGui()
        if aa.gui and aa.gui.Parent then
            return aa.gui
        end

        local ab, ac = (gethui and gethui()) or k or game:GetService'CoreGui', Instance.new'ScreenGui'

        ac.Name = 'CandyRoleBoxESP'
        ac.ResetOnSpawn = false
        ac.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        ac.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

        pcall(function()
            ac.Parent = ab
        end)

        aa.gui = ac

        return ac
    end
    local function mkFrame(ab, ac)
        local ad = Instance.new'Frame'

        ad.BackgroundColor3 = ac or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        ad.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ad.Visible = false
        ad.Parent = ab

        return ad
    end
    local function destroyEntry(ab)
        local ac = aa.entries[ab]

        if not ac then
            return
        end

        for ad, ae in pairs(ac)do
            if typeof(ae) == 'Instance' then
                pcall(function()
                    ae:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end

        aa.entries[ab] = nil
    end
    local function ensureEntry(ab)
        if aa.entries[ab] then
            return aa.entries[ab]
        end

        local ac, ad = ensureGui(), Instance.new'Folder'

        ad.Name = ab.Name
        ad.Parent = ac

        local ae = mkFrame(ad, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))

        ae.BackgroundTransparency = 0.75

        local af = Instance.new'UIGradient'

        af.Parent = ae

        local ag = Instance.new'UIStroke'

        ag.Thickness = 1
        ag.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
        ag.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        ag.Parent = ae

        local ah = Instance.new'UIGradient'

        ah.Parent = ag

        local aj = {}

        for ak = 1, 8 do
            aj[ak] = mkFrame(ad, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
        end

        local ak = {
            folder = ad,
            box = ae,
            gradFill = af,
            stroke = ag,
            gradStroke = ah,
            corners = aj,
        }

        aa.entries[ab] = ak

        return ak
    end
    local function hideEntry(ab)
        if not ab then
            return
        end

        ab.box.Visible = false

        for ac = 1, 8 do
            ab.corners[ac].Visible = false
        end
    end

    local ab = {
        map = {},
        next = 0,
    }

    local function refreshRoles()
        local ac, ad, ae, af = {}, p.Config.BoxColorMurderer or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), p.Config.BoxColorSheriff or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255), p.Config.BoxColorInnocent or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)

        if p.PlayerData then
            for ag, ah in pairs(p.PlayerData)do
                if typeof(ah) == 'table' and ah.Role then
                    local aj = p.GetPlayerByName and p.GetPlayerByName(ag) or (b and b:FindFirstChild(ag))

                    if aj and aj ~= n then
                        local ak = tostring(ah.Role)

                        if ak == 'Murderer' then
                            ac[aj] = {
                                'Murderer',
                                ad,
                            }
                        elseif ak == 'Sheriff' or ak == 'Hero' then
                            ac[aj] = {
                                'Sheriff',
                                ae,
                            }
                        elseif ak == 'Innocent' then
                            ac[aj] = {
                                'Innocent',
                                af,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for ag, ah in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
            if ah ~= n and not ac[ah] and ah.Character then
                local aj, ak = ah:FindFirstChild'Backpack', ah.Character

                if (aj and aj:FindFirstChild'Knife') or ak:FindFirstChild'Knife' then
                    ac[ah] = {
                        'Murderer',
                        ad,
                    }
                elseif (aj and aj:FindFirstChild'Gun') or ak:FindFirstChild'Gun' then
                    ac[ah] = {
                        'Sheriff',
                        ae,
                    }
                end
            end
        end

        local ag = os.clock()

        for ah, aj in pairs(ab.map)do
            if not ac[ah] and aj and (ag - (aj[3] or 0)) < 2.5 then
                ac[ah] = {
                    aj[1],
                    aj[2],
                    aj[3],
                }
            end
        end
        for ah, aj in pairs(ac)do
            if not aj[3] then
                aj[3] = ag
            end
        end

        ab.map = ac
    end
    local function roleOf(ac)
        local ad = os.clock()

        if ad >= ab.next then
            pcall(refreshRoles)

            ab.next = ad + 0.2
        end

        local ae = ab.map[ac]

        if ae then
            return ae[1], ae[2]
        end

        return nil, nil
    end
    local function update()
        local ac = p.Config

        if not ac or not ac.RoleBoxESP then
            for ad, ae in pairs(aa.entries)do
                hideEntry(ae)
            end

            return
        end

        ensureGui()

        local ad = a and a.CurrentCamera or workspace.CurrentCamera

        if not ad then
            return
        end

        local ae = tick()
        local af = ae - (aa.lastTick or ae)

        aa.lastTick = ae

        if ac.BoxAnimate then
            local ag = tonumber(ac.BoxRotationSpeed) or 300

            aa.rotation = aa.rotation + af * ag * math.cos(math.pi / 4 * ae - math.pi / 2)
        else
            aa.rotation = -45
        end

        local ag = {}

        for ah, aj in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
            if aj ~= n then
                ag[aj] = true

                local ak, al = roleOf(aj)
                local am = aj.Character
                local an, ao, ap = am and (am:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or am.PrimaryPart), am and am:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid', ensureEntry(aj)

                if not ak or not an or not ao or ao.Health <= 0 then
                    hideEntry(ap)
                else
                    local aq, ar, as, B, C = nil, nil, pcall(function()
                        return am:GetBoundingBox()
                    end)

                    if as and B and C then
                        aq = B.Position + B.UpVector * (C.Y * 0.5)
                        ar = B.Position - B.UpVector * (C.Y * 0.5)
                    else
                        local D = am:FindFirstChild'Head'
                        local E = D or an

                        aq = E.Position + Vector3.new(0, (E.Size and E.Size.Y or 1) * 0.5, 0)
                        ar = an.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                    end

                    local D, E = ad:WorldToViewportPoint(aq)
                    local F, G = ad:WorldToViewportPoint(ar)

                    if not E or not G or D.Z <= 0 or F.Z <= 0 then
                        hideEntry(ap)
                    else
                        local H = math.max(math.abs(F.Y - D.Y), 8)
                        local I, J = H * 0.55, (D.X + F.X) * 0.5
                        local K, L, M = J - I / 2, math.min(D.Y, F.Y), tostring(ac.BoxStyle or 'Corner')
                        local N, O, P, Q = M == 'Full', M == 'Corner', ac.BoxFilledEnabled ~= false, tonumber(ac.BoxFilledTransparency)

                        if Q == nil then
                            Q = 0.75
                        end

                        ap.box.Visible = N

                        if N then
                            ap.box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K, L)
                            ap.box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(I, H)

                            if P then
                                ap.box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                                ap.box.BackgroundTransparency = Q
                                ap.gradFill.Enabled = ac.BoxGradientFill ~= false

                                if ap.gradFill.Enabled then
                                    ap.gradFill.Color = ColorSequence.new{
                                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, al),
                                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
                                    }
                                    ap.gradFill.Rotation = aa.rotation
                                else
                                    ap.box.BackgroundColor3 = al
                                    ap.box.BackgroundTransparency = Q
                                end
                            else
                                ap.box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                ap.gradFill.Enabled = false
                            end

                            ap.stroke.Enabled = true
                            ap.stroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            ap.gradStroke.Enabled = ac.BoxGradient and true or false

                            if ap.gradStroke.Enabled then
                                ap.gradStroke.Color = ColorSequence.new{
                                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, al),
                                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
                                }
                                ap.gradStroke.Rotation = aa.rotation
                            else
                                ap.stroke.Color = al
                            end
                        end

                        local R, S, T = ap.corners, I / 5, H / 5

                        if O then
                            R[1].Visible = true
                            R[1].BackgroundColor3 = al
                            R[1].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K, L)
                            R[1].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, 1)
                            R[2].Visible = true
                            R[2].BackgroundColor3 = al
                            R[2].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K, L)
                            R[2].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, T)
                            R[3].Visible = true
                            R[3].BackgroundColor3 = al
                            R[3].AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
                            R[3].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K + I, L)
                            R[3].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, 1)
                            R[4].Visible = true
                            R[4].BackgroundColor3 = al
                            R[4].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K + I - 1, L)
                            R[4].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, T)
                            R[5].Visible = true
                            R[5].BackgroundColor3 = al
                            R[5].AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
                            R[5].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K, L + H)
                            R[5].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, T)
                            R[6].Visible = true
                            R[6].BackgroundColor3 = al
                            R[6].AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
                            R[6].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K, L + H)
                            R[6].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, 1)
                            R[7].Visible = true
                            R[7].BackgroundColor3 = al
                            R[7].AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
                            R[7].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K + I, L + H)
                            R[7].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, T)
                            R[8].Visible = true
                            R[8].BackgroundColor3 = al
                            R[8].AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
                            R[8].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(K + I, L + H)
                            R[8].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, 1)
                        else
                            for U = 1, 8 do
                                R[U].Visible = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for ah, aj in pairs(aa.entries)do
            if not ag[ah] or not ah.Parent then
                destroyEntry(ah)
            end
        end
    end

    TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        pcall(update)
    end))

    if b then
        TrackConnection(b.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(ac)
            destroyEntry(ac)
        end))
    end

    getgenv().CandyRoleBoxESP_Clear = function()
        for ac in pairs(aa.entries)do
            destroyEntry(ac)
        end

        if aa.gui then
            pcall(function()
                aa.gui:Destroy()
            end)

            aa.gui = nil
        end
    end
end

local aa = {
    murderer = nil,
    sheriff = nil,
    nextUpdate = 0,
}

local function _espAnyEnabled()
    local ab = p.Config

    if not ab then
        return false
    end

    local ac = ab.RoleChams or ab.RoleBoxESP or ab.HighlightMurderer or ab.InfoMurderer or ab.BoxMurderer or ab.HighlightSheriff or ab.InfoSheriff or ab.BoxSheriff or ab.HighlightInnocent or ab.InfoInnocent or ab.BoxInnocent or ab.ESPGunDropped or ab.HealthBarEnabled

    if ac then
        ab.ESPEnabled = true
    end

    return ac and ab.ESPEnabled ~= false
end

local ab, ac, ad = 0, {}, 0

TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not _espAnyEnabled() then
        for ae, af in pairs(A)do
            if af.Box then
                af.Box.Visible = false
            end
        end

        return
    end

    ab = ab + 1

    local ae = os.clock()

    if ae >= aa.nextUpdate then
        aa.murderer = p.FindMurderer()
        aa.sheriff = p.FindSheriff()
        aa.nextUpdate = ae + 0.3
    end
    if ae - ad > 0.15 or #ac == 0 then
        ac = b:GetPlayers()
        ad = ae
    end

    local af, ag, ah = aa.murderer, aa.sheriff, a.CurrentCamera

    for aj, ak in ipairs(ac)do
        local al = ak.Character

        if ak ~= n and al and al:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' and al:FindFirstChild'Humanoid' then
            local am = al:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

            if am and am.Health > 0 then
                local an, ao

                if af and ak == af then
                    an, ao = 'Murderer', p.Config.ESPColorMurderer
                elseif ag and ak == ag then
                    an, ao = 'Sheriff', p.Config.ESPColorSheriff
                elseif p.FindInnocent(ak) then
                    an, ao = 'Innocent', p.Config.ESPColorInnocent
                end
                if not an then
                    if A[ak] then
                        A[ak].Box.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    if not A[ak] then
                        A[ak] = {
                            Box = Drawing.new'Square',
                        }
                        A[ak].Box.Thickness = 1
                        A[ak].Box.Filled = false
                        A[ak].Box.ZIndex = 2
                    end

                    local ap, aq, ar = A[ak], al:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', al:FindFirstChild'Head'

                    if p.Config.ESPEnabled and p.Config['Highlight' .. an] then
                        local as = al:FindFirstChild'CandyHighlight'

                        if not as then
                            as = Instance.new'Highlight'
                            as.Name = 'CandyHighlight'
                            as.Parent = al
                        end

                        local B, C, D, E = 0.85, 0, ao, ao

                        if an == 'Murderer' then
                            D = p.Config.ESPColorMurderer or ao
                            E = p.Config.ESPOutlineColorMurderer or D
                            B = tonumber(p.Config.ESPFillTransMurderer) or 0.85
                            C = tonumber(p.Config.ESPOutlineTransMurderer) or 0
                        elseif an == 'Sheriff' then
                            D = p.Config.ESPColorSheriff or ao
                            E = p.Config.ESPOutlineColorSheriff or D
                            B = tonumber(p.Config.ESPFillTransSheriff) or 0.85
                            C = tonumber(p.Config.ESPOutlineTransSheriff) or 0
                        elseif an == 'Innocent' then
                            D = p.Config.ESPColorInnocent or ao
                            E = p.Config.ESPOutlineColorInnocent or D
                            B = tonumber(p.Config.ESPFillTransInnocent) or 0.85
                            C = tonumber(p.Config.ESPOutlineTransInnocent) or 0
                        end

                        as.FillColor = D
                        as.OutlineColor = E
                        as.FillTransparency = math.clamp(B, 0, 1)
                        as.OutlineTransparency = math.clamp(C, 0, 1)
                        as.Enabled = true
                    else
                        local as = al:FindFirstChild'CandyHighlight'

                        if as then
                            as:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                    if p.Config.ESPEnabled and p.Config['Info' .. an] and (ar or aq) then
                        local as = al:FindFirstChild'CandyInfoESP'

                        if not as then
                            as = Instance.new('BillboardGui', al)
                            as.Name = 'CandyInfoESP'
                            as.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50)
                            as.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
                            as.AlwaysOnTop = true

                            local B = Instance.new('TextLabel', as)

                            B.Name = 'InfoLabel'
                            B.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            B.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                            B.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                            B.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
                            B.TextSize = 16
                            B.RichText = true
                        end

                        as.Adornee = ar or aq

                        local B, C = aq and math.floor((ah.CFrame.Position - aq.Position).Magnitude) or 0, as:FindFirstChild'InfoLabel'

                        if C then
                            C.Text = string.format("%s\n<font size='11' color='#DDDDDD'>[%d]</font>", ak.Name, B)
                            C.TextColor3 = ao
                        end
                    else
                        local as = al:FindFirstChild'CandyInfoESP'

                        if as then
                            as:Destroy()
                        end
                    end

                    local as, B, C = p.Config.ESPEnabled and (not p.Config.RoleBoxESP) and (p.Config['Box' .. an] or false), ah:WorldToViewportPoint(aq.Position)
                    local D = ar and ah:WorldToViewportPoint(ar.Position) or B

                    if as and C then
                        local E, F = math.min(B.Y, D.Y) - 10, math.max(B.Y, D.Y) + 20
                        local G = math.max(F - E, 20)
                        local H = G * 0.65
                        local I, J = B.X - H / 2, E

                        ap.Box.Size = Vector2.new(H, G)
                        ap.Box.Position = Vector2.new(I, J)
                        ap.Box.Color = ao or p.Config.BoxColor
                        ap.Box.Thickness = p.Config.BoxThickness or 1
                        ap.Box.Filled = p.Config.BoxFilled or false
                        ap.Box.Transparency = p.Config.BoxFilled and (p.Config.BoxFillTransparency or 0.7) or 1
                        ap.Box.Visible = true
                        ap.lastBoxX = I
                        ap.lastBoxY = J
                        ap.lastBoxW = H
                        ap.lastBoxH = G
                    else
                        ap.Box.Visible = false
                        ap.lastBoxX = nil
                    end
                    if p.Config.ESPEnabled and p.Config.HealthBarEnabled and ap.lastBoxX and am then
                        if not ap.HealthBar then
                            ap.HealthBar = Drawing.new'Line'
                            ap.HealthBar.Thickness = 3
                            ap.HealthBar.ZIndex = 3
                            ap.HealthBarOutline = Drawing.new'Line'
                            ap.HealthBarOutline.Thickness = 5
                            ap.HealthBarOutline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            ap.HealthBarOutline.ZIndex = 2
                        end

                        local E = math.clamp(am.Health / math.max(am.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                        local F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O = (p.Config.HealthBarColorHigh or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)):Lerp(p.Config.HealthBarColorLow or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), 1 - E), p.Config.HealthBarSide or 'left', ap.lastBoxX, ap.lastBoxY, ap.lastBoxW, (ap.lastBoxH)

                        if G == 'left' then
                            L = H - 5
                            N = H - 5
                            M = I + K
                            O = I + K * (1 - E)
                        elseif G == 'right' then
                            L = H + J + 5
                            N = H + J + 5
                            M = I + K
                            O = I + K * (1 - E)
                        elseif G == 'top' then
                            M = I - 5
                            O = I - 5
                            L = H
                            N = H + J * E
                        else
                            M = I + K + 5
                            O = I + K + 5
                            L = H
                            N = H + J * E
                        end
                        if G == 'left' or G == 'right' then
                            ap.HealthBarOutline.From = Vector2.new(L, I + K)
                            ap.HealthBarOutline.To = Vector2.new(L, I)
                            ap.HealthBar.From = Vector2.new(L, M)
                            ap.HealthBar.To = Vector2.new(N, O)
                        else
                            ap.HealthBarOutline.From = Vector2.new(H, M)
                            ap.HealthBarOutline.To = Vector2.new(H + J, M)
                            ap.HealthBar.From = Vector2.new(L, M)
                            ap.HealthBar.To = Vector2.new(N, O)
                        end

                        ap.HealthBar.Color = F
                        ap.HealthBar.Visible = true
                        ap.HealthBarOutline.Visible = true
                    elseif ap.HealthBar then
                        ap.HealthBar.Visible = false

                        if ap.HealthBarOutline then
                            ap.HealthBarOutline.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    do
        local aj, ak = FindGunDrop()
        local al = ak or aj

        if al and al.Parent then
            if p.Config.ESPGunDropped then
                local am = al:FindFirstChild'CandyGunHighlight'

                if not am then
                    am = Instance.new'Highlight'
                    am.Name = 'CandyGunHighlight'
                    am.FillTransparency = 0.4
                    am.OutlineTransparency = 0
                    am.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    am.Parent = al
                end

                am.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
                am.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                am.Enabled = true

                local an = al:FindFirstChild'CandyGunInfo'

                if not an then
                    an = Instance.new'BillboardGui'
                    an.Name = 'CandyGunInfo'
                    an.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 40)
                    an.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                    an.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    an.Parent = al

                    local ao = Instance.new'TextLabel'

                    ao.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    ao.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                    ao.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                    ao.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
                    ao.TextSize = 18
                    ao.RichText = true
                    ao.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
                    ao.Parent = an
                end

                local ao, ap = (aj and aj.Position) or (al:IsA'BasePart' and al.Position) or nil, an:FindFirstChildOfClass'TextLabel'

                if ap and ao and ah then
                    local aq = math.floor((ah.CFrame.Position - ao).Magnitude)

                    ap.Text = string.format("<b>GUN</b>\n<font size='13' color='#DDDDDD'>[%d]</font>", aq)
                end
            else
                local am = al:FindFirstChild'CandyGunHighlight'

                if am then
                    pcall(function()
                        am:Destroy()
                    end)
                end

                local an = al:FindFirstChild'CandyGunInfo'

                if an then
                    pcall(function()
                        an:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for aj, ak in pairs(A)do
        if not aj.Parent then
            if ak.Box then
                ak.Box:Remove()
            end
            if ak.HealthBar then
                pcall(function()
                    ak.HealthBar:Remove()
                end)
            end
            if ak.HealthBarOutline then
                pcall(function()
                    ak.HealthBarOutline:Remove()
                end)
            end

            A[aj] = nil
        end
    end
end))
pcall(function()
    for ae, af in ipairs(a:GetChildren())do
        if (af.Name and string.find(af.Name, 'HitEffect', 1, true)) or (af.GetAttribute and af:GetAttribute'IsHitEffect') then
            for ag, ah in ipairs(af:GetDescendants())do

                end
            end
            for ag, ah in ipairs(af:GetChildren())do
                if ah:IsA'Highlight' or ah:IsA'BillboardGui' then
                    ah:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local ae = false

local function RuzForceStopSelf()
    local af = n and n.Character

    if not af then
        return nil
    end

    local ag = af:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'
    local ah, aj = (ag and ag.RootPart) or af:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or af.PrimaryPart, {
        walkSpeed = ag and ag.WalkSpeed or 16,
        jumpPower = ag and ag.JumpPower or 50,
        jumpHeight = ag and ag.JumpHeight or 7.2,
        platformStand = ag and ag.PlatformStand or false,
        autoRotate = ag and ag.AutoRotate or true,
    }

    pcall(function()
        if ag then
            ag.WalkSpeed = 0
            ag.JumpPower = 0

            pcall(function()
                ag.JumpHeight = 0
            end)

            ag.PlatformStand = true
            ag.AutoRotate = false

            ag:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
        end
        if ah then
            ah.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            ah.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

            pcall(function()
                ah.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                ah.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
        end

        for ak, al in ipairs(af:GetDescendants())do
            if al:IsA'BasePart' then
                pcall(function()
                    al.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    al.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    al.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                    al.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    return aj
end
local function RuzRestoreSelfMovement(af)
    local ag = n and n.Character

    if not ag or not af then
        return
    end

    local ah = ag:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

    pcall(function()
        if ah then
            ah.PlatformStand = af.platformStand and true or false
            ah.AutoRotate = af.autoRotate ~= false

            if not (p.Config and p.Config.EnableWalkSpeed) then
                ah.WalkSpeed = af.walkSpeed or 16
            else
                ah.WalkSpeed = tonumber(p.Config.WalkSpeed) or 16
            end
            if not (p.Config and p.Config.EnableJumpPower) then
                ah.JumpPower = af.jumpPower or 50

                pcall(function()
                    ah.JumpHeight = af.jumpHeight or 7.2
                end)
            else
                ah.JumpPower = tonumber(p.Config.JumpPower) or 50
            end

            ah:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
        end
    end)
end
local function RuzResolveFlingTarget(af)
    if p.PlayerData then
        for ag, ah in pairs(p.PlayerData)do
            if typeof(ah) == 'table' and ah.Role then
                local aj, ak = tostring(ah.Role), false

                if af == 'Murderer' then
                    ak = (aj == 'Murderer')
                else
                    ak = (aj == 'Sheriff' or aj == 'Hero')
                end
                if ak then
                    local al = p.GetPlayerByName(ag) or b:FindFirstChild(ag)

                    if al and al ~= n and al.Character then
                        local am = al.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                        if am and am.Health > 0 then
                            return al
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if af == 'Murderer' then
        if p.FindMurderer then
            local ag = p.FindMurderer()

            if ag and ag ~= n and ag.Character then
                local ah = ag.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                if ah and ah.Health > 0 then
                    return ag
                end
            end
        end
        if p.FlingFns and p.FlingFns.findMurderer then
            local ag, ah = pcall(p.FlingFns.findMurderer)

            if ag and ah and ah ~= n and ah.Character then
                local aj = ah.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                if aj and aj.Health > 0 then
                    return ah
                end
            end
        end
    else
        if p.FindSheriff then
            local ag = p.FindSheriff()

            if ag and ag ~= n and ag.Character then
                local ah = ag.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                if ah and ah.Health > 0 then
                    return ag
                end
            end
        end
        if p.FlingFns and p.FlingFns.findSheriffHero then
            local ag, ah = pcall(p.FlingFns.findSheriffHero)

            if ag and ah and ah ~= n and ah.Character then
                local aj = ah.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                if aj and aj.Health > 0 then
                    return ah
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for ag, ah in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
        if ah ~= n and ah.Character then
            local aj, ak, al = ah:FindFirstChild'Backpack', ah.Character, false

            if af == 'Murderer' then
                al = (aj and aj:FindFirstChild'Knife') or (ak and ak:FindFirstChild'Knife')
            else
                al = (aj and aj:FindFirstChild'Gun') or (ak and ak:FindFirstChild'Gun')
            end
            if al then
                local am = ak:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                if am and am.Health > 0 then
                    return ah
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function p.FlingMurdererRuz()
    if ae then
        return
    end

    local af = RuzResolveFlingTarget'Murderer'

    if not af then
        return
    end

    task.spawn(function(ag)
        if ae then
            return
        end

        local ah = n and n.Character

        if not ah then
            return
        end

        local aj = ah:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

        if not aj then
            return
        end

        local ak = aj.RootPart

        if not ak then
            return
        end

        local al = ag.Character

        if not al then
            return
        end

        local am = al:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'
        local an, ao, ap = am and am.RootPart, al:FindFirstChild'Head', al:FindFirstChildOfClass'Accessory'
        local aq, ar = ap and ap:FindFirstChild'Handle', RuzForceStopSelf()

        if ak.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
            getgenv().RuzOldPos = ak.CFrame
        end
        if not am or not am.Sit then
            local as = ao or (aq or am)

            if as then
                a.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = as
            end
            if al:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'BasePart' then
                local B, C = ak, ah

                local function u670(D, E, F)
                    B.CFrame = CFrame.new(D.Position) * E * F

                    pcall(function()
                        C:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(D.Position) * E * F)
                    end)

                    B.Velocity = Vector3.new(90000000, 900000000, 90000000)
                    B.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(900000000, 900000000, 900000000)
                end

                local D = ak

                ae = true
                a.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = (0 / 0)

                local E = Instance.new'BodyVelocity'

                E.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                E.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9000000000, 9000000000, 9000000000)
                E.Parent = ak

                aj:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)

                local F = an or (ao or aq)

                if F then
                    (function(G)
                        local H, I = tick() + 2.5, 0

                        while D and am do
                            local J = G.Velocity.Magnitude

                            if not (J < 40) then
                                local K, L = am.MoveDirection, am.WalkSpeed

                                u670(G, CFrame.new(K.X * L * 0.12, 3, K.Z * L * 0.12), CFrame.Angles(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))

                                D.Velocity = Vector3.new(900000000, 900000000, 900000000)

                                task.wait()
                                u670(G, CFrame.new(-K.X * L * 0.06, -3, -K.Z * L * 0.06), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))

                                D.Velocity = Vector3.new(900000000, 900000000, 900000000)

                                task.wait()
                                u670(G, CFrame.new(K.X * L * 0.18, 3, K.Z * L * 0.18), CFrame.Angles(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))

                                D.Velocity = Vector3.new(900000000, 900000000, 900000000)

                                task.wait()
                                u670(G, CFrame.new(-K.X * L * 0.06, -3, -K.Z * L * 0.06), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))

                                D.Velocity = Vector3.new(900000000, 900000000, 900000000)

                                task.wait()
                            else
                                I = I + 100

                                u670(G, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + am.MoveDirection * J / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(I), 0, 0))
                                task.wait()
                                u670(G, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + am.MoveDirection * J / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(I), 0, 0))
                                task.wait()
                                u670(G, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + am.MoveDirection * J / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(I), 0, 0))
                                task.wait()
                                u670(G, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + am.MoveDirection * J / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(I), 0, 0))
                                task.wait()
                                u670(G, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(I), 0, 0))
                                task.wait()
                                u670(G, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(I), 0, 0))
                                task.wait()
                            end
                            if H < tick() then
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end)(F)
                end

                E:Destroy()
                aj:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)

                a.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = aj

                if getgenv().RuzOldPos then
                    local G = 0

                    repeat
                        G = G + 1
                        ak.CFrame = getgenv().RuzOldPos * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)

                        pcall(function()
                            ah:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(getgenv().RuzOldPos * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0))
                        end)
                        aj:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)

                        for H, I in ipairs(ah:GetChildren())do
                            if I:IsA'BasePart' then
                                I.Velocity = Vector3.new()
                                I.RotVelocity = Vector3.new()
                            end
                        end

                        task.wait()
                    until G > 30 or (ak.Position - getgenv().RuzOldPos.p).Magnitude < 25

                    a.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = getgenv().RuzFPDH
                end

                RuzRestoreSelfMovement(ar)

                ae = false

                return
            end

            RuzRestoreSelfMovement(ar)

            return
        end

        RuzRestoreSelfMovement(ar)

        return
    end, af)
end
