local function Resolver_GetPingSeconds()
    local ag = 0.05

    pcall(function()
        if l then
            local ah = l:FindFirstChild'Network'
            local aj = ah and ah:FindFirstChild'ServerStatsItem'
            local ak = aj and aj:FindFirstChild'Data Ping'

            if ak then
                ag = math.clamp(ak:GetValue() / 1000, 0.006, 0.4)
            end
        end
    end)

    return ag
end
local function Resolver_Percentile(ag, ah)
    if #ag == 0 then
        return 0
    end
    if #ag == 1 then
        return ag[1]
    end

    local aj = (ah / 100) * (#ag - 1) + 1
    local ak = math.floor(aj)
    local al, am = math.min(#ag, ak + 1), aj - ak

    return ag[ak] * (1 - am) + ag[al] * am
end
local function Resolver_UpdatePingStats()
    local ag = Resolver_GetPingSeconds()

    af.pingRaw = ag

    local ah, aj = os.clock(), math.abs(ag - af.pingEma)
    local ak = (aj > 0.08 and 0.08) or (aj > 0.04 and 0.18) or 0.32

    af.pingEma = af.pingEma + (ag - af.pingEma) * ak

    if (ah - af.lastPingSampleT) >= 0.06 then
        af.lastPingSampleT = ah

        table.insert(af.pingSamples, ag)

        while#af.pingSamples > 16 do
            table.remove(af.pingSamples, 1)
        end

        if #af.pingSamples >= 5 then
            local al = {}

            for am = 1, #af.pingSamples do
                al[am] = af.pingSamples[am]
            end

            table.sort(al)

            af.pingP75 = Resolver_Percentile(al, 75)
            af.pingP90 = Resolver_Percentile(al, 90)
        else
            af.pingP75 = af.pingEma
            af.pingP90 = math.max(af.pingEma, ag)
        end
    end

    return af.pingEma, ag
end
local function Resolver_GetPingJitter()
    local ag = af.pingSamples

    if #ag < 5 then
        return 0
    end

    local ah = 0

    for aj = 1, #ag do
        ah = ah + ag[aj]
    end

    ah = ah / #ag

    local aj = 0

    for ak = 1, #ag do
        local al = ag[ak] - ah

        aj = aj + al * al
    end

    return math.sqrt(aj / #ag)
end

function p.GetAdaptivePredictionParams()
    local ag, ah = p.Config or {}, Resolver_UpdatePingStats()
    local aj, ak, al, am, an = ah * 1000, (af.pingP75 or ah) * 1000, (af.pingP90 or ah) * 1000, Resolver_GetPingJitter() * 1000, ah * 0.28 + (af.pingP75 or ah) * 0.42 + (af.pingP90 or ah) * 0.3
    local ao, ap = (0.52 + math.clamp((ak - 35) / 130, 0, 1) * 0.1 + math.clamp(am / 35, 0, 1) * 0.06)

    if ak <= 28 then
        ap = 16 + ak * 0.22
    elseif ak <= 55 then
        ap = 22 + (ak - 28) * 0.48
    elseif ak <= 90 then
        ap = 35 + (ak - 55) * 0.32
    else
        ap = 46 + (ak - 90) * 0.14
    end

    ap = ap + math.clamp(am * 0.75, 0, 28)
    ap = ap + (1 - af.confidence) * 10
    ap = ap + math.clamp((af.lagScore or 0) * 18, 0, 22)

    local aq

    if ak <= 35 then
        aq = 0.07
    elseif ak <= 70 then
        aq = 0.1 + (ak - 35) / 35 * 0.1
    else
        aq = 0.2 + math.clamp((ak - 70) / 100, 0, 1) * 0.16
    end

    local ar, as, B = math.clamp(0.012 + aq * 0.05, 0.006, 0.055), tonumber(ag.ResolverLatencyScale) or 1, tonumber(ag.ResolverExtraMs) or 40
    local C = an * ao * as

    ap = ap + (B - 40) * 0.85
    ap = math.clamp(ap, 4, 130)
    aq = math.clamp(aq, 0.025, 0.6)
    ar = math.clamp(ar, 0.005, 0.08)

    local D, E = C + ap / 1000, math.clamp(af.strafeScore * 0.14 + af.dirChangeScore * 0.11 + af.oscScore * 0.16, 0, 0.32)

    D = D * (1 - E)
    D = math.clamp(D, 0.012, 0.42)
    af.adaptedScale = ao * as
    af.adaptedExtraMs = ap
    af.adaptedSmooth = aq
    af.adaptedShootSmooth = ar
    af.adaptedLead = D

    return {
        ping = ah,
        pingMs = aj,
        pingRaw = af.pingRaw,
        p75Ms = ak,
        p90Ms = al,
        jitterMs = am,
        scale = af.adaptedScale,
        extraMs = ap,
        smooth = aq,
        shootSmooth = ar,
        lead = D,
        strafeScore = af.strafeScore,
        dirChangeScore = af.dirChangeScore,
        oscScore = af.oscScore,
        confidence = af.confidence,
        lagScore = af.lagScore or 0,
    }
end

local function Resolver_GetAimPart(ag, ah)
    ah = ah or 'Head'

    local aj, ak, al = ag:FindFirstChild'Head', ag:FindFirstChild'UpperTorso' or ag:FindFirstChild'Torso', ag:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

    if ah == 'Head' then
        return aj or ak or al
    elseif ah == 'Torso' then
        return ak or al or aj
    elseif ah == 'HRP' then
        return al or ak or aj
    elseif ah == 'Closest' then
        local am = a.CurrentCamera
        local an = am and am.CFrame.Position or (p.RootPart and p.RootPart.Position)

        if an then
            local ao, ap = (math.huge)

            for aq, ar in ipairs{aj, ak, al}do
                if ar and ar:IsA'BasePart' then
                    local as = (ar.Position - an).Magnitude

                    if as < ao then
                        ao = as
                        ap = ar
                    end
                end
            end

            if ap then
                return ap
            end
        end
    elseif ah == 'Auto' then
        local am = (p.RootPart and p.RootPart.Position) or (a.CurrentCamera and a.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)

        if am and al then
            local an = (al.Position - am).Magnitude

            if an < 48 and aj then
                return aj
            end
            if ak then
                return ak
            end
        end

        return aj or ak or al
    end

    return al or ag.PrimaryPart
end
local function Resolver_PushSample(ag, ah, aj, ak)
    local al = os.clock()

    if ah and ah.Magnitude > 80 then
        ah = ah.Unit * 80
    end

    local am = Vector3.new(ah.X, 0, ah.Z)

    table.insert(af.samples, {
        t = al,
        pos = ag,
        vel = ah,
        hvel = am,
        aimPos = aj or ag,
        grounded = ak and true or false,
    })

    while#af.samples > 12 do
        table.remove(af.samples, 1)
    end
    while#af.samples > 0 and (al - af.samples[1].t) > 0.3 do
        table.remove(af.samples, 1)
    end

    local an = 0.42

    if af.velEma.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        af.velEma = ah
        af.hVelEma = am
    else
        af.velEma = af.velEma:Lerp(ah, an)
        af.hVelEma = af.hVelEma:Lerp(am, an)
    end

    local ao = am.Magnitude > 1 and am.Unit or Vector3.zero

    if af.lastHDir.Magnitude > 0.4 and ao.Magnitude > 0.4 then
        local ap = math.clamp(af.lastHDir:Dot(ao), -1, 1)
        local aq = 1 - ap

        af.dirChangeScore = af.dirChangeScore * 0.84 + math.clamp(aq * 0.55, 0, 1) * 0.16
    else
        af.dirChangeScore = af.dirChangeScore * 0.93
    end
    if ao.Magnitude > 0.4 then
        af.lastHDir = ao
    end

    local ap, aq = am.X > 1.2 and 1 or (am.X < -1.2 and -1 or 0), am.Z > 1.2 and 1 or (am.Z < -1.2 and -1 or 0)

    if af.signWindowT == 0 then
        af.signWindowT = al
    end
    if (al - af.signWindowT) > 0.48 then
        af.signFlipCount = math.max(0, af.signFlipCount - 1)
        af.signWindowT = al
    end
    if ap ~= 0 and af.lastSignX ~= 0 and ap ~= af.lastSignX then
        af.signFlipCount = af.signFlipCount + 1
    end
    if aq ~= 0 and af.lastSignZ ~= 0 and aq ~= af.lastSignZ then
        af.signFlipCount = af.signFlipCount + 1
    end
    if ap ~= 0 then
        af.lastSignX = ap
    end
    if aq ~= 0 then
        af.lastSignZ = aq
    end

    af.strafeScore = math.clamp(af.signFlipCount / 5, 0, 1)

    local ar, as = 0, af.samples

    if #as >= 6 then
        local B, C, D = 0, 0

        for E = math.max(1, #as - 10), #as do
            local F = as[E].hvel

            if F.Magnitude > 1.5 then
                local G = F.Unit

                if D then
                    C = C + 1

                    if D:Dot(G) < 0 then
                        B = B + 1
                    end
                end

                D = G
            end
        end

        if C > 0 then
            ar = B / C
        end
    end

    af.oscScore = af.oscScore * 0.75 + ar * 0.25
end
local function Resolver_EstimateAccel()
    local ag = af.samples

    if #ag < 4 then
        return Vector3.zero
    end

    local ah, aj = ag[math.max(1, #ag - 3)], ag[#ag]
    local ak = aj.t - ah.t

    if ak < 0.025 then
        return Vector3.zero
    end

    local al = (aj.vel - ah.vel) / ak

    if al.Magnitude > 140 then
        al = al.Unit * 140
    end
    if af.accelEma.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        af.accelEma = al
    else
        af.accelEma = af.accelEma:Lerp(al, 0.28)
    end

    al = af.accelEma

    local am = 1 - af.strafeScore * 0.65 - af.dirChangeScore * 0.4 - af.oscScore * 0.5

    al = al * math.clamp(am, 0.05, 1)

    return al
end
local function Resolver_EstimateVelFromHistory()
    local ag = af.samples

    if #ag < 3 then
        return nil, 0
    end

    local ah = math.min(#ag, 14)
    local aj, ak, al, am, an = #ag - ah + 1, 0, Vector3.zero, 0, {}

    for ao = aj, #ag - 1 do
        local ap, aq = ag[ao], ag[ao + 1]
        local ar = aq.t - ap.t

        if ar >= 0.008 and ar < 0.22 then
            local as = (aq.pos - ap.pos) / ar

            if as.Magnitude <= 85 then
                local B = 1 + (ao - aj) * 0.55

                table.insert(an, {
                    v = as,
                    w = B,
                    dt = ar,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    if #an < 2 then
        return nil, 0
    end

    local ao = {}

    for ap = 1, #an do
        ao[ap] = an[ap].v.Magnitude
    end

    table.sort(ao)

    local ap = ao[math.max(1, math.floor(#ao * 0.5))]
    local aq = math.max(ap * 2.4, 18)

    for ar = 1, #an do
        local as = an[ar]

        if as.v.Magnitude <= aq then
            al = al + as.v * as.w
            ak = ak + as.w
            am = am + 1
        end
    end

    if ak < 0.01 or am < 2 then
        return nil, 0
    end

    local ar = al / ak

    if ar.Magnitude > 80 then
        ar = ar.Unit * 80
    end

    local as = math.clamp(am / 7, 0.2, 1)

    if am >= 3 then
        local B, C = Vector3.zero, 0

        for D = 1, #an do
            if an[D].v.Magnitude > 1.2 and an[D].v.Magnitude <= aq then
                B = B + an[D].v.Unit
                C = C + 1
            end
        end

        if C >= 2 then
            local D = (B / C).Magnitude

            as = as * math.clamp(0.35 + D * 0.65, 0.3, 1)
        end
    end

    return ar, as
end
local function Resolver_ResolveVelocity(ag, ah)
    local aj = (ag and ag.AssemblyLinearVelocity) or Vector3.zero

    if aj.Magnitude > 90 then
        aj = aj.Unit * 90
    end

    local ak, al, am, an = ah and ah.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero, (ah and ah.WalkSpeed) or 16, Resolver_EstimateVelFromHistory()

    an = an or 0

    local ao = aj

    if ao.Magnitude < 0.35 and ak.Magnitude > 0.08 then
        ao = ak * al
    end
    if am then
        local ap = 0.2 + an * 0.34

        if af.strafeScore > 0.3 or af.oscScore > 0.28 then
            ap = ap + 0.22
        end
        if aj.Magnitude < 0.4 then
            ap = math.max(ap, 0.6)
        end
        if (af.lagScore or 0) > 0.45 then
            ap = math.max(ap, 0.7)
        end

        ao = ao:Lerp(am, math.clamp(ap, 0, 0.82))
    end
    if af.velEma.Magnitude > 0.1 then
        ao = ao:Lerp(af.velEma, 0.26)
    end
    if af.stableVel.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        local ap, aq, ar = Vector3.new(ao.X, 0, ao.Z), Vector3.new(af.stableVel.X, 0, af.stableVel.Z), 0.22

        if af.dirChangeScore > 0.4 then
            ar = 0.12
        end

        ap = ap:Lerp(aq, ar)
        ao = Vector3.new(ap.X, ao.Y, ap.Z)
    end

    local ap = af.hVelEma

    if ap.Magnitude > 0.12 then
        local aq = Vector3.new(ao.X, 0, ao.Z):Lerp(ap, 0.28)

        ao = Vector3.new(aq.X, aj.Y * 0.8 + ao.Y * 0.2, aq.Z)
    end
    if ak.Magnitude > 0.2 then
        local aq = Vector3.new(ao.X, 0, ao.Z)

        if aq.Magnitude > 1 then
            local ar, as = ak.Unit, aq.Unit
            local B = ar:Dot(as)

            if B < 0.05 then
                local C = ar * math.max(aq.Magnitude * 0.65, al * 0.8)

                aq = aq:Lerp(C, 0.48)
                ao = Vector3.new(aq.X, ao.Y, aq.Z)
            elseif B < 0.35 then
                local C = ar * math.max(aq.Magnitude * 0.75, al * 0.7)

                aq = aq:Lerp(C, 0.32)
                ao = Vector3.new(aq.X, ao.Y, aq.Z)
            elseif B > 0.75 and aq.Magnitude < al * 0.5 then
                aq = aq:Lerp(ar * al, 0.22)
                ao = Vector3.new(aq.X, ao.Y, aq.Z)
            end
        elseif ak.Magnitude > 0.45 then
            ao = Vector3.new(ak.X * al * 0.92, ao.Y, ak.Z * al * 0.92)
        end
    end
    if af.stableVel.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        af.stableVel = ao
    else
        local aq = (af.dirChangeScore > 0.5) and 0.38 or 0.22

        af.stableVel = af.stableVel:Lerp(ao, aq)
    end

    local aq = 1

    aq = aq - af.oscScore * 0.38
    aq = aq - af.strafeScore * 0.22
    aq = aq - af.dirChangeScore * 0.16
    aq = aq - math.clamp((af.lagScore or 0) * 0.25, 0, 0.25)

    if an > 0 then
        aq = aq * (0.5 + an * 0.5)
    end

    af.confidence = math.clamp(aq, 0.2, 1)
    af.avgSpeed = af.avgSpeed * 0.92 + ao.Magnitude * 0.08

    return ao
end

TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    pcall(Resolver_UpdatePingStats)

    if not p.Config or p.Config.ResolverEnabled == false then
        return
    end

    local ag = p.FindMurderer()

    if not ag or not ag.Character then
        af.samples = {}
        af.smoothPos = nil
        af.shootSmoothPos = nil
        af.targetUserId = nil
        af.strafeScore = 0
        af.signFlipCount = 0
        af.dirChangeScore = 0
        af.oscScore = 0
        af.confidence = 1

        return
    end
    if af.targetUserId ~= ag.UserId then
        af.samples = {}
        af.smoothPos = nil
        af.shootSmoothPos = nil
        af.targetUserId = ag.UserId
        af.velEma = Vector3.zero
        af.hVelEma = Vector3.zero
        af.accelEma = Vector3.zero
        af.stableVel = Vector3.zero
        af.strafeScore = 0
        af.signFlipCount = 0
        af.dirChangeScore = 0
        af.oscScore = 0
        af.lastHDir = Vector3.zero
        af.confidence = 1
        af.airborneSince = 0
        af.lagScore = 0
        af.lagHoldPos = nil
        af.lagHoldUntil = 0
        af.predError = Vector3.zero
        af.lastPredPos = nil
        af.patternPositions = {}
        af.patternResolved = nil
        af.patternRefresh = 0
    end

    local ah, aj = ag.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', ag.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

    if not ah or not aj or aj.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local ak, al, am = Resolver_GetAimPart(ag.Character, (p.Config and p.Config.ResolverAimPart) or 'Head'), Resolver_ResolveVelocity(ah, aj), aj.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air

    af.isAirborne = not am

    if not am then
        if af.airborneSince == 0 then
            af.airborneSince = os.clock()
            af.jumpVy0 = al.Y
        end
    else
        af.airborneSince = 0
    end

    local an = os.clock()

    if af.lastPos then
        local ao, ap = math.max(an - (af.lastT or an), 8.333333333333334E-3), (ah.Position - af.lastPos).Magnitude
        local aq = (af.lastVel or Vector3.zero).Magnitude * ao + 2.2

        if ap > aq * 1.85 and ap > 4.5 then
            af.lagScore = math.clamp((af.lagScore or 0) + 0.35, 0, 1)
            af.lagHoldPos = ah.Position
            af.lagHoldUntil = an + 0.12
        else
            af.lagScore = math.max(0, (af.lagScore or 0) - 0.08)
        end
    end
    if af.lastPredPos and af.lastPredT and (an - af.lastPredT) < 0.2 then
        local ao = ah.Position - af.lastPredPos
        local ap = ao.Magnitude

        if ap < 25 then
            af.predError = af.predError:Lerp(ao, 0.28)
        else
            af.predError = af.predError * 0.5
        end
    end

    Resolver_PushSample(ah.Position, al, ak and ak.Position or ah.Position, am)

    af.lastPos = ah.Position
    af.lastVel = al
    af.lastT = an
end))

function p.GetResolverLatency(ag)
    ag = ag or {}

    local ah = p.Config or {}
    local aj, ak = ah.ResolverMode or 'Adaptive'

    if ah.ResolverAutoAdapt ~= false then
        local al = p.GetAdaptivePredictionParams()

        ak = al.lead

        if aj == 'Aggressive' then
            ak = ak + 0.02
        elseif aj == 'Velocity' then
            ak = ak * 0.9
        elseif aj == 'Hybrid' then
            ak = ak * 0.95
        end
    else
        local al, am, an = Resolver_UpdatePingStats(), (tonumber(ah.ResolverExtraMs) or 40) / 1000, tonumber(ah.ResolverLatencyScale) or 1

        ak = al * (0.55 * an) + am

        if aj == 'Aggressive' then
            ak = ak + 0.025
        elseif aj == 'Velocity' then
            ak = al * (0.5 * an) + am * 0.5
        elseif aj == 'Hybrid' then
            ak = al * (0.52 * an) + am * 0.72
        end
    end

    local al = tonumber(ag.distance)

    if al and al > 0 then
        if al < 12 then
            ak = ak * 0.62
        elseif al < 25 then
            ak = ak * 0.78
        elseif al < 45 then
            ak = ak * 0.9
        elseif al < 80 then
            ak = ak * 0.98
        elseif al > 80 then
            local am = math.clamp((al - 80) / 450, 0, 0.09)

            ak = ak * (1 + math.clamp((al - 80) / 120, 0, 0.28)) + am
        end
    end
    if af.strafeScore > 0.28 then
        ak = ak * (1 - af.strafeScore * 0.18)
    end
    if af.oscScore > 0.22 then
        ak = ak * (1 - af.oscScore * 0.16)
    end
    if af.dirChangeScore > 0.38 then
        ak = ak * (1 - af.dirChangeScore * 0.12)
    end
    if (af.lagScore or 0) > 0.4 then
        ak = ak * (1 - af.lagScore * 0.12)
    end

    return math.clamp(ak, 0.01, 0.45)
end
function p.GetResolverSmooth()
    local ag = p.Config or {}

    if ag.ResolverAutoAdapt ~= false then
        p.GetAdaptivePredictionParams()

        local ah, aj = af.adaptedSmooth, math.clamp(tonumber(ag.ResolverSmooth) or 0.35, 0, 0.9)
        local ak = (aj - 0.35) * 0.4

        return math.clamp(ah + ak, 0.03, 0.75)
    end

    return math.clamp(tonumber(ag.ResolverSmooth) or 0.35, 0, 0.9)
end
function p.GetResolverShootSmooth()
    local ag = p.Config or {}

    if ag.ResolverAutoAdapt ~= false then
        p.GetAdaptivePredictionParams()

        return math.clamp(af.adaptedShootSmooth or 0.03, 0.005, 0.08)
    end

    local ah = math.clamp(tonumber(ag.ResolverSmooth) or 0.35, 0, 0.9)

    return math.clamp(ah * 0.12, 0.005, 0.08)
end

local function Resolver_PatternResolve(ag)
    local ah = p.Config or {}

    if ah.ResolverPattern == false then
        return ag
    end

    local aj, ak = os.clock(), tonumber(ah.ResolverRefreshTime) or 2.5

    if aj - (af.patternRefresh or 0) >= ak then
        af.patternPositions = {}
        af.patternResolved = nil
        af.patternRefresh = aj
    end

    local al, am, an, ao, ap = tonumber(ah.ResolverForgiveness) or 12, math.max(2, math.floor(tonumber(ah.ResolverMinCluster) or 4)), tonumber(ah.ResolverDistPenalty) or 1.2, tonumber(ah.ResolverVoidBonus) or 8, math.abs(ag.X) + math.abs(ag.Z)

    if ap < 8955 then
        al = al + ao
    end

    local aq = n
    local ar = aq and aq.Character
    local as = ar and ar:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

    if as then
        local B = (ag - as.Position).Magnitude
        local C = (B / 100) * an

        al = math.clamp(al - C, 1, 100)
    end

    table.insert(af.patternPositions, {
        pos = ag,
        time = aj,
    })

    while#af.patternPositions > 120 do
        table.remove(af.patternPositions, 1)
    end

    local B = af.patternPositions

    if #B < 10 then
        return ag
    end

    local C = {}

    for D = 1, #B do
        local E, F, G = B[D].pos, 0, Vector3.zero

        for H = 1, #B do
            local I = B[H].pos

            if (E - I).Magnitude <= al then
                F = F + 1
                G = G + I
            end
        end

        if F >= am then
            table.insert(C, {
                pos = G / F,
                count = F,
            })
        end
    end

    local D

    for E, F in ipairs(C)do
        if not D or F.count > D.count then
            D = F
        end
    end

    if D then
        af.patternResolved = D.pos

        return D.pos
    end

    return ag
end

function p.ResolveMurderer(ag)
    ag = ag or {}

    local ah = p.FindMurderer()

    if not ah or not ah.Character then
        return nil
    end

    local aj = ah.Character
    local ak = aj:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

    if not ak or ak.Health <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local al = p.Config or {}
    local am = ag.aimPart or al.ResolverAimPart or 'Head'
    local an, ao = Resolver_GetAimPart(aj, am), aj:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

    if not an and not ao then
        return nil
    end

    an = an or ao

    local ap = an.Position

    if an.Name == 'Head' and not ag.rawAim then
        ap = ap + Vector3.new(0, -0.22, 0)
    elseif an.Name == 'UpperTorso' or an.Name == 'Torso' then
        ap = ap + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)
    end

    local aq = Resolver_PatternResolve(ap)

    if aq and aq ~= ap then
        ap = Vector3.new(aq.X, ap.Y, aq.Z)
    end

    local ar = Resolver_ResolveVelocity(ao, ak)

    if al.ResolverEnabled == false then
        return ap, ah, an
    end

    local as = (p.RootPart and p.RootPart.Position) or (a.CurrentCamera and a.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)
    local B = as and (ap - as).Magnitude or 40
    local C = p.GetResolverLatency{distance = B}

    if ag.forShoot and ag.extraLead then
        C = C + (tonumber(ag.extraLead) or 0)
    end

    local D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R = al.ResolverMode or 'Adaptive', Resolver_EstimateAccel(), ak.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air, ar.Magnitude, Vector3.new(ar.X, 0, ar.Z).Magnitude, af.strafeScore, af.oscScore, af.dirChangeScore, af.confidence, af.lagScore or 0, Vector3.new(ar.X, 0, ar.Z), ak.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero, ak.WalkSpeed or 16, ap

    if M > 0.55 and af.lagHoldPos and os.clock() < (af.lagHoldUntil or 0) then
        Q = af.lagHoldPos:Lerp(ap, 0.35)

        if af.stableVel.Magnitude > 1 then
            ar = ar:Lerp(af.stableVel, 0.4)
            N = Vector3.new(ar.X, 0, ar.Z)
        end
    end
    if D == 'Velocity' then
        R = Q + ar * C
    elseif D == 'Aggressive' then
        R = Q + ar * C + 0.5 * E * (C * C)

        if O.Magnitude > 0.12 then
            R = R + O * P * C * 0.12
        end
    elseif D == 'Hybrid' then
        local S, T = Q + ar * C, Q + ar * C + 0.5 * E * (C * C) * math.clamp(1 - I * 0.55 - J * 0.4, 0, 1)

        R = S:Lerp(T, 0.48)
    else
        local S = math.clamp(E.Magnitude / 42, 0, 1) * (1 - I * 0.65 - J * 0.5 - K * 0.32) * L

        if G < 1 and H < 0.85 then
            R = Q + ar * (C * 0.08)

            if O.Magnitude > 0.3 then
                R = R + O * P * C * 0.35
            end
        elseif F then
            local T, U = ar.Y, C

            if af.airborneSince > 0 then
                local V = os.clock() - af.airborneSince

                if V < 0.85 then
                    U = C
                end
            end

            R = Q + N * U + Vector3.new(0, T * U, 0)

            if al.ResolverGravity ~= false then
                local V = a.Gravity or 196.2

                R = R + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * V * U * U, 0)
            end
            if O.Magnitude > 0.15 then
                R = R + Vector3.new(O.X, 0, O.Z) * P * U * 0.15
            end
        elseif J > 0.42 or I > 0.5 then
            local T = 0.78 + L * 0.12

            R = Q + ar * (C * T)

            if O.Magnitude > 0.2 then
                R = R:Lerp(Q + O * P * C * 0.9, 0.18)
            end
        elseif K > 0.5 then
            local T = ar

            if O.Magnitude > 0.25 then
                local U = O * math.max(H, P * 0.85)

                T = Vector3.new(U.X, ar.Y, U.Z)
            end

            R = Q + T * (C * 0.82)
        else
            R = Q + ar * C + 0.5 * E * (C * C) * S

            if O.Magnitude > 0.35 and H > 4 then
                local T = O * P * C * 0.06 * L

                R = R + T
            end
        end
    end
    if D ~= 'Adaptive' and al.ResolverGravity ~= false and F then
        R = R + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * (a.Gravity or 196.2) * C * C, 0)
    end
    if af.predError and af.predError.Magnitude > 0.15 then
        local S = ag.forShoot and 0.22 or 0.12

        S = S * L
        R = R + af.predError * S
    end
    if al.ResolverGroundClamp ~= false and not F then
        if R.Y < ap.Y - 0.45 then
            R = Vector3.new(R.X, ap.Y, R.Z)
        elseif R.Y > ap.Y + 1.6 and G < 12 then
            R = Vector3.new(R.X, ap.Y + (R.Y - ap.Y) * 0.15, R.Z)
        end
    end

    local S = ag.forShoot == true

    if S then
        local T = p.GetResolverShootSmooth()

        if T > 0 and af.shootSmoothPos then
            R = af.shootSmoothPos:Lerp(R, 1 - T)
        end

        af.shootSmoothPos = R
    else
        local T = p.GetResolverSmooth()

        if T > 0 and af.smoothPos then
            R = af.smoothPos:Lerp(R, 1 - T)
        end

        af.smoothPos = R
    end

    af.lastPredPos = R
    af.lastPredT = os.clock()

    return R, ah, an, C
end
function p.EnableWalkSpeed(ag)
    p.Config.EnableWalkSpeed = ag

    if not ag then
        if ai then
            DisconnectConnection(ai)

            ai = nil
        end
        if p.Humanoid then
            p.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        end

        return
    end
    if ai then
        DisconnectConnection(ai)
    end

    ai = TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if p.Humanoid and p.Humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= p.Config.WalkSpeed then
            p.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = p.Config.WalkSpeed
        end
    end))
end
function p.SetWalkSpeed(ag)
    p.Config.WalkSpeed = math.clamp(ag, 16, 200)

    if p.Config.EnableWalkSpeed and p.Humanoid then
        p.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = p.Config.WalkSpeed
    end
end

local ag

function p.EnableJumpPower(ah)
    p.Config.EnableJumpPower = ah

    if not ah then
        if ag then
            DisconnectConnection(ag)

            ag = nil
        end
        if p.Humanoid then
            p.Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
        end

        return
    end
    if ag then
        DisconnectConnection(ag)
    end

    ag = TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if p.Humanoid and p.Humanoid.JumpPower ~= p.Config.JumpPower then
            p.Humanoid.JumpPower = p.Config.JumpPower
        end
    end))
end
function p.SetJumpPower(ah)
    p.Config.JumpPower = math.clamp(ah, 50, 300)

    if p.Config.EnableJumpPower and p.Humanoid then
        p.Humanoid.JumpPower = p.Config.JumpPower
    end
end

local ah, aj = {}

function p.EnableNoclip(ak)
    p.Config.Noclip = ak

    if not ak then
        if aj then
            DisconnectConnection(aj)

            aj = nil
        end

        for al, am in pairs(ah)do
            if al and al.Parent then
                al.CanCollide = am
            end
        end

        ah = {}

        return
    end

    ah = {}

    if p.Character then
        for al, am in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants())do
            if am:IsA'BasePart' then
                ah[am] = am.CanCollide
                am.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    if aj then
        DisconnectConnection(aj)
    end

    aj = TrackConnection(d.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if p.Character then
            for al, am in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants())do
                if am:IsA'BasePart' then
                    am.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end

local ak

function p.InfiniteJump(al)
    p.Config.InfiniteJump = al

    if not al then
        if ak then
            DisconnectConnection(ak)

            ak = nil
        end

        return
    end
    if ak then
        DisconnectConnection(ak)
    end

    ak = TrackConnection(e.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
        if p.Humanoid then
            p.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end))
end

local al

function p.EnableFOV(am)
    if am ~= nil then
        p.Config.EnableFOV = am and true or false
    end
    if al then
        DisconnectConnection(al)

        al = nil
    end
    if not p.Config.EnableFOV then
        local an = a and a.CurrentCamera

        if an then
            pcall(function()
                an.FieldOfView = 70
            end)
        end

        return
    end

    al = TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not p.Config.EnableFOV then
            return
        end

        local an = a and a.CurrentCamera

        if an then
            local ao = tonumber(p.Config.FOV) or 70

            if math.abs(an.FieldOfView - ao) > 0.05 then
                an.FieldOfView = ao
            end
        end
    end))
end
function p.SetFOV(am)
    local an = math.clamp(tonumber(am) or 70, 40, 120)

    p.Config.FOV = an

    if p.Config.EnableFOV then
        local ao = a and a.CurrentCamera

        if ao then
            pcall(function()
                ao.FieldOfView = an
            end)
        end
    end
end
function p.GrabGun()
    local am = p.RootPart or (n and n.Character and (n.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or n.Character.PrimaryPart))

    if not am or not am.Parent then
        return false
    end

    local an = FindGunDrop()

    if not an or not an.Parent then
        return false
    end

    local ao = false

    if firetouchinterest then
        pcall(function()
            firetouchinterest(am, an, 0)
            firetouchinterest(am, an, 1)

            ao = true
        end)
        pcall(function()
            firetouchinterest(an, am, 0)
            firetouchinterest(an, am, 1)

            ao = true
        end)
        pcall(function()
            firetouchinterest(am, an, 1)
            firetouchinterest(am, an, 0)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            firetouchinterest(an, am, 1)
            firetouchinterest(an, am, 0)
        end)
    end

    local function hasGun()
        local ap, aq = n and n.Character, n and n:FindFirstChild'Backpack'

        if ap and (ap:FindFirstChild'Gun' or ap:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'Tool') then
            local ar = ap:FindFirstChild'Gun'

            if ar then
                return true
            end
        end
        if aq and aq:FindFirstChild'Gun' then
            return true
        end

        return false
    end

    if not hasGun() then
        local ap = am.CFrame

        pcall(function()
            am.CFrame = an.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        end)

        if firetouchinterest then
            pcall(function()
                firetouchinterest(am, an, 0)
                firetouchinterest(am, an, 1)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                firetouchinterest(an, am, 0)
                firetouchinterest(an, am, 1)
            end)
        end

        task.defer(function()
            pcall(function()
                if am and am.Parent then
                    am.CFrame = ap
                end
            end)
        end)

        ao = true
    end

    return ao
end

local am, an = nil, 0

function p.ToggleAutoGrabGun(ao)
    if ao ~= nil then
        p.Config.AutoGrabGun = ao and true or false
    end
    if am then
        DisconnectConnection(am)

        am = nil
    end
    if p.Config.AutoGrabGun then
        an = 0
        am = TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not p.Config.AutoGrabGun then
                return
            end

            local ap = os.clock()

            if ap - an < 0.15 then
                return
            end

            an = ap

            local aq, ar = n and n.Character, n and n:FindFirstChild'Backpack'

            if (aq and aq:FindFirstChild'Gun') or (ar and ar:FindFirstChild'Gun') then
                return
            end

            pcall(p.GrabGun)
        end))
    end
end

local ao, ap = false
local aq, ar, as, B = {
    MainPoint = nil,
    PosController = nil,
    RotController = nil,
}, {}

task.spawn(function()
    if y then
        for C, D in ipairs{
            'RoundStart',
            'RoundEndFade',
            'VictoryScreen',
        }do
            local E = y:FindFirstChild(D)

            if E then
                TrackConnection(E.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                    ao = (D == 'RoundStart')
                end))
            end
        end
    end
    if n then
        TrackConnection(n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(C)
            local D = C:WaitForChild('Humanoid', 10)

            if D then
                D.Died:Connect(function()
                    ao = false
                end)
            end
        end))

        if n.Character then
            local C = n.Character:FindFirstChild'Humanoid'

            if C then
                C.Died:Connect(function()
                    ao = false
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function CleanupFarm()
    if as then
        pcall(function()
            as:Cancel()
        end)

        as = nil
    end
    if aq.PosController then
        aq.PosController:Destroy()

        aq.PosController = nil
    end
    if aq.RotController then
        aq.RotController:Destroy()

        aq.RotController = nil
    end
    if aq.MainPoint then
        aq.MainPoint:Destroy()

        aq.MainPoint = nil
    end
end
local function SetFarmNoclip(C)
    if p.EnableNoclip then
        p.EnableNoclip(C)
    else
        local D = n and n.Character

        if D then
            for E, F in ipairs(D:GetDescendants())do
                if F:IsA'BasePart' then
                    F.CanCollide = not C
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function p.ToggleAutoFarm(C)
    p.Config.AutoFarmCoins = C

    if ap then
        task.cancel(ap)

        ap = nil
    end

    CleanupFarm()

    ar = {}

    if not C then
        SetFarmNoclip(false)

        if B then
            B:Disconnect()

            B = nil
        end

        local D = n and n.Character
        local E, F = D and D:FindFirstChild'Humanoid', D and D:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

        if E then
            E.PlatformStand = false
        end
        if F then
            F.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            F.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end

        return
    end

    ap = task.spawn(function()
        while p.Config.AutoFarmCoins do
            local D, E, F, G = p.Config.AutoFarmSpeed, p.Config.AutoFarmOffset, p.Config.AutoFarmRadius, p.Config.AutoFarmDelay

            if math.random(1, 100) == 1 then
                for H in pairs(ar)do
                    if not H or not H.Parent then
                        ar[H] = nil
                    end
                end
            end
            if not ao then
                CleanupFarm()
                SetFarmNoclip(false)

                if B then
                    B:Disconnect()

                    B = nil
                end

                local H = n and n.Character
                local I = H and H:FindFirstChild'Humanoid'

                if I then
                    I.PlatformStand = false
                end

                task.wait(1)
            else
                local H = n and n.Character
                local I, J = H and H:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', H and H:FindFirstChild'Humanoid'

                if not H or not I or not J or J.Health <= 0 then
                    task.wait(0.5)
                else
                    SetFarmNoclip(true)

                    if B then
                        B:Disconnect()
                    end

                    B = d.Stepped:Connect(function()
                        local K = n and n.Character and n.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

                        if K then
                            K.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            K.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        end
                    end)
                    J.PlatformStand = true

                    local K = FindMap()
                    local L = K and (K:FindFirstChild'CoinContainer' or K:FindFirstChild'CoinAreas' or K:FindFirstChild'Coins')

                    if not L then
                        task.wait(1)
                    else
                        if not aq.MainPoint or not aq.MainPoint.Parent then
                            CleanupFarm()

                            local M = Instance.new'Attachment'

                            M.Name = 'FarmPoint'
                            M.Parent = I
                            aq.MainPoint = M

                            local N = Instance.new'AlignPosition'

                            N.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
                            N.Attachment0 = M
                            N.RigidityEnabled = true
                            N.Position = I.Position
                            N.Parent = I
                            aq.PosController = N

                            local O = Instance.new'AlignOrientation'

                            O.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
                            O.Attachment0 = M
                            O.RigidityEnabled = true
                            O.CFrame = I.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
                            O.Parent = I
                            aq.RotController = O
                        end

                        local M, N = (math.huge)
                        local O = I.Position

                        for P, Q in ipairs(L:GetChildren())do
                            local R = Q:FindFirstChild'CoinVisual' or Q

                            if R and (R:IsA'BasePart' or R:IsA'UnionOperation') and R.Transparency < 1 and not ar[R] then
                                local S = (R.Position - O).Magnitude

                                if S < F and S < M then
                                    M = S
                                    N = R
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if not N then
                            if aq.PosController then
                                aq.PosController.Position = I.Position
                            end

                            task.wait(0.5)
                        else
                            local P, Q = N.Position + Vector3.new(0, E, 0), math.max(M / math.max(D, 1), 0.1)

                            if aq.PosController then
                                as = f:Create(aq.PosController, TweenInfo.new(Q, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Position = P})

                                as:Play()

                                local R = false
                                local S, T = as.Completed:Connect(function()
                                    R = true
                                end), 0

                                while T < Q + 0.1 and not R and p.Config.AutoFarmCoins and ao and I and I.Parent and N and N.Parent and N.Transparency < 1 and not ar[N] do
                                    if aq.RotController then
                                        aq.RotController.CFrame = CFrame.new(I.Position) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
                                    end

                                    T = T + d.Heartbeat:Wait()
                                end

                                if S then
                                    S:Disconnect()
                                end
                            end
                            if p.Config.AutoFarmCoins and ao and aq.PosController and N and N.Parent then
                                local R = N.Parent:IsA'BasePart' and N.Parent or N

                                if firetouchinterest then
                                    firetouchinterest(I, R, 1)
                                    firetouchinterest(I, R, 0)
                                end

                                task.wait(G)
                            end

                            ar[N] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            task.wait()
        end

        p.ToggleAutoFarm(false)
    end)
end

do
    local C = {
        isFarming = false,
        isActivelyFlying = false,
        currentTargetCoin = nil,
        ignoredCoins = {},
        currentTween = nil,
        steppedConn = nil,
    }

    local function CandyFarm_GetTorso(D)
        if not D then
            return nil
        end

        return D:FindFirstChild'Torso' or D:FindFirstChild'LowerTorso' or D:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'
    end
    local function CandyFarm_GetCurrentCoins()
        local D, E = pcall(function()
            local D = n and n:FindFirstChild'PlayerGui'

            D = D and D:FindFirstChild'MainGUI'

            if not D then
                return 0
            end

            local E = D:FindFirstChild'Game'

            if not E then
                return 0
            end

            local F = E:FindFirstChild'CoinBags'

            if not F then
                return 0
            end

            local G = F:FindFirstChild'Container'

            if not G then
                return 0
            end

            local H = G:FindFirstChild'Coin'

            if not H then
                return 0
            end

            local I = H:FindFirstChild'CurrencyFrame'

            if not I then
                return 0
            end

            local J = I:FindFirstChild'Icon'

            if not J then
                return 0
            end

            local K = J:FindFirstChild'Coins'

            if not K then
                return 0
            end

            return K.Text
        end)

        return D and (tonumber(E) or 0) or 0
    end
    local function CandyFarm_IsRoundOver()
        local D = n and n:FindFirstChild'PlayerGui'

        if not D then
            return false
        end

        local E = D:FindFirstChild'Victory'

        if E then
            for F, G in pairs(E:GetChildren())do
                if G:IsA'GuiObject' and G.Visible then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end
    local function CandyFarm_IsBagFull()
        local D = n and n:FindFirstChild'PlayerGui'

        if not D then
            return false
        end

        local E = D:FindFirstChild'MainGUI'

        if E and E:FindFirstChild'Lobby' and E.Lobby:FindFirstChild'Dock' then
            local F = E.Lobby.Dock:FindFirstChild'CoinBags'

            if F then
                local G = F:FindFirstChild'FullBagNotification'

                if G and G.Visible then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end
    local function CandyFarm_GetNearestCoin(D)
        local E

        for F, G in pairs(a:GetDescendants())do
            if G.Name == 'CoinContainer' then
                E = G

                break
            end
        end

        if not E then
            return nil
        end

        local F, G, H = math.huge, tonumber(p.Config.CandyFarmMaxDistance) or 600

        for I, J in pairs(E:GetChildren())do
            if J.Name == 'Coin_Server' and J:IsA'BasePart' and not C.ignoredCoins[J] then
                local K = (D.Position - J.Position).Magnitude

                if K < F and K <= G then
                    F = K
                    H = J
                end
            end
        end

        return H
    end
    local function CandyFarm_ApplyFlightPhysics(D)
        if not D then
            return
        end

        local E = D:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

        if not E then
            return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
        end

        local F = E:FindFirstChild'FarmBV'

        if not F then
            F = Instance.new'BodyVelocity'
            F.Name = 'FarmBV'
            F.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            F.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            F.Parent = E
        end

        local G = E:FindFirstChild'FarmBG'

        if not G then
            G = Instance.new'BodyGyro'
            G.Name = 'FarmBG'
            G.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            G.P = 50000
            G.Parent = E

            local H, I = E.CFrame:ToOrientation()

            G.CFrame = CFrame.new(E.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, I, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
        end

        return G.CFrame.Rotation
    end
    local function CandyFarm_RemovePhysics()
        local D = n and n.Character

        if not D then
            return
        end

        local E = D:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

        if E then
            if E:FindFirstChild'FarmBV' then
                E.FarmBV:Destroy()
            end
            if E:FindFirstChild'FarmBG' then
                E.FarmBG:Destroy()
            end
            if E.Anchored then
                E.Anchored = false
            end
        end
    end
    local function CandyFarm_SetupNoclip()
        local D = n and n.Character

        if not D then
            return
        end

        local E = D:FindFirstChild'Humanoid'

        if E then
            E.PlatformStand = true
        end

        for F, G in pairs(D:GetDescendants())do
            if G:IsA'BasePart' and G.CanCollide then
                G.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    local function CandyFarm_FlyToPoint(D, E, F, G, H)
        local I, J = (G.Position - D).Magnitude, math.max(tonumber(p.Config.CandyFarmTweenSpeed) or 25, 1)
        local K, L = TweenInfo.new(I / J, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), CFrame.new(D) * H
        local M = f:Create(F, K, {CFrame = L})

        C.currentTween = M

        local N = false

        M:Play()

        local O

        O = d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not C.isFarming or not E or not E:IsDescendantOf(a) then
                M:Cancel()

                if O then
                    O:Disconnect()
                end

                return
            end

            local P = (G.Position - D).Magnitude

            if firetouchinterest then
                pcall(function()
                    firetouchinterest(G, E, 0)
                    firetouchinterest(G, E, 1)
                end)
            end
            if P <= 1.5 then
                N = true

                M:Cancel()

                if O then
                    O:Disconnect()
                end
            end
        end)

        while O and O.Connected do
            d.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end

        return N
    end
    local function CandyFarm_TweenToCoin(D)
        if not D or not D.Parent or not D:FindFirstChild'TouchInterest' then
            return false
        end

        local E = n and n.Character

        if not E then
            return false
        end

        local F, G = E:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', E:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

        if not F or not G then
            return false
        end

        local H = D.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

        if (F.Position - H).Magnitude < 5 then
            return true
        end
        if C.currentTween then
            pcall(function()
                C.currentTween:Cancel()
            end)
        end

        local I = math.max(tonumber(p.Config.CandyFarmTweenSpeed) or 25, 1)

        C.currentTween = f:Create(F, TweenInfo.new((F.Position - H).Magnitude / I, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(H),
        })
        G.Sit = true

        C.currentTween:Play()

        local J, K = false

        K = C.currentTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            J = true

            if K then
                K:Disconnect()
            end
        end)

        local L = tick()

        while not J and C.isFarming do
            task.wait(0.1)

            if not D or not D.Parent or not D:FindFirstChild'TouchInterest' then
                if C.currentTween then
                    pcall(function()
                        C.currentTween:Cancel()
                    end)
                end

                G.Sit = false

                return false
            end
            if tick() - L > 30 then
                if C.currentTween then
                    pcall(function()
                        C.currentTween:Cancel()
                    end)
                end

                G.Sit = false

                return false
            end
        end

        G.Sit = false

        return J
    end
    local function CandyFarm_CollectCoin(D)
        if not D or not D.Parent then
            return
        end

        local E = n and n.Character and n.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

        if not E then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            firetouchinterest(E, D, 0)
            task.wait(0.05)
            firetouchinterest(E, D, 1)
        end)
    end

    function p.StopCandyFarm()
        C.isFarming = false
        C.isActivelyFlying = false
        C.currentTargetCoin = nil
        p.Config.CandyFarmEnabled = false

        if C.currentTween then
            pcall(function()
                C.currentTween:Cancel()
            end)

            C.currentTween = nil
        end
        if C.steppedConn then
            DisconnectConnection(C.steppedConn)

            C.steppedConn = nil
        end

        CandyFarm_RemovePhysics()

        local D = n and n.Character

        if D then
            local E = D:FindFirstChild'Humanoid'

            if E then
                E.PlatformStand = false
                E.Sit = false
            end
        end
    end
    function p.StartCandyFarm()
        if C.isFarming then
            return
        end
        if p.Config.AutoFarmCoins then
            pcall(function()
                p.ToggleAutoFarm(false)
            end)
        end

        C.isFarming = true
        p.Config.CandyFarmEnabled = true

        table.clear(C.ignoredCoins)

        if not C.steppedConn then
            C.steppedConn = TrackConnection(d.Stepped:Connect(function()
                if not C.isFarming or not C.isActivelyFlying then
                    return
                end
                if (p.Config.CandyFarmMode or 'Underground') ~= 'Underground' then
                    return
                end

                local D = n and n.Character

                if not D then
                    return
                end

                local E = D:FindFirstChild'Humanoid'

                if E then
                    E.PlatformStand = true
                end

                for F, G in pairs(D:GetDescendants())do
                    if G:IsA'BasePart' and G.CanCollide then
                        G.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end))
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            while C.isFarming do
                task.wait()

                local D = pcall(function()
                    local D = n and n.Character

                    if not D then
                        return
                    end

                    local E, F, G = D:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', CandyFarm_GetTorso(D), D:FindFirstChild'Humanoid'

                    if not E or not F or not G or G.Health <= 0 then
                        C.isActivelyFlying = false
                        C.currentTargetCoin = nil

                        CandyFarm_RemovePhysics()
                        task.wait(1)

                        return
                    end
                    if CandyFarm_IsRoundOver() or CandyFarm_IsBagFull() then
                        C.isActivelyFlying = false
                        C.currentTargetCoin = nil

                        CandyFarm_RemovePhysics()

                        if G then
                            G.Sit = false
                        end

                        task.wait(1)

                        return
                    end
                    if p.Config.CandyFarmAutoReset then
                        local H, I = CandyFarm_GetCurrentCoins(), tonumber(p.Config.CandyFarmCoinLimit) or 40

                        if H >= I then
                            G.Health = 0

                            task.wait(5)

                            return
                        end
                    end

                    local H = CandyFarm_GetNearestCoin(F)

                    if not H or not H:IsDescendantOf(a) then
                        C.isActivelyFlying = false
                        C.currentTargetCoin = nil

                        CandyFarm_RemovePhysics()

                        if G then
                            G.Sit = false
                        end

                        task.wait(0.5)

                        return
                    end

                    C.isActivelyFlying = true
                    C.currentTargetCoin = H

                    local I, J = false, p.Config.CandyFarmMode or 'Underground'

                    if J == 'Underground' then
                        CandyFarm_SetupNoclip()

                        local K, L = CandyFarm_ApplyFlightPhysics(D), tonumber(p.Config.CandyFarmUndergroundOffset) or 4
                        local M = H.Position - Vector3.new(0, L, 0)

                        I = CandyFarm_FlyToPoint(M, H, E, F, K)
                    elseif J == 'Sit' then
                        I = CandyFarm_TweenToCoin(H)

                        if I and C.isFarming and G.Health > 0 then
                            CandyFarm_CollectCoin(H)
                        end
                    end
                    if I and C.isFarming and G.Health > 0 then
                        C.ignoredCoins[H] = true

                        task.delay(5, function()
                            C.ignoredCoins[H] = nil
                        end)
                        task.wait(0.2)
                    end

                    C.currentTargetCoin = nil
                end)

                if not D then
                    C.isActivelyFlying = false
                    C.currentTargetCoin = nil

                    CandyFarm_RemovePhysics()
                    task.wait(1)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    function p.ToggleCandyFarm(D)
        if D then
            p.StartCandyFarm()
        else
            p.StopCandyFarm()
        end
    end
end

local C, D = false

function p.ToggleGunDropNotification(E)
    p.Config.NotifyGunDropped = E and true or false

    if D then
        pcall(function()
            if type(D.Disconnect) == 'function' then
                D:Disconnect()
            elseif typeof(D) == 'RBXScriptConnection' then
                D:Disconnect()
            end
        end)

        D = nil
    end
    if not p.Config.NotifyGunDropped then
        C = false

        return
    end

    C = false

    local F = true
    local G = task.spawn(function()
        while F and p.Config.NotifyGunDropped do
            local G = FindGunDrop()
            local H = G ~= nil and G.Parent ~= nil

            if H and not C then
                C = true

                pcall(function()
                    if aK and aK.new then
                        aK.new{
                            Title = 'Gun Dropped!',
                            Content = 'The Sheriff has died. The gun is now available!',
                            Duration = 5,
                            Force = true,
                        }
                    elseif getgenv().Library and getgenv().Library.Notify then
                        getgenv().Library:Notify{
                            Title = 'Gun Dropped!',
                            Description = 'The Sheriff has died. The gun is now available!',
                            Time = 5,
                            Force = true,
                        }
                    end
                end)
            elseif not H then
                C = false
            end

            task.wait(0.35)
        end
    end)

    D = {
        Disconnect = function()
            F = false

            pcall(task.cancel, G)
        end,
    }
end

getgenv().candyware_Cleanup = function()
    for E, F in ipairs(getgenv().candyware_Connections)do
        if typeof(F) == 'RBXScriptConnection' and F.Connected then
            pcall(function()
                F:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
    end

    table.clear(getgenv().candyware_Connections)

    if getgenv().ClearESP then
        getgenv().ClearESP()
    end

    pcall(function() end)

    if getgenv().HitsoundData then
        getgenv().HitsoundData.enabled = false
        getgenv().HitsoundData = nil
    end
end

    local function Hitsound_SafeName(F)
        F = tostring(F or 'sound'):lower()
        F = F:gsub('[^%w%-%._ ]', '')
        F = F:gsub('%s+', '_')

        if F == '' then
            F = 'sound'
        end

        return F
    end

    local F = {}

    local function Hitsound_EnsureFolder()
        pcall(function()
            if makefolder then
                makefolder'candycfg'
                makefolder'candycfg/sounds'
                makefolder'candycfg/cfg'
            end
        end)
    end
    local function Hitsound_HttpGet(G)
        local H

        pcall(function()
            H = game:HttpGet(G)
        end)

        if type(H) == 'string' and #H > 0 then
            return H
        end

        pcall(function()
            if request then
                local I = request{
                    Url = G,
                    Method = 'GET',
                }

                if I and (I.StatusCode == 200 or I.StatusCode == 0) and type(I.Body) == 'string' then
                    H = I.Body
                end
            end
        end)

        if type(H) == 'string' and #H > 0 then
            return H
        end

        pcall(function()
            if http_request then
                local I = http_request{
                    Url = G,
                    Method = 'GET',
                }

                if I and type(I.Body) == 'string' and #I.Body > 0 then
                    H = I.Body
                end
            end
        end)

        if type(H) == 'string' and #H > 0 then
            return H
        end

        pcall(function()
            if syn and syn.request then
                local I = syn.request{
                    Url = G,
                    Method = 'GET',
                }

                if I and type(I.Body) == 'string' and #I.Body > 0 then
                    H = I.Body
                end
            end
        end)

        return H
    end
    local function Hitsound_ResolveId(G, H)
        if type(H) ~= 'string' or H == '' then
            return H
        end
        if F[H] then
            return F[H]
        end
        if H:sub(1, 11) == 'rbxassetid:' or H:sub(1, 13) == 'rbxasset://' or H:sub(1, 11) == 'rbxthumb://' then
            F[H] = H

            return H
        end
        if H:sub(1, 4) ~= 'http' then
            F[H] = H

            return H
        end

        Hitsound_EnsureFolder()

        local I = Hitsound_SafeName(G)
        local J, K = 'candycfg/sounds/' .. I .. '.ogg', true

        pcall(function()
            if isfile and isfile(J) then
                K = false
            end
        end)

        if K then
            local L = Hitsound_HttpGet(H)

            if type(L) == 'string' and #L > 64 then
                pcall(function()
                    if writefile then
                        writefile(J, L)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        local L = H

        pcall(function()
            if getcustomasset and isfile and isfile(J) then
                L = getcustomasset(J)
            end
        end)

        F[H] = L

        return L
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        for G, H in pairs(E.gunshotSounds)do
            if type(H) == 'string' and H:sub(1, 4) == 'http' then
                pcall(Hitsound_ResolveId, G, H)
            end
        end
        for G, H in pairs(E.knifeKillSounds)do
            if type(H) == 'string' and H:sub(1, 4) == 'http' then
                pcall(Hitsound_ResolveId, G, H)
            end
        end
    end)

    local function hookSound(G)
        if not G:IsA'Sound' or E.hooked[G] then
            return
        end

        E.hooked[G] = true

        G.Played:Connect(function()
            if not E.enabled then
                return
            end
            if G.Name == 'Gunshot' and E.gunshotSounds[E.selectedGunshot] then
                local H = E.gunshotSounds[E.selectedGunshot]
                local I = Hitsound_ResolveId(E.selectedGunshot, H)

                if G.SoundId ~= I then
                    G.SoundId = I
                    G.TimePosition = 0

                    G:Play()
                end
            elseif G.Name == 'Kill' and E.knifeKillSounds[E.selectedKnifeKill] then
                local H = E.knifeKillSounds[E.selectedKnifeKill]
                local I = Hitsound_ResolveId(E.selectedKnifeKill, H)

                if G.SoundId ~= I then
                    G.SoundId = I
                    G.TimePosition = 0

                    G:Play()
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(G)
        if G:IsA'Sound' and (G.Name == 'Gunshot' or G.Name == 'Kill') then
            hookSound(G)
        end
    end)
    task.defer(function()
        local G = workspace:GetDescendants()
        local H, I = #G, 1

        while I <= H do
            local J = math.min(I + 200, H)

            for K = I, J do
                local L = G[K]

                if L and L:IsA'Sound' and (L.Name == 'Gunshot' or L.Name == 'Kill') then
                    hookSound(L)
                end
            end

            I = J + 1

            if I <= H then
                task.wait()
            end
        end
    end)

    E.ResolveId = Hitsound_ResolveId
    getgenv().HitsoundData = E
end

local E, F, G, H, I, J = game:GetService'Players', game:GetService'Workspace', game:GetService'RunService', game:GetService'UserInputService', game:GetService'CoreGui', game:GetService'ReplicatedStorage'
