local function __candyware_InitFling()
    local M = {
        isFlinging = false,
        flingTarget = nil,
        flingOldPos = nil,
        trueOriginalPos = nil,
        flingOldCameraSubject = nil,
        flingConnection = nil,
        flingVelConn = nil,
        flingAngle = 0,
        flingHighVelCount = 0,
        flingOriginalFallenHeight = nil,
        flingQueue = {},
        flingQueueIndex = 1,
        isFlingingAll = false,
        flingSuccess = false,
        currentMurderer = nil,
        currentSheriff = nil,
        allPlayersCache = {},
        flingDropdown = nil,
        flingStatusLabel = nil,
        floatingButtons = {},
    }

    local function isDead(N)
        if not N then
            return true
        end

        local O = N.Character

        if not O then
            return true
        end

        local P = O:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

        if not P or P.Health <= 0 then
            return true
        end

        return false
    end
    local function cachePlayerList()
        M.allPlayersCache = {}

        for N, O in ipairs(E:GetPlayers())do
            table.insert(M.allPlayersCache, O)
        end
    end
    local function findMurderer()
        if p.PlayerData then
            for N, O in pairs(p.PlayerData)do
                if typeof(O) == 'table' and O.Role == 'Murderer' then
                    local P = E:FindFirstChild(N)

                    if P and P ~= K and not isDead(P) and P.Character then
                        return P
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for N, O in ipairs(E:GetPlayers())do
            if O ~= K then
                local P, Q = O:FindFirstChild'Backpack', O.Character

                if (P and P:FindFirstChild'Knife') or (Q and Q:FindFirstChild'Knife') then
                    if not isDead(O) then
                        return O
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if M.currentMurderer and not isDead(M.currentMurderer) then
            return M.currentMurderer
        end

        return nil
    end
    local function findSheriffHero()
        if p.PlayerData then
            for N, O in pairs(p.PlayerData)do
                if typeof(O) == 'table' and (O.Role == 'Sheriff' or O.Role == 'Hero') then
                    local P = E:FindFirstChild(N)

                    if P and P ~= K and not isDead(P) and P.Character then
                        return P
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for N, O in ipairs(E:GetPlayers())do
            if O ~= K then
                local P, Q = O:FindFirstChild'Backpack', O.Character

                if (P and P:FindFirstChild'Gun') or (Q and Q:FindFirstChild'Gun') then
                    if not isDead(O) then
                        return O
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if M.currentSheriff and not isDead(M.currentSheriff) then
            return M.currentSheriff
        end

        return nil
    end
    local function updateCachedRoles()
        M.currentMurderer = findMurderer()
        M.currentSheriff = findSheriffHero()
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            local N = J:WaitForChild('Remotes', 5)
            local O = N and N:WaitForChild('Gameplay', 5)
            local P = O and O:WaitForChild('PlayerDataChanged', 5)

            if P then
                P.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Q)
                    if typeof(Q) ~= 'table' then
                        return
                    end

                    for R, S in pairs(Q)do
                        if typeof(S) == 'table' and S.Role then
                            local T = E:FindFirstChild(R)

                            if T then
                                if S.Role == 'Murderer' then
                                    M.currentMurderer = T
                                elseif S.Role == 'Sheriff' or S.Role == 'Hero' then
                                    M.currentSheriff = T
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end)

    local function setStatus(N)
        if M.flingStatusLabel then
            pcall(function()
                if M.flingStatusLabel.SetText then
                    M.flingStatusLabel:SetText(N)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    function cleanupFling()
        local N, O = M.isFlinging, M.trueOriginalPos or M.flingOldPos

        if M.flingVelConn then
            M.flingVelConn:Disconnect()

            M.flingVelConn = nil
        end
        if M.flingConnection then
            M.flingConnection:Disconnect()

            M.flingConnection = nil
        end

        M.isFlinging = false
        M.flingTarget = nil
        M.flingAngle = 0
        M.flingHighVelCount = 0

        if M.flingOriginalFallenHeight ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                F.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = M.flingOriginalFallenHeight
            end)

            M.flingOriginalFallenHeight = nil
        end
        if M.flingOldCameraSubject then
            pcall(function()
                L.CameraSubject = M.flingOldCameraSubject
            end)

            M.flingOldCameraSubject = nil
        else
            local P = K.Character
            local Q = P and P:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

            if Q then
                pcall(function()
                    L.CameraSubject = Q
                end)
            end
        end

        local P = K.Character

        if P then
            local Q, R = P:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', P:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

            if Q then
                for S, T in pairs(Q:GetChildren())do
                    if T:IsA'BodyVelocity' or T:IsA'BodyGyro' or T:IsA'LinearVelocity' or T:IsA'AngularVelocity' or T.Name == '_xVibFling_2026_Safe' or T.Name == '_xVibFling_2026_Gyro' then
                        pcall(function()
                            T:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                end

                Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                Q.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
            if R then
                pcall(function()
                    R:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
                    R:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                end)
            end
            if O and Q then
                pcall(function()
                    Q.CFrame = O * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)

                    if P.PrimaryPart then
                        P:PivotTo(O * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0))
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        M.flingOldPos = nil
        M.trueOriginalPos = nil

        if N and M.isFlingingAll and M.flingQueue and M.flingQueueIndex <= #M.flingQueue then
            local Q = M.flingQueue[M.flingQueueIndex]

            M.flingQueueIndex = M.flingQueueIndex + 1

            if Q then
                setStatus'Fling Status: Next target...'
                task.delay(0.35, function()
                    startVibrationFling(Q)
                end)

                return
            end
        end
        if N then
            M.flingQueue = {}
            M.flingQueueIndex = 1
            M.isFlingingAll = false
        end

        setStatus'Fling Status: Idle'
    end

    local function SkidFling(N)
        local O = K
        local P = O.Character
        local Q = P and P:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'
        local R, S = Q and Q.RootPart, N and N.Character

        if not S then
            setStatus'Fling Status: No valid character'

            return
        end

        local T = S:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'
        local U, V, W = T and T.RootPart, S:FindFirstChild'Head', S:FindFirstChildOfClass'Accessory'
        local X = W and W:FindFirstChild'Handle'

        if not (P and Q and R) then
            setStatus'Fling Status: No local character'

            return
        end
        if R.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
            getgenv().OldPos = R.CFrame
        end
        if V and V.Velocity.Magnitude > 500 then
        elseif not V and X and X.Velocity.Magnitude > 500 then
        end
        if V then
            F.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = V
        elseif X then
            F.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = X
        elseif T and U then
            F.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = T
        end
        if not S:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'BasePart' then
            return
        end

        getgenv().FPDH = F.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

        local function FPos(Y, Z, _)
            R.CFrame = CFrame.new(Y.Position) * Z * _

            pcall(function()
                P:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(Y.Position) * Z * _)
            end)

            R.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9E8, 9e7)
            R.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
        end
        local function SFBasePart(Y)
            local Z, _, at = 2, tick(), 0

            repeat
                if R and T then
                    if Y.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
                        at = at + 100

                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + T.MoveDirection * Y.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(at), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + T.MoveDirection * Y.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(at), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25) + T.MoveDirection * Y.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(at), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25) + T.MoveDirection * Y.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(at), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + T.MoveDirection * Y.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(at), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + T.MoveDirection * Y.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(at), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                    else
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, T.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -T.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, T.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        local au = (U and U.Velocity.Magnitude or 0) / 1.25

                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, au), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -au), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, au), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        FPos(Y, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                    end
                else
                    break
                end
            until Y.Velocity.Magnitude > 500 or Y.Parent ~= N.Character or N.Parent ~= E or N.Character ~= S or T.Sit or Q.Health <= 0 or tick() > _ + Z
        end

        F.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0 / 0

        local at = Instance.new'BodyVelocity'

        at.Name = 'EpixVel'
        at.Parent = R
        at.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
        at.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1 / 0, 1 / 0, 1 / 0)

        Q:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)

        M.isFlinging = true
        M.flingTarget = N

        setStatus('Fling Status: Flinging ' .. N.Name)

        if U and V then
            if (U.CFrame.p - V.CFrame.p).Magnitude > 5 then
                SFBasePart(V)
            else
                SFBasePart(U)
            end
        elseif U and not V then
            SFBasePart(U)
        elseif not U and V then
            SFBasePart(V)
        elseif not U and not V and W and X then
            SFBasePart(X)
        else
            setStatus"Fling Status: Can't find target part"
        end

        at:Destroy()
        Q:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)

        F.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Q

        if getgenv().OldPos then
            repeat
                R.CFrame = getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)

                pcall(function()
                    P:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0))
                end)
                Q:ChangeState'GettingUp'

                for au, Y in ipairs(P:GetChildren())do
                    if Y:IsA'BasePart' then
                        Y.Velocity = Vector3.new()
                        Y.RotVelocity = Vector3.new()
                    end
                end

                task.wait()
            until (R.Position - getgenv().OldPos.p).Magnitude < 25
        end
        if getgenv().FPDH ~= nil then
            F.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = getgenv().FPDH
        end

        M.isFlinging = false
        M.flingTarget = nil

        setStatus'Fling Status: Idle'
    end

    function startVibrationFling(at)
        task.spawn(function()
            SkidFling(at)
        end)
    end
    function flingMurderer()
        if M.isFlinging then
            return
        end

        updateCachedRoles()

        local at = M.currentMurderer or findMurderer()

        if at and at ~= K and not isDead(at) and at.Character then
            M.flingQueue = {}
            M.flingQueueIndex = 1
            M.isFlingingAll = false

            task.spawn(function()
                SkidFling(at)
            end)

            return
        end

        setStatus'Fling Status: No Murderer found'
    end
    function flingSheriffHero()
        if M.isFlinging then
            return
        end

        updateCachedRoles()

        local at = M.currentSheriff or findSheriffHero()

        if at and at ~= K and not isDead(at) and at.Character then
            M.flingQueue = {}
            M.flingQueueIndex = 1
            M.isFlingingAll = false

            task.spawn(function()
                SkidFling(at)
            end)

            return
        end

        setStatus'Fling Status: No Sheriff/Hero found'
    end
    function flingSelected()
        if M.isFlinging then
            cleanupFling()

            return
        end
        if not M.flingDropdown then
            setStatus'Fling Status: No player selected'

            return
        end

        local at = M.flingDropdown.Value

        if type(at) == 'table' then
            at = at[1]
        end
        if type(at) ~= 'string' or at == '' then
            setStatus'Fling Status: No player selected'

            return
        end

        local au = E:FindFirstChild(at)

        if au and au ~= K and not isDead(au) and au.Character then
            M.flingQueue = {}
            M.flingQueueIndex = 1
            M.isFlingingAll = false

            startVibrationFling(au)

            return
        end

        setStatus'Fling Status: Invalid target'
    end
    function getFlingTargetNames()
        local at = {}

        cachePlayerList()

        for au, N in ipairs(M.allPlayersCache)do
            if N ~= K and N.Character and N.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' then
                table.insert(at, N.Name)
            end
        end

        return at
    end
    function updateFlingDropdown()
        if not M.flingDropdown then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            M.flingDropdown:SetValues(getFlingTargetNames())
        end)
    end

    local function makeFloatingButton(at, au, N, O)
        local P, Q = (gethui and gethui()) or I, Instance.new'ScreenGui'

        Q.Name = 'FlingFloat_' .. at
        Q.ResetOnSpawn = false
        Q.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        Q.DisplayOrder = 60
        Q.Parent = P

        local R = Instance.new'TextButton'

        R.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 88)
        R.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.5, 0)
        R.BackgroundColor3 = N
        R.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        R.Text = au
        R.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        R.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        R.TextSize = 13
        R.TextWrapped = true
        R.Parent = Q
        Instance.new('UICorner', R).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

        local S, T, U = false

        R.InputBegan:Connect(function(V)
            if V.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or V.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                S = true
                T = V.Position
                U = R.Position

                local W, X = false

                X = V.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if V.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        S = false

                        if X then
                            X:Disconnect()
                        end
                        if not W then
                            O()
                        end
                    end
                end)

                local Y

                Y = H.InputChanged:Connect(function(Z)
                    if not S then
                        if Y then
                            Y:Disconnect()
                        end

                        return
                    end
                    if Z.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Z.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        local _ = Z.Position - T

                        if math.abs(_.X) > 4 or math.abs(_.Y) > 4 then
                            W = true
                        end

                        R.Position = UDim2.new(U.X.Scale, U.X.Offset + _.X, U.Y.Scale, U.Y.Offset + _.Y)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        M.floatingButtons[at] = Q

        return Q
    end
    local function toggleFloating(at, au, N, O, P)
        if M.floatingButtons[at] then
            pcall(function()
                M.floatingButtons[at]:Destroy()
            end)

            M.floatingButtons[at] = nil
        end
        if au then
            makeFloatingButton(at, N, O, P)
        end
    end

    E.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        updateFlingDropdown()
    end)
    E.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.2)
        updateFlingDropdown()
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(3) do
            updateFlingDropdown()
        end
    end)
    K.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if M.isFlinging then
            cleanupFling()
        end
    end)

    p.FlingFns = p.FlingFns or {}

    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.State = M
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.flingMurderer = flingMurderer
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.flingSheriffHero = flingSheriffHero
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.flingSelected = flingSelected
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.cleanupFling = cleanupFling
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.getFlingTargetNames = getFlingTargetNames
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.updateFlingDropdown = updateFlingDropdown
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.toggleFloating = toggleFloating
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.startVibrationFling = startVibrationFling
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.SkidFling = SkidFling
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.setStatus = setStatus
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.isDead = isDead
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.cachePlayerList = cachePlayerList
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.findMurderer = findMurderer
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.findSheriffHero = findSheriffHero
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.updateCachedRoles = updateCachedRoles
    end)
    pcall(function()
        p.FlingFns.makeFloatingButton = makeFloatingButton
    end)
end

local function __candyware_InitCharVisuals()
    local ax, ay, az, aA, aB, aC, aD, aE, aF, aG, aH, aI = {
        enabled = false,
        style = 'Classic',
        transparency = 0.3,
        rainbow = false,
        rainbowSpeed = 5,
        color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
        radius = 2.4,
        height = 1.6,
        reflectance = 0,
        sides = 25,
        parts = {},
        connection = nil,
    }, math.pi * 2, {
        enabled = false,
        isGradient = false,
        lifetime = 0.5,
        transparencyStart = 0,
        rainbow = false,
        colorStatic = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
        gradient1 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 86, 255),
        gradient2 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
        parts = {},
        connection = nil,
    }, {
        enabled = false,
        color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
        lifetime = 0.5,
    }, {
        screenEnabled = false,
        screenIntensity = 0,
        screenConnection = nil,
        timeEnabled = false,
        timeValue = 12,
        fullBrightEnabled = false,
    }, {
        enabled = false,
        themeColor = Color3.fromRGB(173, 216, 230),
    }, {
        current = 'Roblox Default',
        customEnabled = false,
    }, {
        enabled = false,
        gui = nil,
    }, {
        fpsPing1Enabled = false,
        fpsPing2Enabled = false,
    }, K, L
    local aJ, aK, aL, aM = 0.02, 48, math.pi * 2, 220
    local aN = {
        rows = {},
        px = table.create(aK + 1),
        py = table.create(aK + 1),
        cos = table.create(aK),
        sin = table.create(aK),
        ord = table.create(aK + 1),
        stack = table.create(aK + 2),
        shown = {},
        cpos = {},
        csize = {},
        ccol = {},
        white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        black = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
        eps = 0.75,
        lastRadius = nil,
        lastAlpha = nil,
    }

    local function ch_rebuildRing()
        local aO = tonumber(ax.radius) or 1.55

        if aO <= 0 then
            aO = 1.55
        end

        for aP = 1, aK do
            local aQ = (aP - 1) / aK * aL

            aN.cos[aP] = math.cos(aQ) * aO
            aN.sin[aP] = math.sin(aQ) * aO
        end

        aN.lastRadius = aO
        aN.head, aN.pos, aN.cf = nil, nil, nil
        aN.fov, aN.vx, aN.vy, aN.col = nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    ch_rebuildRing()

    aN.order = function(aO, aP)
        local aQ, aR = aN.px, aN.py
        local aS, aT = aQ[aO], aQ[aP]

        return aS == aT and aR[aO] < aR[aP] or aS < aT
    end
    aN.hull = function(aO)
        local aP, aQ, aR, aS = aN.px, aN.py, aN.ord, aN.stack

        for aT = 1, aO do
            aR[aT] = aT
        end

        table.sort(aR, aN.order)

        local aT = 0

        for aU = 1, aO do
            local aV = aR[aU]
            local aW, aX = aP[aV], aQ[aV]

            while aT >= 2 do
                local aY, aZ = aS[aT - 1], aS[aT]
                local a_, a0 = aP[aY], aQ[aY]

                if (aP[aZ] - a_) * (aX - a0) - (aQ[aZ] - a0) * (aW - a_) > 0 then
                    break
                end

                aT = aT - 1
            end

            aT = aT + 1
            aS[aT] = aV
        end

        local aU = aT

        for aV = aO - 1, 1, -1 do
            local aW = aR[aV]
            local aX, aY = aP[aW], aQ[aW]

            while aT > aU do
                local aZ, a_ = aS[aT - 1], aS[aT]
                local a0, a1 = aP[aZ], aQ[aZ]

                if (aP[a_] - a0) * (aY - a1) - (aQ[a_] - a1) * (aX - a0) > 0 then
                    break
                end

                aT = aT - 1
            end

            aT = aT + 1
            aS[aT] = aW
        end

        return aT - 1
    end
    aN.visible = function(aO)
        local aP, aQ = aN.rows, aN.shown

        for aR = 1, #aP do
            if aQ[aR] ~= aO then
                aP[aR].Visible = aO
                aQ[aR] = aO
            end
        end
    end
    aN.clear = function()
        local aO = aN.rows

        for aP = 1, #aO do
            pcall(function()
                aO[aP]:Remove()
            end)
        end

        table.clear(aO)
        table.clear(aN.shown)
        table.clear(aN.cpos)
        table.clear(aN.csize)
        table.clear(aN.ccol)

        aN.head, aN.pos, aN.cf = nil, nil, nil
        aN.fov, aN.vx, aN.vy, aN.col = nil, nil, nil, nil
        aN.lastAlpha = nil
    end
    aN.build = function()
        aN.clear()
        ch_rebuildRing()
    end
    aN.row = function(aO)
        local aP = aN.rows
        local aQ = aP[aO]

        if aQ then
            return aQ
        end

        aQ = Drawing.new'Square'
        aQ.Filled = true
        aQ.Thickness = 0

        local aR = 1 - (tonumber(ax.transparency) or 0.3)

        if aR < 0 then
            aR = 0
        elseif aR > 1 then
            aR = 1
        end

        aQ.Transparency = aR
        aQ.Visible = false
        aQ.ZIndex = 1
        aP[aO] = aQ
        aN.shown[aO] = false

        return aQ
    end

    local function ch_applyAlpha()
        local aO = 1 - (tonumber(ax.transparency) or 0.3)

        if aO < 0 then
            aO = 0
        elseif aO > 1 then
            aO = 1
        end
        if aN.lastAlpha == aO then
            return
        end

        aN.lastAlpha = aO

        local aP = aN.rows

        for aQ = 1, #aP do
            aP[aQ].Transparency = aO
        end
    end

    aN.update = function(aO)
        local aP = aG and aG.Character
        local aQ = aP and aP:FindFirstChild'Head'

        if not aQ or not aQ:IsA'BasePart' or not aO then
            aN.visible(false)

            return
        end

        local aR = tonumber(ax.radius) or 1.55

        if aR <= 0 then
            aR = 1.55
        end
        if aN.lastRadius ~= aR then
            ch_rebuildRing()
        end

        local aS = tonumber(ax.height) or 0.82

        if aS <= 0 then
            aS = 0.82
        end

        ch_applyAlpha()

        local aT, aU, aV, aW = aQ.Position, aO.CFrame, aO.FieldOfView, aO.ViewportSize
        local aX, aY, aZ = aW.X, aW.Y, nil

        if ax.rainbow then
            local a_ = tonumber(ax.rainbowSpeed) or 5

            if a_ <= 0 then
                a_ = 5
            end

            aZ = Color3.fromHSV((tick() % a_) / a_, 1, 1)
        else
            aZ = ax.color

            if typeof(aZ) ~= 'Color3' then
                aZ = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
            end
        end
        if not ax.rainbow and aN.head == aQ and aN.pos == aT and aN.cf == aU and aN.fov == aV and aN.vx == aX and aN.vy == aY and aN.col == aZ and aN.lastHeight == aS then
            return
        end

        aN.head, aN.pos, aN.cf = aQ, aT, aU
        aN.fov, aN.vx, aN.vy, aN.col = aV, aX, aY, aZ
        aN.lastHeight = aS

        local a_, a0, a1, a2, a3 = aN.px, aN.py, aN.cos, aN.sin, aT.Y + aQ.Size.Y * 0.5 - aJ
        local a4 = Vector3.new(aT.X, a3, aT.Z)
        local a5 = aO:WorldToViewportPoint(a4 + Vector3.new(0, aS, 0))

        if a5.Z <= 0 then
            aN.visible(false)

            return
        end

        local a6 = aO:WorldToViewportPoint(a4 + Vector3.new(a1[1], 0, a2[1]))

        if a6.Z <= 0 then
            aN.visible(false)

            return
        end

        a_[1], a0[1] = a5.X, a5.Y
        a_[2], a0[2] = a6.X, a6.Y

        local a7, a8, a9, ba = aU.Position, aU.RightVector, aU.UpVector, aU.LookVector
        local bb, bc, bd = a4.X - a7.X, a4.Y - a7.Y, a4.Z - a7.Z
        local be, bf, bg, bh, bi, bj, bk, bl, bm, bn, bo, bp, bq, br = bb * a8.X + bc * a8.Y + bd * a8.Z, bb * a9.X + bc * a9.Y + bd * a9.Z, bb * ba.X + bc * ba.Y + bd * ba.Z, a8.X, a8.Z, a9.X, a9.Z, ba.X, ba.Z, aY * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(aV * 0.5)), aX * 0.5, aY * 0.5, aN.eps, false
        local bs = bg + aS * ba.Y

        if bs > 0 then
            local bt = bn / bs

            if math.abs(bo + (be + aS * a8.Y) * bt - a5.X) <= bq and math.abs(bp - (bf + aS * a9.Y) * bt - a5.Y) <= bq then
                local bu, bv = a1[1], a2[1]

                bs = bg + bu * bl + bv * bm

                if bs > 0 then
                    bt = bn / bs

                    if math.abs(bo + (be + bu * bh + bv * bi) * bt - a6.X) <= bq and math.abs(bp - (bf + bu * bj + bv * bk) * bt - a6.Y) <= bq then
                        br = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if br then
            for bt = 2, aK do
                local bu, bv = a1[bt], a2[bt]
                local bw = bg + bu * bl + bv * bm

                if bw <= 0 then
                    aN.visible(false)

                    return
                end

                local bx = bn / bw

                a_[bt + 1] = bo + (be + bu * bh + bv * bi) * bx
                a0[bt + 1] = bp - (bf + bu * bj + bv * bk) * bx
            end
        else
            for bt = 2, aK do
                local bu = aO:WorldToViewportPoint(a4 + Vector3.new(a1[bt], 0, a2[bt]))

                if bu.Z <= 0 then
                    aN.visible(false)

                    return
                end

                a_[bt + 1] = bu.X
                a0[bt + 1] = bu.Y
            end
        end

        local bt = aN.hull(aK + 1)

        if bt < 3 then
            aN.visible(false)

            return
        end

        local bu, bv, bw = aN.stack, math.huge, -math.huge

        for bx = 1, bt do
            local by = a0[bu[bx] ]

            if by < bv then
                bv = by
            end
            if by > bw then
                bw = by
            end
        end

        local bx, by = math.max(0, math.floor(bv)), math.min(aY, math.ceil(bw))

        if by - bx < 2 then
            aN.visible(false)

            return
        end

        local bz, bA, bB, bC, bD, bE, bF, bG, bH, bI = math.max(1, math.ceil((by - bx) / aM)), math.max(1, bw - bv), aN.rows, aN.shown, aN.cpos, aN.csize, aN.ccol, aN.white, aN.black, 0

        for bJ = bx, by - 1, bz do
            local bK = math.min(bz, by - bJ)
            local bL, bM, bN, bO, bP = bJ + bK * 0.5, math.huge, -math.huge, a_[bu[bt] ], a0[bu[bt] ]

            for bQ = 1, bt do
                local bR = bu[bQ]
                local bS, bT = a_[bR], a0[bR]

                if (bP <= bL and bT > bL) or (bT <= bL and bP > bL) then
                    local bU = bO + (bL - bP) * (bS - bO) / (bT - bP)

                    if bU < bM then
                        bM = bU
                    end
                    if bU > bN then
                        bN = bU
                    end
                end

                bO, bP = bS, bT
            end

            local bQ = bN - bM

            if bQ >= 2.5 then
                bI = bI + 1

                local bR, bS = aN.row(bI), (bL - bv) / bA
                local bT, bU = 1 - bS * 1.35, (bS - 0.58) / 0.42

                if bT < 0 then
                    bT = 0
                end
                if bU < 0 then
                    bU = 0
                end

                local bV, bW, bX = aZ:Lerp(bG, bT * 0.26):Lerp(bH, bU * 0.1), Vector2.new(bM, bJ), Vector2.new(bQ, bK)

                if bD[bI] ~= bW then
                    bR.Position = bW
                    bD[bI] = bW
                end
                if bE[bI] ~= bX then
                    bR.Size = bX
                    bE[bI] = bX
                end
                if bF[bI] ~= bV then
                    bR.Color = bV
                    bF[bI] = bV
                end
                if not bC[bI] then
                    bR.Visible = true
                    bC[bI] = true
                end
            end
        end
        for bJ = bI + 1, #bB do
            if bC[bJ] then
                bB[bJ].Visible = false
                bC[bJ] = false
            end
        end
    end

    local function Hat_RemoveClassic()
        aN.clear()

        if aG and aG.Character and ax.parts[aG.Character] then
            pcall(function()
                ax.parts[aG.Character]:Destroy()
            end)

            ax.parts[aG.Character] = nil
        end
    end
    local function Hat_AddClassic(aO) end
    local function Hat_ToggleEnabled(aO)
        ax.enabled = aO and true or false

        if ax.enabled then
            aN.build()

            if ax.connection then
                pcall(function()
                    ax.connection:Disconnect()
                end)
            end

            ax.connection = G.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not ax.enabled then
                    return
                end

                aN.update(workspace.CurrentCamera)
            end)
        else
            Hat_RemoveClassic()

            if ax.connection then
                pcall(function()
                    ax.connection:Disconnect()
                end)

                ax.connection = nil
            end
        end
    end
    local function Hat_ChangeStyle(aO)
        ax.style = 'Classic'
        aN.head, aN.pos, aN.cf = nil, nil, nil
        aN.col = nil

        if ax.enabled then
            aN.build()
        end
    end
    local function Hat_UpdateSides(aO)
        ax.sides = aO
    end

    if aG then
        TrackConnection(aG.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.4)

            if ax.enabled then
                aN.build()
            end
        end))
    end

    local function Trail_RemoveFromCharacter(aO)
        if az.parts[aO] then
            az.parts[aO]:Destroy()

            az.parts[aO] = nil
        end
        if aO and aO:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' then
            local aP = aO.HumanoidRootPart

            if aP:FindFirstChild'TrailAttach0' then
                aP.TrailAttach0:Destroy()
            end
            if aP:FindFirstChild'TrailAttach1' then
                aP.TrailAttach1:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    local function Trail_AddToCharacter(aO)
        local aP = aO:WaitForChild('HumanoidRootPart', 5)

        if not aP then
            return
        end

        Trail_RemoveFromCharacter(aO)

        local aQ = Instance.new'Attachment'

        aQ.Name = 'TrailAttach0'
        aQ.Position = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        aQ.Parent = aP

        local aR = Instance.new'Attachment'

        aR.Name = 'TrailAttach1'
        aR.Position = Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
        aR.Parent = aP

        local aS = Instance.new'Trail'

        aS.Attachment0 = aQ
        aS.Attachment1 = aR
        aS.Lifetime = az.lifetime
        aS.Transparency = NumberSequence.new{
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, az.transparencyStart),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        }
        aS.Color = az.isGradient and ColorSequence.new(az.gradient1, az.gradient2) or ColorSequence.new(az.colorStatic)
        aS.LightEmission = 0.2
        aS.Enabled = true
        aS.Parent = aO
        az.parts[aO] = aS
    end
    local function Trail_UpdateAll()
        for aO, aP in pairs(az.parts)do
            if aP and aP.Parent and aO == aG.Character then
                aP.Lifetime = az.lifetime
                aP.Transparency = NumberSequence.new{
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, az.transparencyStart),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                }

                if az.isGradient then
                    aP.Color = ColorSequence.new(az.gradient1, az.gradient2)
                else
                    aP.Color = ColorSequence.new(az.rainbow and Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 5 / 5, 1, 1) or az.colorStatic)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function Trail_ToggleEnabled(aO)
        az.enabled = aO

        if aO and aG.Character then
            Trail_AddToCharacter(aG.Character)

            if az.connection then
                az.connection:Disconnect()
            end

            az.connection = G.Heartbeat:Connect(Trail_UpdateAll)
        else
            if aG.Character then
                Trail_RemoveFromCharacter(aG.Character)
            end
            if az.connection then
                az.connection:Disconnect()

                az.connection = nil
            end
        end
    end
    local function AuraTrailer_Toggle(aO)
        local aP = aG.Character

        if not aP then
            return
        end

        local aQ = aP:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

        if not aQ then
            return
        end

        for aR, aS in pairs(aP:GetChildren())do
            if aS:IsA'BasePart' and aS ~= aQ then
                if aO then
                    if not aS:FindFirstChild'AuraTrailer' then
                        local aT = Instance.new'Trail'

                        aT.Name = 'AuraTrailer'
                        aT.Texture = 'rbxassetid://1390780157'
                        aT.Parent = aS

                        local aU = Instance.new('Attachment', aS)

                        aU.Name = 'AuraPointer1'

                        local aV = Instance.new('Attachment', aQ)

                        aV.Name = 'AuraPointer2'
                        aT.Attachment0 = aU
                        aT.Attachment1 = aV
                        aT.Color = ColorSequence.new{
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, aA.color),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, aA.color),
                        }
                        aT.Lifetime = aA.lifetime
                    end
                else
                    if aS:FindFirstChild'AuraTrailer' then
                        aS.AuraTrailer:Destroy()
                    end
                    if aS:FindFirstChild'AuraPointer1' then
                        aS.AuraPointer1:Destroy()
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if not aO then
            for aR, aS in pairs(aQ:GetChildren())do
                if aS.Name == 'AuraPointer2' then
                    aS:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function AuraTrailer_Update()
        local aO = aG.Character

        if not aO then
            return
        end

        for aP, aQ in pairs(aO:GetDescendants())do
            if aQ:IsA'Trail' and aQ.Name == 'AuraTrailer' then
                aQ.Color = ColorSequence.new{
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, aA.color),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, aA.color),
                }
                aQ.Lifetime = aA.lifetime
            end
        end
    end
    local function Skybox_Apply(aO)
        local aP = aw[aO]

        if not aP then
            return
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            O:PreloadAsync{
                aP.Bk,
                aP.Dn,
                aP.Ft,
                aP.Lf,
                aP.Rt,
                aP.Up,
            }
        end)

        local aQ = M:FindFirstChildOfClass'Sky'

        if not aQ then
            aQ = Instance.new'Sky'
            aQ.Name = 'Sky'
            aQ.Parent = M
        end

        aQ.SkyboxBk = aP.Bk
        aQ.SkyboxDn = aP.Dn
        aQ.SkyboxFt = aP.Ft
        aQ.SkyboxLf = aP.Lf
        aQ.SkyboxRt = aP.Rt
        aQ.SkyboxUp = aP.Up
    end
    local function Skybox_RestoreDefault()
        local aO = M:FindFirstChildOfClass'Sky'

        if aO and R.SkyboxBk then
            aO.SkyboxBk = R.SkyboxBk
            aO.SkyboxDn = R.SkyboxDn
            aO.SkyboxFt = R.SkyboxFt
            aO.SkyboxLf = R.SkyboxLf
            aO.SkyboxRt = R.SkyboxRt
            aO.SkyboxUp = R.SkyboxUp
        elseif aO then
            aO:Destroy()
        end
    end
    local function mapCharacterParts(aO)
        local aP = {}

        if not aO then
            return aP
        end

        local function add(aQ, aR)
            if aR then
                aP[aQ] = aR
            end
        end

        add('Head', aO:FindFirstChild'Head')
        add('UpperTorso', aO:FindFirstChild'UpperTorso')
        add('LowerTorso', aO:FindFirstChild'LowerTorso')
        add('HumanoidRootPart', aO:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart')
        add('LeftUpperArm', aO:FindFirstChild'LeftUpperArm')
        add('LeftLowerArm', aO:FindFirstChild'LeftLowerArm')
        add('LeftHand', aO:FindFirstChild'LeftHand')
        add('RightUpperArm', aO:FindFirstChild'RightUpperArm')
        add('RightLowerArm', aO:FindFirstChild'RightLowerArm')
        add('RightHand', aO:FindFirstChild'RightHand')
        add('LeftUpperLeg', aO:FindFirstChild'LeftUpperLeg')
        add('LeftLowerLeg', aO:FindFirstChild'LeftLowerLeg')
        add('LeftFoot', aO:FindFirstChild'LeftFoot')
        add('RightUpperLeg', aO:FindFirstChild'RightUpperLeg')
        add('RightLowerLeg', aO:FindFirstChild'RightLowerLeg')
        add('RightFoot', aO:FindFirstChild'RightFoot')
        add('Torso', aO:FindFirstChild'Torso' or aO:FindFirstChild'UpperTorso')
        add('Left Arm', aO:FindFirstChild'Left Arm' or aO:FindFirstChild'LeftUpperArm')
        add('Right Arm', aO:FindFirstChild'Right Arm' or aO:FindFirstChild'RightUpperArm')
        add('Left Leg', aO:FindFirstChild'Left Leg' or aO:FindFirstChild'LeftUpperLeg')
        add('Right Leg', aO:FindFirstChild'Right Leg' or aO:FindFirstChild'RightUpperLeg')

        for aQ, aR in ipairs(aO:GetChildren())do
            if aR:IsA'BasePart' then
                aP[aR.Name] = aR
            end
        end

        return aP
    end
    local function getParticleAuraTemplate(aO)
        if V[aO] then
            return V[aO]
        end

        local aP = U[aO]

        if not aP then
            return nil
        end

        local aQ, aR, aS, aT = tostring(aP):gsub('%D', ''), nil, pcall(function()
            if game.GetObjects then
                return game:GetObjects(aP)
            end

            return nil
        end)

        if aS and type(aT) == 'table' and aT[1] then
            aR = aT[1]
        end
        if not aR and aQ ~= '' then
            local aU, aV = pcall(function()
                local aU = game:GetService'InsertService'
                local aV = aU:LoadAsset(tonumber(aQ))

                if aV then
                    local aW = aV:GetChildren()[1]

                    if aW then
                        aW.Parent = nil

                        aV:Destroy()

                        return aW
                    end

                    return aV
                end

                return nil
            end)

            if aU and aV then
                aR = aV
            end
        end
        if not aR and aQ ~= '' then
            local aU, aV = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects('rbxassetid://' .. aQ)
            end)

            if aU and type(aV) == 'table' and aV[1] then
                aR = aV[1]
            end
        end
        if aR then
            V[aO] = aR

            return aR
        end

        warn('[candy.cc] Failed to load particle aura template:', aO, aP)

        return nil
    end
    local function tintParticleSubtree(aO, aP)
        if not aP or not aO then
            return
        end

        local aQ = ColorSequence.new(aP)

        local function tintOne(aR)
            pcall(function()
                if aR:IsA'ParticleEmitter' or aR:IsA'Beam' or aR:IsA'Trail' then
                    aR.Color = aQ
                elseif aR:IsA'PointLight' then
                    aR.Color = aP
                end
            end)
        end

        tintOne(aO)

        for aR, aS in ipairs(aO:GetDescendants())do
            tintOne(aS)
        end
    end
    local function setParticleEmittersEnabledInSubtree(aO, aP)
        if not aO then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            if aO:IsA'ParticleEmitter' then
                aO.Enabled = aP
            end
        end)

        for aQ, aR in ipairs(aO:GetDescendants())do
            pcall(function()
                if aR:IsA'ParticleEmitter' then
                    aR.Enabled = aP
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function applyParticleAuraToCharacter(aO, aP, aQ)
        local aR = getParticleAuraTemplate(aP)

        if not aR then
            return {}
        end

        local aS, aT, aU = mapCharacterParts(aO), aR:Clone(), {}
        local aV = aS.HumanoidRootPart or aO:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

        local function parentClone(aW, aX)
            if not aW or not aX then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                local aY = aW:Clone()

                aY.Name = 'LarpticAuraParticle'
                aY.Parent = aX

                if aQ then
                    tintParticleSubtree(aY, aQ)
                end

                setParticleEmittersEnabledInSubtree(aY, true)
                pcall(function()
                    if aY:IsA'ParticleEmitter' then
                        aY.Enabled = true
                    end

                    for aZ, a_ in ipairs(aY:GetDescendants())do
                        if a_:IsA'ParticleEmitter' then
                            a_.Enabled = true
                        end
                    end
                end)
                table.insert(aU, aY)
            end)
        end

        for aW, aX in ipairs(aT:GetChildren())do
            local aY = aS[aX.Name]

            if aY then
                if aX:IsA'ParticleEmitter' or aX:IsA'Beam' or aX:IsA'Trail' or aX:IsA'Attachment' then
                    parentClone(aX, aY)
                else
                    for aZ, a_ in ipairs(aX:GetChildren())do
                        parentClone(a_, aY)
                    end

                    if #aX:GetChildren() == 0 then
                        parentClone(aX, aY)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if #aU == 0 and aV then
            for aW, aX in ipairs(aT:GetDescendants())do
                if aX:IsA'ParticleEmitter' or aX:IsA'Beam' or aX:IsA'Trail' then
                    parentClone(aX, aV)
                end
            end

            if #aU == 0 then
                for aW, aX in ipairs(aT:GetChildren())do
                    parentClone(aX, aV)
                end
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            aT:Destroy()
        end)

        return aU
    end
    local function ParticleAura_DisableOne(aO)
        if W[aO] then
            for aP, aQ in ipairs(W[aO])do
                if aQ then
                    pcall(function()
                        aQ:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end

            W[aO] = nil
        end
    end

    local aO = 0

    local function ParticleAura_RefreshAll()
        aO = aO + 1

        local aP = aO

        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.05)

            if aP ~= aO then
                return
            end

            local aQ = aG and aG.Character

            if not aQ then
                return
            end

            local aR, aS = (rawget(_G, 'Toggles') or getgenv().Toggles or Toggles), (rawget(_G, 'Options') or getgenv().Options or Options)
            local aT = aR and aR.ParticleAuraEnabled
            local aU = aT and (aT.Value == true)

            for aV, aW in ipairs(T)do
                ParticleAura_DisableOne(aW)
            end

            if not aU then
                return
            end

            local aV = aS and aS.ParticleAuraDropdown

            if not aV then
                return
            end

            local aW, aX = aV.Value, aS and aS.ParticleAuraColor
            local aY, aZ = (aX and aX.Value) or Color3.fromRGB(133, 220, 255), {}

            if type(aW) == 'table' then
                local a_ = (#aW > 0)

                if a_ then
                    for a0, a1 in ipairs(aW)do
                        if type(a1) == 'string' and U[a1] then
                            table.insert(aZ, a1)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    for a0, a1 in pairs(aW)do
                        if a1 and type(a0) == 'string' and U[a0] then
                            table.insert(aZ, a0)
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif type(aW) == 'string' and U[aW] then
                table.insert(aZ, aW)
            end

            for a_, a0 in ipairs(aZ)do
                if aP ~= aO then
                    return
                end

                local a1, a2 = pcall(function()
                    return applyParticleAuraToCharacter(aQ, a0, aY)
                end)

                if a1 and a2 then
                    W[a0] = a2
                else
                    warn('[candy.cc] Particle aura apply failed:', a0, a2)
                end

                task.wait()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function applyAtmosphere()
        if not Toggles.WorldAtmEnabled or not Toggles.WorldAtmEnabled.Value then
            if aI then
                pcall(function()
                    aI:Destroy()
                end)

                aI = nil
            end

            return
        end

        local aP = aI

        if not (aP and aP.Parent) then
            aP = Instance.new'Atmosphere'
            aP.Name = 'LarpticAtmosphere'
            aP.Parent = M
            aI = aP
        end

        pcall(function()
            aP.Density = Options.WorldAtmDensity and Options.WorldAtmDensity.Value or 0.35
            aP.Offset = Options.WorldAtmOffset and Options.WorldAtmOffset.Value or 0
            aP.Haze = Options.WorldAtmHaze and Options.WorldAtmHaze.Value or 1
            aP.Glare = Options.WorldAtmGlare and Options.WorldAtmGlare.Value or 10
            aP.Color = (Options.WorldAtmColor and Options.WorldAtmColor.Value) or Color3.fromRGB(199, 212, 255)
            aP.Decay = (Options.WorldAtmDecay and Options.WorldAtmDecay.Value) or Color3.fromRGB(106, 112, 125)
        end)
    end
    local function ensureMinecraftVariants()
        if av then
            return
        end

        for aP, aQ in pairs(X)do
            local aR = N:FindFirstChild(aP)

            if not aR then
                aR = Instance.new'MaterialVariant'
                aR.Name = aP
                aR.Parent = N
            end

            pcall(function()
                aR.BaseMaterial = aQ.BaseMaterial
                aR.ColorMap = aQ.Texture
                aR.MetalnessMap = aQ.Texture
                aR.NormalMap = aQ.Texture
                aR.RoughnessMap = aQ.Texture
                aR.MaterialPattern = Enum.MaterialPattern.Regular
                aR.StudsPerTile = 5
            end)
        end

        av = true
    end
    local function rememberPartState(aP)
        if not _[aP] then
            _[aP] = {
                Color = aP.Color,
                Material = aP.Material,
                MaterialVariant = aP.MaterialVariant,
            }
        end

        return _[aP]
    end
    local function shouldSkipTexturePart(aP)
        if not aP:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            return true
        end
        if aP.Name == 'LarpticWeather' or aP.Name == 'Part' then
            return true
        end

        local aQ = aP.Parent

        if aQ and (aQ:IsA'Tool' or aQ:IsA'Accessory') then
            return true
        end

        local aR = aP:FindFirstAncestorOfClass'Model'

        if aR and game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(aR) then
            return true
        end

        return false
    end
    local function applyPartTexturePack()
        ensureMinecraftVariants()

        for aP, aQ in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants())do
            if aQ:IsA'BasePart' and not shouldSkipTexturePart(aQ) then
                rememberPartState(aQ)

                local aR = Y[aQ.Material]

                if aR then
                    pcall(function()
                        aQ.MaterialVariant = aR
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function clearPartTexturePack()
        for aP, aQ in pairs(_)do
            if aP and aP.Parent and aQ then
                pcall(function()
                    aP.Color = aQ.Color
                    aP.Material = aQ.Material
                    aP.MaterialVariant = aQ.MaterialVariant or ''
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function clearMinecraftVariants()
        for aP in pairs(X)do
            local aQ = N:FindFirstChild(aP)

            if aQ and aQ:IsA'MaterialVariant' then
                pcall(function()
                    aQ:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end

        av = false
    end
    local function applyTexturePack()
        local aP = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass'Terrain'

        if aP then
            for aQ, aR in pairs(Z)do
                pcall(function()
                    aP:SetMaterialColor(aQ, aR)
                end)
            end
        end

        applyPartTexturePack()
    end
    local function clearTexturePack()
        clearPartTexturePack()
        clearMinecraftVariants()
    end
    local function Nebula_ClearEffects()
        local aP = {
            NebulaBloom = true,
            NebulaColorCorrection = true,
            NebulaAtmosphere = true,
        }

        for aQ, aR in ipairs(M:GetChildren())do
            if aP[aR.Name] then
                pcall(function()
                    aR:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function Nebula_SaveLightingState()
        aC._saved = {
            Ambient = M.Ambient,
            OutdoorAmbient = M.OutdoorAmbient,
            FogStart = M.FogStart,
            FogEnd = M.FogEnd,
            FogColor = M.FogColor,
        }
    end
    local function Nebula_RestoreLightingState()
        local aP = aC._saved

        if aP then
            pcall(function()
                M.Ambient = aP.Ambient
                M.OutdoorAmbient = aP.OutdoorAmbient
                M.FogStart = aP.FogStart
                M.FogEnd = aP.FogEnd
                M.FogColor = aP.FogColor
            end)
        else
            pcall(function()
                M.Ambient = P.Ambient
                M.OutdoorAmbient = P.OutdoorAmbient
                M.FogStart = P.FogStart
                M.FogEnd = P.FogEnd
                M.FogColor = P.FogColor
            end)
        end

        aC._saved = nil

        pcall(function()
            if applyFog then
                applyFog()
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if applyAtmosphere then
                applyAtmosphere()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function Nebula_Enable()
        Nebula_ClearEffects()

        if not aC._saved then
            Nebula_SaveLightingState()
        end

        for aP, aQ in ipairs(M:GetChildren())do
            if aQ:IsA'Atmosphere' and aQ.Name ~= 'NebulaAtmosphere' then
                pcall(function()
                    aQ.Parent = nil
                end)

                aC._parkedAtmospheres = aC._parkedAtmospheres or {}

                table.insert(aC._parkedAtmospheres, aQ)
            end
        end

        local aP = Instance.new('BloomEffect', M)

        aP.Intensity = 0.7
        aP.Size = 24
        aP.Threshold = 1
        aP.Name = 'NebulaBloom'

        local aQ = Instance.new('ColorCorrectionEffect', M)

        aQ.Saturation = 0.5
        aQ.Contrast = 0.2
        aQ.TintColor = aC.themeColor
        aQ.Name = 'NebulaColorCorrection'

        local aR = Instance.new('Atmosphere', M)

        aR.Density = 0.4
        aR.Offset = 0.25
        aR.Glare = 1
        aR.Haze = 2
        aR.Color = aC.themeColor
        aR.Decay = aC.themeColor
        aR.Name = 'NebulaAtmosphere'
        M.Ambient = aC.themeColor
        M.OutdoorAmbient = aC.themeColor
        M.FogColor = aC.themeColor

        if aC._saved then
            M.FogStart = aC._saved.FogStart
            M.FogEnd = aC._saved.FogEnd
        end

        aC.enabled = true
    end
    local function Nebula_Disable()
        Nebula_ClearEffects()

        aC.enabled = false

        if aC._parkedAtmospheres then
            for aP, aQ in ipairs(aC._parkedAtmospheres)do
                if aQ and aQ.Parent == nil then
                    pcall(function()
                        aQ.Parent = M
                    end)
                end
            end

            aC._parkedAtmospheres = nil
        end

        Nebula_RestoreLightingState()
    end
    local function Nebula_UpdateColor()
        if aC.enabled then
            local aP = M:FindFirstChild'NebulaColorCorrection'

            if aP then
                aP.TintColor = aC.themeColor
            end

            local aQ = M:FindFirstChild'NebulaAtmosphere'

            if aQ then
                aQ.Color = aC.themeColor
                aQ.Decay = aC.themeColor
            end

            M.Ambient = aC.themeColor
            M.OutdoorAmbient = aC.themeColor
            M.FogColor = aC.themeColor
        end
    end
    local function Screen_Toggle(aP)
        aB.screenEnabled = aP and true or false

        if aB.screenConnection then
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(aB.screenConnection) == 'RBXScriptConnection' and aB.screenConnection.Connected then
                    aB.screenConnection:Disconnect()
                end
            end)

            aB.screenConnection = nil
        end
        if aB.screenEnabled then
            aB.screenConnection = G.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not aB.screenEnabled then
                    return
                end

                aH.CFrame = aH.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, (0.65 + aB.screenIntensity), 0, 0, 0, 1)
            end)
        end
    end
    local function Anime_Toggle(aP)
        aE.enabled = aP and true or false

        if aE.gui then
            pcall(function()
                aE.gui:Destroy()
            end)

            aE.gui = nil
        end
        if aE.enabled and aG and aG.PlayerGui then
            aE.gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui', aG.PlayerGui)
            aE.gui.Name = 'AnimeImageGui'
            aE.gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

            local aQ = Instance.new('ImageLabel', aE.gui)

            aQ.Name = 'AnimeImage'
            aQ.Image = 'http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=117783035423570'
            aQ.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 400)
            aQ.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 10)
            aQ.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
            aQ.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        end
    end

    G.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if aB.timeEnabled then
            M.ClockTime = aB.timeValue
        end
        if aB.fullBrightEnabled then
            M.Brightness = 3
            M.GlobalShadows = false

        end

    local function ReapplyVisuals_OnCharacterSpawned(aP)
        task.wait(1)

        if ax.enabled and ax.style == 'Classic' then
            Hat_AddClassic(aP)
        end
        if az.enabled then
            Trail_AddToCharacter(aP)
        end
        if aA.enabled then
            AuraTrailer_Toggle(true)
        end
        if aE.enabled then
            Anime_Toggle(true)
        end

        ParticleAura_RefreshAll()
    end

    if aG then
        aG.CharacterAdded:Connect(ReapplyVisuals_OnCharacterSpawned)

        if aG.Character then
            ReapplyVisuals_OnCharacterSpawned(aG.Character)
        end
    end

        if aI then

                aI:Destroy()

        end
    end
    local function applyFog()
        if not Toggles.WorldFogEnabled or not Toggles.WorldFogEnabled.Value then
            pcall(function()
                M.FogStart = P.FogStart
                M.FogEnd = P.FogEnd
                M.FogColor = P.FogColor
            end)

            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            M.FogStart = Options.WorldFogStart and Options.WorldFogStart.Value or 0
            M.FogEnd = Options.WorldFogEnd and Options.WorldFogEnd.Value or 200
            M.FogColor = (Options.WorldFogColor and Options.WorldFogColor.Value) or Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
        end)
    end
    local function clearFog()
        pcall(function()
            M.FogStart = P.FogStart
            M.FogEnd = P.FogEnd
            M.FogColor = P.FogColor
        end)
    end

    local function ShiftLock_IsMouseLocked()
        local aQ, aR = pcall(function()
            return H.MouseBehavior
        end)

        if aQ and aR == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            return true
        end

        aR.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        aR.DisplayOrder = 9999

    end

    local function ShiftLock_ApplySize(aQ)
        if not aQ or not aQ.Parent then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            aQ.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(aP.cursorWidth, 1, 100), 0, math.clamp(aP.cursorHeight, 1, 100))
            aQ.ImageTransparency = 0
            aQ.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            aQ.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        end)
    end
    local function ShiftLock_ApplyPCCursor()
        if not aP.enabled then
            if aP.pcImage then
                aP.pcImage.Visible = false
            end
            if aP.mouseIconOverridden then
                pcall(function()
                    H.MouseIconEnabled = true
                end)

                aP.mouseIconOverridden = false
            end

            return
        end

        local aQ, aR, aS, aT = ShiftLock_IsMouseLocked(), ShiftLock_EnsurePCOverlay(), math.clamp(aP.cursorWidth, 1, 100), math.clamp(aP.cursorHeight, 1, 100)

        if aR then
            aR.Image = aP.selectedCursor
            aR.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(aS, aT)

            if aQ then
                aR.Visible = true
                aR.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

                pcall(function()
                    H.MouseIconEnabled = false
                end)

                aP.mouseIconOverridden = true
            else
                aR.Visible = false

                if aP.mouseIconOverridden then
                    pcall(function()
                        H.MouseIconEnabled = true
                    end)

                    aP.mouseIconOverridden = false
                end
            end
            if aP.spinEnabled then
                aR.Rotation = aP.rotation
            else
                aR.Rotation = 0
            end
        end
    end
    local function ShiftLock_Update()
        for aQ, aR in pairs(aP.objects)do
            if aR and aR.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    if aP.enabled then
                        aR.Image = aP.selectedCursor

                        ShiftLock_ApplySize(aR)
                    else
                        aR.Image = 'rbxasset://textures/MouseLockedCursor.png'
                        aR.Rotation = 0
                        aR.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        ShiftLock_ApplyPCCursor()
    end
    local function ShiftLock_Scan()
        aP.objects = {}

        local function consider(aQ)
            if not aQ or not (aQ:IsA'ImageLabel' or aQ:IsA'ImageButton') then
                return
            end
            if aQ.Name == 'ShiftCursor' or (aQ.Parent and aQ.Parent.Name == 'CandyShiftLockPC') then
                return
            end

            local aR, aS = aQ.Image, string.lower(aQ.Name)

            if table.find(aP.defaultImages, aR) or string.find(aS, 'shift', 1, true) or string.find(aS, 'lock', 1, true) then
                table.insert(aP.objects, aQ)
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            local aQ = {}

            if I then
                table.insert(aQ, I)
            end
            if K then
                local aR = K:FindFirstChild'PlayerGui'

                if aR then
                    table.insert(aQ, aR)
                end
            end

            for aR, aS in ipairs(aQ)do
                for aT, aU in ipairs(aS:GetDescendants())do
                    consider(aU)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    task.defer(ShiftLock_Scan)
    TrackConnection(game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(aQ)
        task.wait(0.25)

        if not (aQ and (aQ:IsA'ImageLabel' or aQ:IsA'ImageButton')) then
            return
        end
        if aQ.Name == 'ShiftCursor' or (aQ.Parent and aQ.Parent.Name == 'CandyShiftLockPC') then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            local aR, aS = aQ.Image, string.lower(aQ.Name)

            if table.find(aP.defaultImages, aR) or string.find(aS, 'shift', 1, true) or string.find(aS, 'lock', 1, true) then
                table.insert(aP.objects, aQ)

                if aP.enabled then
                    aQ.Image = aP.selectedCursor

                    ShiftLock_ApplySize(aQ)
                end
            end
        end)
    end))
    TrackConnection(G.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not aP.enabled then
            return
        end

        ShiftLock_ApplyPCCursor()

        if aP.spinEnabled then
            if aP.spinDirection == 'Right' then
                aP.rotation = aP.rotation + aP.spinSpeed
            else
                aP.rotation = aP.rotation - aP.spinSpeed
            end

            for aQ, aR in pairs(aP.objects)do
                if aR and aR.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        aR.Rotation = aP.rotation

                        ShiftLock_ApplySize(aR)
                    end)
                end
            end

            if aP.pcImage and aP.pcImage.Visible then
                aP.pcImage.Rotation = aP.rotation
            end
        end
    end))

    local function ShiftLock_SetEnabled(aQ)
        aP.enabled = aQ and true or false

        if aQ then
            ShiftLock_Scan()
            ShiftLock_EnsurePCOverlay()
        else
            if aP.mouseIconOverridden then
                pcall(function()
                    H.MouseIconEnabled = true
                end)

                aP.mouseIconOverridden = false
            end

            ShiftLock_DestroyPCOverlay()
        end

        ShiftLock_Update()
    end
    local function ShiftLock_SetCursor(aQ)
        local aR = aP.cursorMap[aQ]

        if aR then
            aP.selectedCursor = aR

            ShiftLock_Update()
        end
    end

    local function WVFX_Track(aS)
        if aS then
            table.insert(aR.conns, aS)

            if TrackConnection then
                pcall(TrackConnection, aS)
            end
        end

        return aS
    end
    local function WVFX_EnsureFolder()
        if aR.folder and aR.folder.Parent then
            return aR.folder
        end

        local aS = Instance.new'Folder'

        aS.Name = 'CandyWorldVFX'
        aS.Parent = F
        aR.folder = aS

        return aS
    end
    local function WVFX_Destroy(aS)
        local aT = aR.objs[aS]

        if aT then
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(aT) == 'Instance' then
                    aT:Destroy()
                elseif type(aT) == 'table' then
                    for aU, aV in pairs(aT)do
                        if typeof(aV) == 'Instance' then
                            pcall(function()
                                aV:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            aR.objs[aS] = nil
        end
    end
    local function WVFX_GetOrCreateFX(aS, aT, aU)
        aU = aU or aQ

        local aV = aU:FindFirstChild(aT)

        if aV and aV:IsA(aS) then
            return aV
        end
        if aV then
            pcall(function()
                aV:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        local aW = Instance.new(aS)

        aW.Name = aT
        aW.Parent = aU

        return aW
    end
    local function WVFX_SetAurora(aS)
        aR.state.aurora = aS and true or false

        if not aS then
            WVFX_Destroy'AuroraCC'
            WVFX_Destroy'AuroraAtm'
            WVFX_Destroy'AuroraBloom'

            return
        end

        local aT = WVFX_GetOrCreateFX('ColorCorrectionEffect', 'CandyAuroraCC')

        aT.Enabled = true
        aT.Brightness = 0.02
        aT.Contrast = 0.08
        aT.Saturation = 0.15
        aT.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(140, 220, 255)
        aR.objs.AuroraCC = aT

        local aU = WVFX_GetOrCreateFX('BloomEffect', 'CandyAuroraBloom')

        aU.Enabled = true
        aU.Intensity = 0.35
        aU.Size = 28
        aU.Threshold = 1.1
        aR.objs.AuroraBloom = aU

        local aV = aQ:FindFirstChildOfClass'Atmosphere'

        if not aV then
            aV = Instance.new'Atmosphere'
            aV.Name = 'CandyAuroraAtmosphere'
            aV.Parent = aQ
            aR.objs.AuroraAtm = aV
        end

        aV.Density = math.clamp(aV.Density, 0.25, 0.45)
        aV.Offset = 0.15
        aV.Glare = 0.15
        aV.Haze = 1.8
        aV.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 160, 220)
        aV.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 140)
    end
    local function WVFX_SetGodRays(aS)

    local function WVFX_CaptureBaseline()
        if aR.saved and aR.saved.captured then
            return
        end

        local aT = aQ:FindFirstChildOfClass'Atmosphere'

        aR.saved = {
            captured = true,
            clock = aQ.ClockTime,
            brightness = aQ.Brightness,
            ambient = aQ.Ambient,
            outdoor = aQ.OutdoorAmbient,
            fogStart = aQ.FogStart,
            fogEnd = aQ.FogEnd,
            fogColor = aQ.FogColor,
            atm = aT and {
                Density = aT.Density,
                Offset = aT.Offset,
                Color = aT.Color,
                Decay = aT.Decay,
                Haze = aT.Haze,
                Glare = aT.Glare,
            } or nil,
            hadAtm = aT ~= nil,
        }
    end
    local function WVFX_RestoreBaseline()
        local aT = aR.saved

        if not aT or not aT.captured then
            pcall(function()
                aQ.ClockTime = 14
                aQ.Brightness = 2
                aQ.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
                aQ.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
                aQ.FogStart = 0
                aQ.FogEnd = 100000
                aQ.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
            end)

            local aU = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyWeatherAtmosphere'

            if aU then
                pcall(function()
                    aU:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            aQ.ClockTime = aT.clock
            aQ.Brightness = aT.brightness
            aQ.Ambient = aT.ambient
            aQ.OutdoorAmbient = aT.outdoor
            aQ.FogStart = aT.fogStart
            aQ.FogEnd = aT.fogEnd
            aQ.FogColor = aT.fogColor
        end)

        local aU = aQ:FindFirstChildOfClass'Atmosphere'

        if aT.atm and aU then
            for aV, aW in pairs(aT.atm)do
                pcall(function()
                    aU[aV] = aW
                end)
            end
        end

        local aV = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyWeatherAtmosphere'

        if aV and not aT.hadAtm then
            pcall(function()
                aV:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function WVFX_ClearWeatherParticles()
        WVFX_Destroy'WeatherAttach'
        WVFX_Destroy'WeatherPart'
    end
    local function WVFX_MakeLocalEmitter(aT, aU, aV)
        local aW = Instance.new'Attachment'

        aW.Name = aT .. 'Att'
        aW.Parent = aU

        local aX = Instance.new'ParticleEmitter'

        aX.Name = aT

        for aY, aZ in pairs(aV)do
            pcall(function()
                aX[aY] = aZ
            end)
        end

        aX.Parent = aW

        return aW, aX
    end
    local function WVFX_ApplyWeatherParticles(aT)

            local aX = WVFX_MakeLocalEmitter('WeatherFX', aV, aW)
