        end
    end
    local function WVFX_ApplyCustomOverrides()
        local aT = aR.state.custom

        if not aT then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            aQ.ClockTime = aT.clock
            aQ.Brightness = aT.brightness
            aQ.Ambient = aT.ambient
            aQ.OutdoorAmbient = aT.outdoor
            aQ.FogStart = aT.fogStart
            aQ.FogEnd = aT.fogEnd
            aQ.FogColor = aT.fog
        end)

        local aU = aQ:FindFirstChildOfClass'Atmosphere'

        if not aU then
            aU = Instance.new'Atmosphere'
            aU.Name = 'CandyWeatherAtmosphere'
            aU.Parent = aQ
            aR.objs.WeatherAtm = aU
        end

        pcall(function()
            aU.Color = aT.atmosphere
            aU.Density = aT.density
            aU.Haze = aT.haze
        end)

        local aV = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyWeatherCC'

        if not aV then
            aV = Instance.new'ColorCorrectionEffect'
            aV.Name = 'CandyWeatherCC'
            aV.Parent = aQ
            aR.objs.WeatherCC = aV
        end

        aV.Enabled = true
        aV.TintColor = aT.tint
        aV.Contrast = aT.contrast
        aV.Saturation = aT.saturation
        aV.Brightness = math.clamp((aT.brightness - 2) * 0.04, -0.15, 0.15)
    end
    local function WVFX_SetCustomMood(aT)
        local aU = aT and true or false

        aR.state.customMood = aU

        local aV = aR.state.weather

        if not aV or aV == 'Off' or not aS[aV] then
            return
        end

        local aW = aS[aV]

        if aU then
            local aX = aR.state.custom

            if aX and aW then
                aX.tint = (aW.cc and aW.cc.TintColor) or aX.tint
                aX.atmosphere = (aW.atm and aW.atm.Color) or aX.atmosphere
                aX.fog = aW.fogColor or aX.fog
                aX.ambient = aW.ambient or aX.ambient
                aX.outdoor = aW.outdoor or aX.outdoor
                aX.brightness = aW.brightness or aX.brightness
                aX.clock = aW.clock or aX.clock
                aX.fogStart = aW.fogStart or aX.fogStart
                aX.fogEnd = aW.fogEnd or aX.fogEnd
                aX.density = (aW.atm and aW.atm.Density) or aX.density
                aX.haze = (aW.atm and aW.atm.Haze) or aX.haze
                aX.contrast = (aW.cc and aW.cc.Contrast) or aX.contrast
                aX.saturation = (aW.cc and aW.cc.Saturation) or aX.saturation
            end

            WVFX_ApplyCustomOverrides()
        else
            pcall(function()
                aQ.ClockTime = aW.clock
                aQ.Brightness = aW.brightness
                aQ.Ambient = aW.ambient
                aQ.OutdoorAmbient = aW.outdoor
                aQ.FogStart = aW.fogStart
                aQ.FogEnd = aW.fogEnd
                aQ.FogColor = aW.fogColor
            end)

            local aX = aQ:FindFirstChildOfClass'Atmosphere'

            if aX and aW.atm then
                for aY, aZ in pairs(aW.atm)do
                    pcall(function()
                        aX[aY] = aZ
                    end)
                end
            end

            local aY = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyWeatherCC'

            if aY and aW.cc then
                for aZ, a_ in pairs(aW.cc)do
                    pcall(function()
                        aY[aZ] = a_
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function WVFX_UpdateCustom(aT, aU)
        if aR.state.custom and aT ~= nil then
            aR.state.custom[aT] = aU
        end
        if aR.state.customMood and aR.state.weather and aR.state.weather ~= 'Off' then
            WVFX_ApplyCustomOverrides()
        end
    end
    local function WVFX_SetWeather(aT)
        aT = aT or 'Off'
        aR.state.weather = aT

        WVFX_ClearWeatherParticles()

        local aU = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyWeatherCC'

        if aU then
            pcall(function()
                aU:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        aR.objs.WeatherCC = nil

        if not aT or aT == 'Off' or not aS[aT] then
            WVFX_RestoreBaseline()

            return
        end

        WVFX_CaptureBaseline()

        local aV = aS[aT]

        pcall(function()
            aQ.ClockTime = aV.clock
            aQ.Brightness = aV.brightness
            aQ.Ambient = aV.ambient
            aQ.OutdoorAmbient = aV.outdoor
            aQ.FogStart = aV.fogStart
            aQ.FogEnd = aV.fogEnd
            aQ.FogColor = aV.fogColor
        end)

        local aW = aQ:FindFirstChildOfClass'Atmosphere'

        if not aW then
            aW = Instance.new'Atmosphere'
            aW.Name = 'CandyWeatherAtmosphere'
            aW.Parent = aQ
            aR.objs.WeatherAtm = aW
        end

        for aX, aY in pairs(aV.atm)do
            pcall(function()
                aW[aX] = aY
            end)
        end

        local aX = Instance.new'ColorCorrectionEffect'

        aX.Name = 'CandyWeatherCC'
        aX.Enabled = true

        for aY, aZ in pairs(aV.cc)do
            pcall(function()
                aX[aY] = aZ
            end)
        end

        aX.Parent = aQ
        aR.objs.WeatherCC = aX

        if aV.particles then
            WVFX_ApplyWeatherParticles(aV.particles)
        end
        if aR.state.customMood then
            WVFX_ApplyCustomOverrides()
        end
    end

    local function WVFX_SetClouds(aT)
        aR.state.clouds = aT and true or false

        WVFX_Destroy'Clouds'

        if not aT then
            return
        end

        local aU = Instance.new'Folder'

        aU.Name = 'CandyClouds'
        aU.Parent = WVFX_EnsureFolder()
        aR.objs.Clouds = aU

        local function addLobe(aV, aW, aX, aY)
            local aZ = Instance.new'Part'

            aZ.Name = 'Lobe'
            aZ.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            aZ.Anchored = true
            aZ.CanCollide = false
            aZ.CanQuery = false
            aZ.CanTouch = false
            aZ.CastShadow = false
            aZ.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            aZ.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
            aZ.Transparency = aY
            aZ.Size = aX
            aZ.CFrame = aV.CFrame * CFrame.new(aW)
            aZ.Parent = aV

            return aZ
        end

        for aV = 1, 7 do
            local aW = Instance.new'Part'

            aW.Name = 'Cloud' .. aV
            aW.Anchored = true
            aW.CanCollide = false
            aW.CanQuery = false
            aW.CanTouch = false
            aW.CastShadow = false
            aW.Transparency = 1
            aW.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)

            local aX, aY, aZ = (aV / 7) * math.pi * 2, 200 + (aV % 4) * 55, 130 + (aV % 3) * 22

            aW.CFrame = CFrame.new(math.cos(aX) * aY, aZ, math.sin(aX) * aY)
            aW.Parent = aU

            aW:SetAttribute('BaseY', aZ)
            aW:SetAttribute('Angle', aX)
            aW:SetAttribute('Radius', aY)
            aW:SetAttribute('Speed', 0.012 + (aV % 5) * 0.003)

            local a_ = 14 + (aV % 3) * 4

            addLobe(aW, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(a_ * 2.2, a_ * 1.1, a_ * 1.6), 0.35)
            addLobe(aW, Vector3.new(a_ * 0.9, a_ * 0.15, 0), Vector3.new(a_ * 1.5, a_ * 1, a_ * 1.3), 0.4)
            addLobe(aW, Vector3.new(-a_ * 0.85, a_ * 0.1, a_ * 0.2), Vector3.new(a_ * 1.4, a_ * 0.95, a_ * 1.2), 0.42)
            addLobe(aW, Vector3.new(0, a_ * 0.45, -a_ * 0.3), Vector3.new(a_ * 1.2, a_ * 0.9, a_ * 1.1), 0.38)
            addLobe(aW, Vector3.new(a_ * 0.3, -a_ * 0.1, a_ * 0.55), Vector3.new(a_ * 1.1, a_ * 0.8, a_ * 1), 0.45)

            local a0 = addLobe(aW, Vector3.new(0, a_ * 0.55, 0), Vector3.new(a_ * 0.9, a_ * 0.55, a_ * 0.9), 0.55)

            a0.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            a0.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            a0.Transparency = 0.72
        end
    end
    local function WVFX_SetLightning(aT)
        aR.state.lightning = aT and true or false
        aR.nextStrike = os.clock() + 3

        if not aT then
            local aU = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyLightningCC'

            if aU then
                pcall(function()
                    aU:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            local aV = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyLightningBloom'

            if aV then
                pcall(function()
                    aV:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            aR.objs.LightningCC = nil
            aR.objs.LightningBloom = nil

            return
        end

        local aU = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyLightningCC'

        if not aU then
            aU = Instance.new'ColorCorrectionEffect'
            aU.Name = 'CandyLightningCC'
            aU.Parent = aQ
        end

        aU.Enabled = false
        aU.Brightness = 0.85
        aU.Contrast = 0.35
        aU.Saturation = -0.25
        aU.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(230, 240, 255)
        aR.objs.LightningCC = aU

        local aV = aQ:FindFirstChild'CandyLightningBloom'

        if not aV then
            aV = Instance.new'BloomEffect'
            aV.Name = 'CandyLightningBloom'
            aV.Parent = aQ
        end

        aV.Enabled = false
        aV.Intensity = 3.5
        aV.Size = 60
        aV.Threshold = 0.4
        aR.objs.LightningBloom = aV
    end
    local function WVFX_DoStrike()
        local aT, aU = aR.objs.LightningCC, aR.objs.LightningBloom

        if not aT then
            return
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            for aV = 1, 2 do
                aT.Enabled = true

                if aU then
                    aU.Enabled = true
                end

                pcall(function()
                    local aW = Instance.new'Sound'

                    aW.SoundId = 'rbxassetid://169380525'
                    aW.Volume = 0.35
                    aW.PlaybackSpeed = 0.9 + math.random() * 0.2
                    aW.Parent = g

                    aW:Play()
                    game:GetService'Debris':AddItem(aW, 3)
                end)
                task.wait(0.05 + math.random() * 0.04)

                aT.Enabled = false

                if aU then
                    aU.Enabled = false
                end
                if aV == 1 then
                    task.wait(0.07 + math.random() * 0.08)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function WVFX_Update(aT)
        aT = aT or 0.016
        aR.phase = aR.phase + aT

        local aU, aV = F.CurrentCamera, K and K.Character
        local aW = aV and aV:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

        if aR.state.aurora and aR.objs.AuroraCC then
            local aX = aR.phase
            local aY, aZ = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(aX * 0.35), 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(aX * 0.22 + 1.3)
            local a_, a0, a1 = 0.45 + aY * 0.25, 0.75 + aZ * 0.2, 0.95

            aR.objs.AuroraCC.TintColor = Color3.new(a_, a0, a1)
            aR.objs.AuroraCC.Saturation = 0.1 + aY * 0.2

            if aR.objs.AuroraBloom then
                aR.objs.AuroraBloom.Intensity = 0.25 + aY * 0.25
            end

            local a2 = aQ:FindFirstChildOfClass'Atmosphere'

            if a2 then
                a2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70 + aY * 50, 140 + aZ * 40, 200 + aY * 30)
                a2.Haze = 1.4 + aY * 0.8
            end
        end
        if aR.state.dof and aR.objs.DOF and aU and aW then
            local aX = (aU.CFrame.Position - aW.Position).Magnitude

            aR.objs.DOF.FocusDistance = math.clamp(aX, 8, 80)
            aR.objs.DOF.InFocusRadius = math.clamp(aX * 0.35, 12, 40)
        end

        local function placeHost(aX, aY)
            if not aX or not aU then
                return
            end

            local aZ = aU.CFrame

            aX.CFrame = aZ * CFrame.new(aY)
        end

        if aR.objs.WeatherPart then
            placeHost(aR.objs.WeatherPart, Vector3.new(0, 12, -6))
        end
        if aR.objs.AmbientPart then
            placeHost(aR.objs.AmbientPart, Vector3.new(0, 1, -4))
        end
        if aR.objs.SeasonPart then
            placeHost(aR.objs.SeasonPart, Vector3.new(0, 8, -2))
        end
        if aR.objs.MistPart and aW then
            aR.objs.MistPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(aW.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0))
        elseif aR.objs.MistPart and aU then
            local aX = aU.CFrame.Position + aU.CFrame.LookVector * 8

            aR.objs.MistPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(aX.X, aX.Y - 6, aX.Z)
        end
        if aR.state.clouds and aR.objs.Clouds then
            for aX, aY in ipairs(aR.objs.Clouds:GetChildren())do
                if aY:IsA'BasePart' and aY.Name:match'^Cloud' then
                    local aZ = (aY:GetAttribute'Angle' or 0) + (aY:GetAttribute'Speed' or 0.02) * aT

                    aY:SetAttribute('Angle', aZ)

                    local a_, a0 = aY:GetAttribute'Radius' or 200, aY:GetAttribute'BaseY' or 140
                    local a1 = math.sin(aR.phase * 0.25 + a_) * 4
                    local a2, a3 = CFrame.new(math.cos(aZ) * a_, a0 + a1, math.sin(aZ) * a_), aY.CFrame

                    aY.CFrame = a2

                    local a4 = a2.Position - a3.Position

                    for a5, a6 in ipairs(aY:GetChildren())do
                        if a6:IsA'BasePart' then
                            a6.CFrame = a6.CFrame + a4
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if aR.state.lightning then
            local aX = os.clock()

            if aX >= (aR.nextStrike or 0) then
                WVFX_DoStrike()

                aR.nextStrike = aX + 8 + math.random() * 7
            end
        end
    end
    local function WVFX_StopAll()
        WVFX_SetAurora(false)
        WVFX_SetGodRays(false)
        WVFX_SetDOF(false)
        WVFX_SetNeon(false)
        WVFX_SetWeather'Off'
        WVFX_SetAmbientFx'Off'
        WVFX_SetClouds(false)
        WVFX_SetLightning(false)
        WVFX_SetGroundMist(false)
        WVFX_SetSeasonal'Off'

        if aR.folder then
            pcall(function()
                aR.folder:Destroy()
            end)

            aR.folder = nil
        end
    end

    WVFX_Track(G.RenderStepped:Connect(function(aT)
        local aU = aR.state

        if aU.aurora or aU.godRays or aU.dof or aU.neon or aU.clouds or aU.lightning or aU.groundMist or (aU.weather and aU.weather ~= 'Off') or (aU.ambientFx and aU.ambientFx ~= 'Off') or (aU.seasonal and aU.seasonal ~= 'Off') then
            WVFX_Update(aT)
        end
    end))

    p.VisualFns.WorldVFX = aR
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetAurora = WVFX_SetAurora
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetGodRays = WVFX_SetGodRays
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetDOF = WVFX_SetDOF
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetNeon = WVFX_SetNeon
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetWeather = WVFX_SetWeather
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetCustomMood = WVFX_SetCustomMood
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_UpdateCustom = WVFX_UpdateCustom
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_ApplyCustomOverrides = WVFX_ApplyCustomOverrides
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetAmbientFx = WVFX_SetAmbientFx
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetClouds = WVFX_SetClouds
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetLightning = WVFX_SetLightning
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetGroundMist = WVFX_SetGroundMist
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_SetSeasonal = WVFX_SetSeasonal
    p.VisualFns.WVFX_StopAll = WVFX_StopAll
    p.VisualFns.Screen_Toggle = Screen_Toggle
    p.VisualFns.WorldVariables = aB
    p.VisualFns.Anime_Toggle = Anime_Toggle
    p.VisualFns.AnimeVariables = aE
    p.VisualFns.FPSVariables = aF
    p.VisualFns.player = aG
end

__candyware_InitCharVisuals()

do
    getgenv().crosshair = {
        enabled = true,
        refreshrate = 0,
        mode = 'mouse',
        position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
        width = 1.5,
        length = 10,
        radius = 11,
        color = Color3.fromRGB(199, 110, 255),
        spin = true,
        spin_speed = 150,
        spin_max = 340,
        spin_style = Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
        resize = true,
        resize_speed = 150,
        resize_min = 5,
        resize_max = 22,
    }

    if typeof(Drawing) ~= 'table' or typeof(Drawing.new) ~= 'function' then
    else
        local ax
        local ay = pcall(function()
            ax = hookfunction(Drawing.new, function(ay, az)
                local aA = ax(ay)

                for aB, aC in next, az or {}do
                    aA[aB] = aC
                end

                return aA
            end)
        end)

        if not ay then
            ax = Drawing.new
        end

        local az, aA, aB, aC, aD, aE = game:GetService'RunService', game:GetService'UserInputService', game:GetService'TweenService', workspace.CurrentCamera, 0, {
            crosshair = {},
            text = {
                Drawing.new('Text', {
                    Size = 13,
                    Font = 2,
                    Outline = true,
                    Text = ' ',
                    Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                }),
                Drawing.new('Text', {
                    Size = 13,
                    Font = 2,
                    Outline = true,
                    Text = ' ',
                }),
            },
        }

        for aF = 1, 8 do
            aE.crosshair[aF] = Drawing.new'Line'
        end

        function solve(aF, aG)
            return Vector2.new(math.sin(math.rad(aF)) * aG, math.cos(math.rad(aF)) * aG)
        end

        az.PostSimulation:Connect(function()
            local aF, aG = tick(), getgenv().crosshair

            if not aG then
                return
            end
            if aF - aD > (aG.refreshrate or 0) then
                aD = aF

                local aH, aI = (aG.mode == 'center' and aC.ViewportSize / 2 or aG.mode == 'mouse' and aA:GetMouseLocation() or aG.position), aE.text[1].TextBounds.X + aE.text[2].TextBounds.X

                aE.text[1].Visible = aG.enabled
                aE.text[2].Visible = aG.enabled

                if aG.enabled then
                    pcall(function()
                        if H.MouseIconEnabled then
                            H.MouseIconEnabled = false
                        end
                    end)

                    aE.text[1].Position = aH + Vector2.new(-aI / 2, aG.radius + (aG.resize and aG.resize_max or aG.length) + 15)
                    aE.text[2].Position = aE.text[1].Position + Vector2.new(aE.text[1].TextBounds.X)
                    aE.text[2].Color = aG.color

                    for aJ = 1, 4 do
                        local aK, aL, aM, aN = aE.crosshair[aJ], aE.crosshair[aJ + 4], (aJ - 1) * 90, aG.length

                        if aG.spin then
                            local aO = -aF * aG.spin_speed % aG.spin_max

                            aM = aM + aB:GetValue(aO / 360, aG.spin_style, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut) * 360
                        end
                        if aG.resize then
                            local aO = tick() * aG.resize_speed % 180

                            aN = aG.resize_min + math.sin(math.rad(aO)) * aG.resize_max
                        end

                        aL.Visible = true
                        aL.Color = aG.color
                        aL.From = aH + solve(aM, aG.radius)
                        aL.To = aH + solve(aM, aG.radius + aN)
                        aL.Thickness = aG.width
                        aK.Visible = true
                        aK.From = aH + solve(aM, aG.radius - 1)
                        aK.To = aH + solve(aM, aG.radius + aN + 1)
                        aK.Thickness = aG.width + 1.5
                    end
                else
                    for aJ = 1, 8 do
                        aE.crosshair[aJ].Visible = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        local function Crosshair_ApplyConfig()
            local aF, aG = p and p.Config, getgenv().crosshair

            if not aF or not aG then
                return
            end

            aG.mode = (tostring(aF.CrosshairMode or 'Mouse'):lower() == 'center') and 'center' or 'mouse'
            aG.width = tonumber(aF.CrosshairWidth) or aG.width
            aG.length = tonumber(aF.CrosshairLength) or aG.length
            aG.radius = tonumber(aF.CrosshairRadius) or aG.radius
            aG.spin = aF.CrosshairSpin ~= false
            aG.spin_speed = tonumber(aF.CrosshairSpinSpeed) or aG.spin_speed
            aG.resize = aF.CrosshairResize ~= false
            aG.resize_speed = tonumber(aF.CrosshairResizeSpeed) or aG.resize_speed
            aG.resize_min = tonumber(aF.CrosshairResizeMin) or aG.resize_min
            aG.resize_max = tonumber(aF.CrosshairResizeMax) or aG.resize_max

            if typeof(aF.CrosshairColor) == 'Color3' then
                aG.color = aF.CrosshairColor
            end
            if aF.CrosshairEnabled ~= nil then
                aG.enabled = aF.CrosshairEnabled and true or false
            end
        end
        local function Crosshair_SetEnabled(aF)
            local aG = getgenv().crosshair

            if not aG then
                return
            end

            aG.enabled = aF and true or false

            if p and p.Config then
                p.Config.CrosshairEnabled = aG.enabled
            end

            pcall(function()
                H.MouseIconEnabled = not aG.enabled
            end)
        end
        local function Crosshair_SetColor(aF)
            if typeof(aF) == 'Color3' then
                local aG = getgenv().crosshair

                if aG then
                    aG.color = aF
                end
                if p and p.Config then
                    p.Config.CrosshairColor = aF
                end
            end
        end
        local function Crosshair_Destroy()
            for aF = 1, 8 do
                local aG = aE.crosshair[aF]

                if aG then
                    pcall(function()
                        aG.Visible = false

                        aG:Remove()
                    end)
                end
            end

            for aF, aG in ipairs(aE.text)do
                if aG then
                    pcall(function()
                        aG.Visible = false

                        aG:Remove()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        p.VisualFns = p.VisualFns or {}
        p.VisualFns.Crosshair_SetEnabled = Crosshair_SetEnabled
        p.VisualFns.Crosshair_ApplyConfig = Crosshair_ApplyConfig
        p.VisualFns.Crosshair_SetColor = Crosshair_SetColor
        p.VisualFns.Crosshair_Destroy = Crosshair_Destroy
        p.VisualFns.CrosshairState = getgenv().crosshair

        task.defer(function()
            Crosshair_ApplyConfig()

            if p.Config and p.Config.CrosshairEnabled then
                Crosshair_SetEnabled(true)
            else
                if p.Config and p.Config.CrosshairEnabled == false then
                    Crosshair_SetEnabled(false)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

local ax = p.VisualFns

do
    local ay, az, aA, aB, aC, aD = writefile or (getgenv and getgenv().writefile), readfile or (getgenv and getgenv().readfile), isfile or (getgenv and getgenv().isfile), makefolder or (getgenv and getgenv().makefolder), listfiles or (getgenv and getgenv().listfiles), delfile or (getgenv and getgenv().delfile)

    local function normalizePath(aE)
        return tostring(aE or ''):gsub('\\', '/')
    end
    local function ensureCandyFolders()
        if not aB then
            return
        end

        pcall(aB, 'candycfg')
        pcall(aB, 'candycfg/cfg')
        pcall(aB, 'candycfg/sounds')
        pcall(aB, 'candycfg/images')
        pcall(aB, 'candycfg/data')
    end
    local function basename(aE)
        aE = normalizePath(aE)

        local aF = aE:match'([^/]+)$' or aE

        return aF
    end
    local function stripExt(aE)
        return (aE:gsub('%.[^%.]+$', ''))
    end
    local function isDefaultConfig(aE)
        aE = normalizePath(aE)

        local aF = stripExt(basename(aE)):lower()

        if aF == 'default' then
            return true
        end
        if aE == 'Default' or aE:match'/Default$' or aE:match'/Default%.' then
            return true
        end

        return false
    end
    local function isConfigPath(aE)
        aE = normalizePath(aE)

        if aE:match'^candycfg/cfg/' then
            return true
        end
        if aE:match'^candycfg/json/' then
            return true
        end
        if aE:match'^candycfg/[^/]+%.json$' then
            return true
        end
        if aE:match'^candycfg/[^/]+%.cfg$' then
            return true
        end
        if aE:match'MobileBtn' then
            return true
        end
        if aE:match'^candycfg/' and not aE:match'%.ogg$' and not aE:match'%.png$' and not aE:match'%.jpg$' and not aE:match'%.lua$' and not aE:match'%.luau$' and not aE:match'%.mp3$' and not aE:match'%.wav$' then
            local aF = aE:match'^candycfg/(.+)$'

            if aF and not aF:find'/' then
                return true
            end
            if aF and aF:match'^cfg/' then
                return true
            end
            if aF and aF:match'^json/' then
                return true
            end
        end

        return false
    end
    local function resolvePath(aE)
        aE = normalizePath(aE)

        if aE == '' then
            return aE
        end

        local aF = basename(aE):lower()

        if aF == 'candy.png' or aF == 'candycc.png' or aF == 'candyware_logo.png' then
            return basename(aE)
        end

        ensureCandyFolders()

        if aE:match'%.ogg$' or aE:match'%.mp3$' or aE:match'%.wav$' then
            if aE:match'^candycfg/sounds/' then
                return aE
            end

            return 'candycfg/sounds/' .. basename(aE)
        end
        if aE:match'%.png$' or aE:match'%.jpg$' or aE:match'%.jpeg$' or aE:match'%.webp$' then
            if aE:match'^candycfg/images/' then
                return aE
            end

            return 'candycfg/images/' .. basename(aE)
        end
        if aE:match'%.lua$' or aE:match'%.luau$' or aE:match'%.txt$' or aE:match'%.dat$' then
            if aE:match'^candycfg/data/' then
                return aE
            end

            return 'candycfg/data/' .. basename(aE)
        end
        if isConfigPath(aE) or aE:match'%.json$' or aE:match'%.cfg$' then
            local aG = stripExt(basename(aE))

            if aG == '' then
                aG = 'config'
            end

            return 'candycfg/cfg/' .. aG .. '.cfg'
        end
        if not aE:find'/' and not aE:match'^candycfg' then
            local aG = aE:match'(%.[^%.]+)$'

            if aG == '.ogg' or aG == '.mp3' or aG == '.wav' then
                return 'candycfg/sounds/' .. aE
            elseif aG == '.png' or aG == '.jpg' or aG == '.jpeg' then
                return 'candycfg/images/' .. aE
            elseif aG == '.lua' or aG == '.luau' or aG == '.txt' then
                return 'candycfg/data/' .. aE
            elseif aG == '.json' or aG == '.cfg' or not aG then
                local aH = stripExt(aE)

                return 'candycfg/cfg/' .. aH .. '.cfg'
            end

            return 'candycfg/data/' .. aE
        end

        return aE
    end
    local function candidatePaths(aE)
        local aF = resolvePath(aE)
        local aG, aH = {aF}, normalizePath(aE)

        if aH ~= aF then
            table.insert(aG, aH)
        end
        if isConfigPath(aH) or aH:match'%.json$' or aH:match'%.cfg$' then
            local aI = stripExt(basename(aH))

            table.insert(aG, 'candycfg/cfg/' .. aI .. '.cfg')
            table.insert(aG, 'candycfg/json/' .. aI .. '.json')
            table.insert(aG, 'candycfg/json/' .. aI)
            table.insert(aG, 'candycfg/' .. aI .. '.json')
            table.insert(aG, 'candycfg/' .. aI .. '.cfg')
            table.insert(aG, 'candycfg/' .. aI)
        end
        if aH:match'%.ogg$' then
            table.insert(aG, 'candycfg/sounds/' .. basename(aH))
            table.insert(aG, 'candycfg/' .. basename(aH))
        end

        local aI, aJ = {}, {}

        for aK, aL in ipairs(aG)do
            if aL and aL ~= '' and not aI[aL] then
                aI[aL] = true

                table.insert(aJ, aL)
            end
        end

        return aJ
    end

    if ay then
        local aE = function(aE, aF)
            if isDefaultConfig(aE) then
                return
            end

            ensureCandyFolders()

            local aG = resolvePath(aE)

            if isDefaultConfig(aG) then
                return
            end

            local aH, aI = stripExt(basename(aG)):lower(), aG:match'%.cfg$' or aG:match'^candycfg/cfg/'

            if aI then
                if aH:match'^[0-9a-f]+%-[0-9a-f%-]+$' and #aH >= 20 then
                    return
                end
                if aH:match'^[0-9a-f]+$' and #aH >= 16 then
                    return
                end

                local aJ = aH:gsub('%-', ''):gsub('_', '')

                if #aJ >= 20 and aJ:match'^[0-9a-f]+$' then
                    return
                end
                if aH:find('neverlose', 1, true) then
                    return
                end
            end

            return ay(aG, aF)
        end

        writefile = aE

        if getgenv then
            getgenv().writefile = aE
        end
    end
    if aA then
        local aE = function(aE)
            if isDefaultConfig(aE) then
                return false
            end

            for aF, aG in ipairs(candidatePaths(aE))do
                if not isDefaultConfig(aG) and aA(aG) then
                    return true
                end
            end

            return false
        end

        isfile = aE

        if getgenv then
            getgenv().isfile = aE
        end
    end
    if az then
        local aE = function(aE)
            if isDefaultConfig(aE) then
                return nil
            end

            for aF, aG in ipairs(candidatePaths(aE))do
                if not isDefaultConfig(aG) and aA and aA(aG) then
                    return az(aG)
                end
            end

            local aF = resolvePath(aE)

            if not isDefaultConfig(aF) then
                return az(aF)
            end

            return nil
        end

        readfile = aE

        if getgenv then
            getgenv().readfile = aE
        end
    end

    local function isJunkConfigName(aE)
        local aF = stripExt(basename(normalizePath(aE or ''))):lower()

        if aF == '' or aF == 'default' then
            return aF == ''
        end
        if aF:match'^[0-9a-f]+%-[0-9a-f%-]+$' and #aF >= 20 then
            return true
        end
        if aF:match'^[0-9a-f]+$' and #aF >= 16 then
            return true
        end

        local aG = aF:gsub('%-', ''):gsub('_', '')

        if #aG >= 20 and aG:match'^[0-9a-f]+$' then
            return true
        end
        if aF:find('neverlose', 1, true) or aF:find('source', 1, true) and aF:find('lib', 1, true) then
            return true
        end
        if aF == 'neverlose_lib' or aF == 'neverlose_source' or aF == 'neverlose_source.luau' then
            return true
        end
        if aF:match'[%c]' then
            return true
        end
        if not aF:match'[%w]' then
            return true
        end

        return false
    end
    local function isValidUserConfigName(aE)
        local aF = stripExt(basename(normalizePath(aE or '')))

        if aF == '' then
            return false
        end

        local aG = aF:lower()

        if aG == 'default' then
            return false
        end
        if isJunkConfigName(aE) then
            return false
        end
        if not aF:match'^[%w%s%._%-]+$' then
            return false
        end
        if #aF > 48 then
            return false
        end

        return true
    end
    local function purgeJunkConfigs()
        if not aC or not aD then
            return
        end

        ensureCandyFolders()

        local aE, aF = pcall(aC, 'candycfg/cfg')

        if not aE or type(aF) ~= 'table' then
            return
        end

        for aG, aH in ipairs(aF)do
            local aI = normalizePath(aH)
            local aJ = basename(aI)

            if isJunkConfigName(aI) or (aI:match'%.cfg$' and not isValidUserConfigName(aI) and stripExt(aJ):lower() ~= 'default') then
                pcall(aD, aI)
            end
            if not aI:match'%.' and isJunkConfigName(aI) then
                pcall(aD, aI)
            end
        end
    end

    if aC then
        local aE = function(aE)
            aE = normalizePath(aE or '')

            local function filterCfgList(aF)
                local aG = {}

                for aH, aI in ipairs(aF)do
                    local aJ = normalizePath(aI)
                    local aK = basename(aJ)
                    local aL = aJ:match'%.cfg$' or (not aK:match'%.' and #aK > 0)

                    if aL and isValidUserConfigName(aJ) then
                        if not aJ:match'^candycfg/cfg/' then
                            aJ = 'candycfg/cfg/' .. stripExt(aK) .. '.cfg'
                        end

                        table.insert(aG, aJ)
                    end
                end

                return aG
            end

            if aE == 'candycfg' or aE == 'candycfg/' or aE == 'candycfg/json' or aE == 'candycfg/json/' or aE == 'candycfg/cfg' or aE == 'candycfg/cfg/' then
                ensureCandyFolders()
                purgeJunkConfigs()

                local aF, aG = pcall(aC, 'candycfg/cfg')

                if aF and type(aG) == 'table' then
                    return filterCfgList(aG)
                end

                return {}
            end

            return aC(aE)
        end

        listfiles = aE

        if getgenv then
            getgenv().listfiles = aE
        end
    end

    pcall(purgeJunkConfigs)

    if aD then
        local aE = function(aE)
            if isDefaultConfig(aE) then
                return
            end

            for aF, aG in ipairs(candidatePaths(aE))do
                if not isDefaultConfig(aG) then
                    pcall(aD, aG)
                end
            end
        end

        delfile = aE

        if getgenv then
            getgenv().delfile = aE
        end
    end
    if aB then
        local aE = function(aE)
            ensureCandyFolders()

            aE = normalizePath(aE or '')

            if aE == 'candycfg/json' then
                aE = 'candycfg/cfg'
            end

            return aB(aE)
        end

        makefolder = aE

        if getgenv then
            getgenv().makefolder = aE
        end
    end

    ensureCandyFolders()
end

local ay

do
    local az, aA, aB, aC = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Be1for/UI/refs/heads/main/candy/NLdef.lua', 'candycfg/data/CandyWare_UI.luau', {
        'candycfg/data/NeverLose_lib.luau',
        'candycfg/NeverLose_source.luau',
        'candycfg/cfg/NeverLose_source.cfg',
        'candycfg/NeverLose_source.cfg',
        'candycfg/cfg/NeverLose_source.luau',
        'candycfg/cfg/NeverLose_lib.cfg',
    }

    pcall(function()
        local aD = delfile or (getgenv and getgenv().delfile)

        if aD then
            for aE, aF in ipairs(aB)do
                pcall(aD, aF)
            end

            pcall(aD, aA)
        end
    end)

    local aD, aE = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(az)
    end)

    if aD and aE and aE ~= '' then
        aC = aE
    end
    if (not aC or aC == '') and readfile and isfile then
        pcall(function()
            if isfile(aA) then
                aC = readfile(aA)
            end
        end)
    end
    if not aC or aC == '' then
        error'[candy.cc] failed to load UI library'
    end

    pcall(function()
        if writefile then
            if makefolder then
                pcall(makefolder, 'candycfg')
                pcall(makefolder, 'candycfg/data')
            end

            writefile(aA, aC)
        end
    end)

    ay = loadstring(aC)()
end

pcall(function()
    local az, aA = listfiles or (getgenv and getgenv().listfiles), delfile or (getgenv and getgenv().delfile)

    if not az or not aA then
        return
    end

    local aB, aC = pcall(az, 'candycfg/cfg')

    if not aB or type(aC) ~= 'table' then
        return
    end

    for aD, aE in ipairs(aC)do
        local aF = tostring(aE):gsub('\\', '/'):match'([^/]+)$' or tostring(aE)
        local aG, aH = aF:gsub('%.cfg$', ''):lower(), false

        if aG:match'^[0-9a-f]+%-[0-9a-f%-]+$' and #aG >= 20 then
            aH = true
        end
        if aG:match'^[0-9a-f]+$' and #aG >= 16 then
            aH = true
        end

        local aI = aG:gsub('%-', ''):gsub('_', '')

        if #aI >= 20 and aI:match'^[0-9a-f]+$' then
            aH = true
        end
        if aG:find('neverlose', 1, true) then
            aH = true
        end
        if aH then
            pcall(aA, aE)
            pcall(aA, 'candycfg/cfg/' .. aF)
        end
    end
end)

local function candyware_ShouldAllowNotify(aB, aC, aD)
    if aD then
        return true
    end
    if not getgenv().candyware_MuteFeatureNotifications then
        return true
    end

    local aE, aF = string.lower(tostring(aB or '')), string.lower(tostring(aC or ''))

    if aE:find('gun drop', 1, true) or aF:find('gun is now available', 1, true) or aF:find('sheriff has died', 1, true) then
        return true
    end
    if (aE:find('candy ware', 1, true) or aE:find('candy.cc', 1, true)) and aF:find('loaded successfully', 1, true) then
        return true
    end

    return false
end

local aB = az.new

function az.new(aC)
    aC = aC or {}

    local aD, aE = aC.Title, aC.Content or aC.Description

    if not candyware_ShouldAllowNotify(aD, aE, aC.Force == true) then
        return nil
    end

    return aB(aC)
end

        aD = aD or {}

        local aE, aF = aD.Title or 'candy.cc', aD.Description or aD.Content or ''

        end

        az.new{
            Title = aE,
            Content = aF,
            Duration = aD.Time or aD.Duration or 5,

        }
    end,
    Unload = function()
        if getgenv().candyware_Cleanup then

        end
    end,
}

        if aI._element and aI._element.SetValue then
            pcall(function()
                aI._element:SetValue(aJ)
            end)
        end
    end
    function aH.GetValue(aI)
        if aI._element and aI._element.GetValue then
            local aJ, aK = pcall(function()
                return aI._element:GetValue()
            end)

            if aJ then
                aI.Value = aK
            end
        end

        return aI.Value
    end

    aD[aF] = aH

    return aH
end

local function __candyware_IsMobileDevice()
    local aG, aH, aI = false, true, false

    pcall(function()
        aG = e and e.TouchEnabled or false
        aH = e and e.KeyboardEnabled or false
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local aJ = (a and a.CurrentCamera) or (workspace and workspace.CurrentCamera)

        if aJ and aJ.ViewportSize and aJ.ViewportSize.X > 0 and aJ.ViewportSize.X < 850 then
            aI = true
        end
    end)

    if aG and not aH then
        return true
    end
    if aG and aI then
        return true
    end

    return aI and aG
end

                    end
                    if a0.DisplayName:lower():match('^' .. aX) then
                        return a0
                    end
                end

        end
    end

    local function BangWait()
        local bk = (p.Config and tonumber(p.Config.BangSpeed)) or 1

        if bk < 0.05 then
            bk = 0.05
        end

        return task.wait(0.03 / bk)
    end
    local function BangAmp()
        return (p.Config and tonumber(p.Config.BangAmplitude)) or 0.5
    end

    function bang(bk)
        coroutine.wrap(function()
            while true do
                if not (bk and bk.Character and bk.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart') then
                    aR = false

                    return
                end

                local bl, bm, bn = bk.Character.HumanoidRootPart, aZ.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', aZ.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                if bn then
                    bn.PlatformStand = true

                    if bm then
                        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Sit = false

                        for bo = 1, 8 do
                            if not aR then
                                break
                            end

                            CustomeTeleport(CFrame.new(0, 0, bo * BangAmp()))
                            BangWait()
                        end
                        for bo = 8, 1, -1 do
                            if not aR then
                                break
                            end

                            CustomeTeleport(CFrame.new(0, 0, bo * BangAmp()))
                            BangWait()
                        end
                    end
                end

                BangWait()

                if not aR then
                    return
                end
            end
        end)()
    end
    function CustomeTeleport(bk)
        local bl = u150(_G.playerName)

        if bl and bl.Character and bl.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' then
            local bm = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character

            if bm then
                bm = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'
            end
            if bm then
                bm.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                bm.CFrame = bl.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * bk
            end
        end
    end

                            local bq = aZ.Character

                            if bq then
                                bq = aZ.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'
                            end
                            if bq then
                                game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Sit = true

                                local br = BangAmp()

                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 1 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.5 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 2 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.5 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 3 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 3.5 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 4 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 3.5 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 3 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.5 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 2 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.5 * br))
                                BangWait()
                                suck(CFrame.new(0, 0, 1 * br))
                            end
                            if not following then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end)()
                    bp.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
                        following = false
                    end)
                    bp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(bq)
                        if following then
                            bq:WaitForChild'HumanoidRootPart'

                            if not bq:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' then
                                following = false
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            else
                _G.currentPlayer = nil
            end
        end,
    }

    function suck(bo)
        local bp = u198(_G.playerName, game.Players.LocalPlayer)

        if _G.playerName ~= '' then
            if bp and bp.Character and bp.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' then
                local bq, br = bp.Character.HumanoidRootPart, game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

                if bq and br then
                    br.CFrame = bq.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) * bo
                end
            end
        end
    end

            br, bs = bp(bq, br)

            if br == nil then

            end

            bs:Stop()
        end
    end

    function StartStand(bp, bq)
        if bp then
            getgenv().Stand = true

            local br = getgenv().StandSettings.Emote.Animation == 'jojo' and '13823324057' or (getgenv().StandSettings.Emote.Animation == 'Sit' and '12507085924' or (getgenv().StandSettings.Emote.Animation == 'Aura' and '10478338114' or (getgenv().StandSettings.Emote.Animation == 'zby' and '10214311282' or nil)))

            if br then
                u220(br)
            end

            repeat
                task.wait()
                pcall(function()
                    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    bo.TimePosition = getgenv().StandSettings.Emote.Animation == 'jojo' and 10 or (getgenv().StandSettings.Emote.Animation == 'Sit' and 7 or (getgenv().StandSettings.Emote.Animation == 'Aura' and 1.5 or (getgenv().StandSettings.Emote.Animation == 'zby' and 3 or 0)))

                    if getgenv().StandSettings.Pos.Height ~= 'Up' then
                        if getgenv().StandSettings.Pos.Height == 'Down' then
                            if getgenv().StandSettings.Pos.Position ~= 'Right' then
                                if getgenv().StandSettings.Pos.Position ~= 'Bottom' then
                                    if getgenv().StandSettings.Pos.Position == 'Left' then
                                        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = bq.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(
-3, 0.5, 2)
                                    end
                                else
                                    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = bq.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 2)
                                end
                            else
                                game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = bq.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(3, 0.5, 2)
                            end
                        end
                    elseif getgenv().StandSettings.Pos.Position ~= 'Right' then
                        if getgenv().StandSettings.Pos.Position ~= 'Bottom' then
                            if getgenv().StandSettings.Pos.Position == 'Left' then
                                game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = bq.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(
-3, 4, 2)
                            end
                        else
                            game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = bq.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 4, 2)
                        end
                    else
                        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = bq.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(3, 5, 2)
                    end
                end)
            until getgenv().Stand == false
        else
            getgenv().Stand = false

            u216()
        end
    end

    local function u231(bp, bq)
        if bp == '' or not bp then
            return nil
        end
        if bp:lower() == 'random' then
            local br = game:GetService'Players':GetPlayers()

        end

        local br, bs, bt = pairs(game:GetService'Players':GetPlayers())

        while true do
            local bu

            bt, bu = br(bs, bt)

            if bt == nil then
                break
            end
            if (bu.Name:lower():sub(1, #bp) == bp:lower() or bu.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #bp) == bp:lower()) and bu ~= bq then
                return bu
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function JerkStop()
        bs = false

        if bt then
            pcall(function()
                bt:Stop()
            end)

            bt = nil
        end
        if bu then
            pcall(function()
                bu:Destroy()
            end)

            bu = nil
        end
    end
    local function u360(bv)
        if not bv or not u356(bv) then
            return
        end
        if bs then
            JerkStop()
            task.wait()
        end

        bs = true

        local bw = bv.Character
        local bx = bw and bw:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'Humanoid'

        if not bx then
            bs = false

            return
        end

        bu = Instance.new'Animation'
        bu.AnimationId = 'rbxassetid://698251653'
        bt = bx:LoadAnimation(bu)

        pcall(function()
            bt.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
            bt.Looped = false
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while bs do
                if not bt or not bx or bx.Health <= 0 then
                    break
                end

                pcall(function()
                    bt:Play(0.1, 1, 0.7)
                    bt:AdjustSpeed((p.Config and tonumber(p.Config.JerkSpeed)) or 0.7)

                    bt.TimePosition = 0.6
                end)

                local by = os.clock()

                while bs and bt and bt.TimePosition < 0.7 and (os.clock() - by) < 1 do
                    task.wait()
                end

                if bt then
                    pcall(function()
                        bt:Stop(0.05)
                    end)
                end

                task.wait()
            end
        end)
        bx.Died:Connect(function()
            JerkStop()
        end)
    end

    local function RemoveJerkTool()
        local bB = game.Players.LocalPlayer

        if not bB then
            return
        end

        for bC, bD in ipairs{
            bB:FindFirstChild'Backpack',
            bB.Character,
        }do
            if bD then
                local bE = bD:FindFirstChild(by)

                if bE and bE:IsA'Tool' then
                    pcall(function()
                        bE:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        bz = nil
    end
    local function BindJerkTool(bB)
        if not bB or not bB:IsA'Tool' then
            return
        end

        bz = bB

        local function startJerkFromTool()
            if not bx then
                return
            end

            local bC = game.Players.LocalPlayer

            if not bC then
                return
            end

            u360(bC)
            SetJerkToggleUI(true)
        end
        local function stopJerkFromTool()
            JerkStop()
            SetJerkToggleUI(false)
        end

        bB.Equipped:Connect(function()
            startJerkFromTool()
        end)
        bB.Activated:Connect(function()
            startJerkFromTool()
        end)
        bB.Unequipped:Connect(function()
            stopJerkFromTool()
        end)
    end
    local function GiveJerkTool()
        local bB = game.Players.LocalPlayer

        if not bB then
            return
        end

        RemoveJerkTool()

        local bC = bB:FindFirstChild'Backpack' or bB:WaitForChild('Backpack', 5)

        if not bC then
            return
        end

        local bD = Instance.new'Tool'

        bD.Name = by
        bD.RequiresHandle = true
        bD.CanBeDropped = false
        bD.ManualActivationOnly = false
        bD.ToolTip = 'Jerk'

        pcall(function()
            bD.Grip = CFrame.new()
            bD.GripForward = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
            bD.GripRight = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
            bD.GripUp = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end)

        local bE = Instance.new'Part'

        bE.Name = 'Handle'
        bE.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
        bE.Transparency = 1
        bE.CanCollide = false
        bE.Massless = true
        bE.Anchored = false
        bE.Parent = bD
        bD.Parent = bC

        BindJerkTool(bD)
    end

    do
        local bC = aP:AddSection{

        }

        local function makeEmote(bD, bE)
            local bF, bG

            local function stopEmote()
                if bG then
                    bG:Stop()

                    bG = nil
                end

                bF = false

                if n and n.Character then
                    local bH = n.Character:FindFirstChild'Animate'

                    if bH then
                        bH.Disabled = false
                    end
                end
            end
            local function play()
                if bF then
                    return
                end

                local bH = n and n.Character
                local bI = bH and bH:FindFirstChild'Humanoid'

                if not bI then
                    return
                end

                local bJ = bH:FindFirstChild'Animate'

                if bJ then
                    bJ.Disabled = true
                end

                for bK, bL in pairs(bI:GetPlayingAnimationTracks())do
                    bL:Stop()
                end

                local bK = Instance.new'Animation'

                bK.AnimationId = 'rbxassetid://' .. bD
                bG = bI:LoadAnimation(bK)
                bG.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

                bG:Play()

                bF = true

                TrackConnection(bI.Running:Connect(function(bL)
                    if bL > 0 then
                        stopEmote()
                    end
                end))
                TrackConnection(bI.Jumping:Connect(function()
                    stopEmote()
                end))
                TrackConnection(bG.Stopped:Connect(function()
                    stopEmote()
                end))
            end

            bC:AddButton{
                Name = 'Play ' .. bE .. ' Emote',
                Callback = play,
            }
        end

        makeEmote('84112287597268', 'FD')
        makeEmote('122366279755346', 'KS')
        makeEmote('103788740211648', 'DS')
    end

__candyware_InitTroll(aL, aH)

do
    local aP = {
        target = nil,
        conn = nil,
        active = false,
    }

    local function CamLock_GetAimPart(aQ)
        if not aQ then
            return nil
        end

        local aR, aS, aT, aU = (p.Config and p.Config.CamLockAimPart) or 'HumanoidRootPart', aQ:FindFirstChild'Head', aQ:FindFirstChild'UpperTorso' or aQ:FindFirstChild'Torso', aQ:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

        if aR == 'Head' then
            return aS or aT or aU
        elseif aR == 'Torso' then
            return aT or aU or aS
        end

        return aU or aT or aS
    end
    local function CamLock_FindNearest()
        local aQ = F and F.CurrentCamera

        if not aQ then
            return nil
        end

        local aR = aQ.ViewportSize
        local aS, aT = Vector2.new(aR.X / 2, aR.Y / 2), tonumber(p.Config and p.Config.CamLockFOV) or 250

        if aT < 1 then
            aT = 1
        end

        local aU, aV = (math.huge)

        for aW, aX in ipairs(E:GetPlayers())do
            if aX ~= K then
                local aY = aX.Character
                local aZ, a_ = aY and aY:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid', CamLock_GetAimPart(aY)

                if a_ and aZ and aZ.Health > 0 then
                    local a0, a1 = aQ:WorldToViewportPoint(a_.Position)

                    if a1 and a0.Z > 0 then
                        local a2 = (aS - Vector2.new(a0.X, a0.Y)).Magnitude

                        if a2 <= aT and a2 < aU then
                            aU = a2
                            aV = a_
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return aV
    end

    function p.CamLock_GetTarget()
        return aP.target
    end
    function p.CamLock_IsActive()
        return aP.active and true or false
    end
    function p.ToggleCamLock(aQ)
        if aQ == nil then
            aQ = not aP.active
        else
            aQ = aQ and true or false
        end

        aP.active = aQ
        p.Config.CamLockEnabled = aQ

        if aP.conn then
            pcall(function()
                DisconnectConnection(aP.conn)
            end)

            aP.conn = nil
        end
        if not aQ then
            aP.target = nil

            pcall(function()
                if aD and aD.CamLockToggle then
                    aD.CamLockToggle.Value = false

                    if aD.CamLockToggle.SetValue then
                        aD.CamLockToggle:SetValue(false)
                    end
                end
            end)

            return
        end

        aP.target = CamLock_FindNearest()
        aP.conn = TrackConnection(G.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not p.Config.CamLockEnabled or not aP.active then
                return
            end

            local aR, aS = p.Config.CamLockSticky ~= false, aP.target

            if aR then
                if not aS or not aS.Parent then
                    aS = CamLock_FindNearest()
                    aP.target = aS
                else
                    local aT = aS.Parent

                    if aT and aT:IsA'Model' then
                        local aU = aT:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                        if not aU or aU.Health <= 0 then
                            aS = CamLock_FindNearest()
                            aP.target = aS
                        else
                            local aV = CamLock_GetAimPart(aT)

                            if aV and aV.Parent then
                                aS = aV
                                aP.target = aV
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                aS = CamLock_FindNearest()
                aP.target = aS
            end
            if not aS or not aS.Parent then
                return
            end

            local aT = F and F.CurrentCamera

            if not aT then
                return
            end

            local aU, aV = tonumber(p.Config.CamLockPrediction) or 0.207, tonumber(p.Config.CamLockSmooth)

            if aV == nil then
                aV = 0.35
            end

            aV = math.clamp(aV, 0, 1)

            local aW = Vector3.zero

            pcall(function()
                aW = aS.AssemblyLinearVelocity or aS.Velocity or Vector3.zero
            end)

            local aX = aS.Position + aW * aU
            local aY = CFrame.new(aT.CFrame.Position, aX)

            pcall(function()
                if aV <= 0.001 then
                    aT.CFrame = aY
                else
                    local aZ = 1 - math.clamp(aV, 0, 0.98)

                    aT.CFrame = aT.CFrame:Lerp(aY, aZ)
                end
            end)
        end))

        pcall(function()
            if aD and aD.CamLockToggle then
                aD.CamLockToggle.Value = true

                if aD.CamLockToggle.SetValue then
                    aD.CamLockToggle:SetValue(true)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local aQ, aR

    local function CamLock_DestroyFOV()
        if aR then
            pcall(function()
                DisconnectConnection(aR)
            end)

            aR = nil
        end
        if aQ then
            pcall(function()
                aQ.Visible = false

                aQ:Remove()
            end)

            aQ = nil
        end
    end
    local function CamLock_EnsureFOV()
        if aQ then
            return aQ
        end

        local aS, aT = pcall(function()
            return Drawing.new'Circle'
        end)

        if not aS or not aT then
            return nil
        end

        aT.Filled = false
        aT.NumSides = 64
        aT.Transparency = 1
        aT.Visible = false
        aT.ZIndex = 5
        aQ = aT

        return aT
    end

    function p.ToggleCamLockFOV(aS)
        if aS ~= nil then
            p.Config.CamLockShowFOV = aS and true or false
        end

        CamLock_DestroyFOV()

        if not p.Config.CamLockShowFOV then
            return
        end

        local aT = CamLock_EnsureFOV()

        if not aT then
            return
        end

        aR = TrackConnection(G.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not p.Config.CamLockShowFOV then
                if aQ then
                    aQ.Visible = false
                end

                return
            end

            local aU = F and F.CurrentCamera

            if not aU then
                if aQ then
                    aQ.Visible = false
                end

                return
            end

            local aV = CamLock_EnsureFOV()

            if not aV then
                return
            end

            local aW, aX, aY = aU.ViewportSize, tonumber(p.Config.CamLockFOV) or 250, p.Config.CamLockFOVColor

            if typeof(aY) ~= 'Color3' then
                aY = Color3.fromRGB(199, 110, 255)
            end

            local aZ, a_ = tonumber(p.Config.CamLockFOVThickness) or 1.5, tonumber(p.Config.CamLockFOVTransparency) or 0

            a_ = math.clamp(a_, 0, 1)

            local a0, a1 = p.Config.CamLockFOVFilled and true or false, tonumber(p.Config.CamLockFOVFillTransparency) or 0.85

            a1 = math.clamp(a1, 0, 1)
            aV.Position = Vector2.new(aW.X / 2, aW.Y / 2)
            aV.Radius = math.max(1, aX)
            aV.Color = aY
            aV.Thickness = aZ
            aV.Filled = a0

            if a0 then
                aV.Transparency = 1 - a1
            else
                aV.Transparency = 1 - a_
            end

            aV.Visible = true
        end))
    end
end

local aP, aQ = {
    GrabGunKey = 'G',
    SpeedGlitchKey = 'C',
    InvisKey = 'X',
    VoteMapKey = 'M',
    CamLockKey = 'Q',
    AutoGrabGunKey = 'B',
    FlingMurdererKey = 'F',
    FlingSheriffKey = 'Y',
}, {
    GrabGunKey = 'G',
    SpeedGlitchKey = 'C',
    InvisKey = 'X',
    VoteMapKey = 'M',
    CamLockKey = 'Q',
    AutoGrabGunKey = 'B',
    FlingMurdererKey = 'F',
    FlingSheriffKey = 'Y',
}

local function normalizeKeybind(aR)
    if aR == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local aS = typeof(aR)

    if aS == 'EnumItem' then
        return aR.Name
    end
    if aS == 'table' then
        if aR.Name ~= nil then
            return normalizeKeybind(aR.Name)
        end
        if aR.KeyCode ~= nil then
            return normalizeKeybind(aR.KeyCode)
        end
        if aR.Key ~= nil then
            return normalizeKeybind(aR.Key)
        end
        if aR.Value ~= nil then
            return normalizeKeybind(aR.Value)
        end
        if aR[1] ~= nil then
            return normalizeKeybind(aR[1])
        end

        return nil
    end

    local aT = tostring(aR)

    if aT == '' or aT == 'nil' or aT == 'None' or aT == 'none' or aT == 'nil value' then
        return nil
    end

    aT = aT:gsub('%s+', '')
    aT = aT:gsub('^Enum%.KeyCode%.', ''):gsub('^KeyCode%.', ''):gsub('^Enum%.UserInputType%.', '')

    local aU = aT:lower()

    if aU == 'mousebutton1' or aU == 'm1' or aU == 'lmb' or aU == 'button1' then
        return 'M1B'
    end
    if aU == 'mousebutton2' or aU == 'm2' or aU == 'rmb' or aU == 'button2' then
        return 'M2B'
    end

    aT = aT:gsub('["\']', '')

    if aT == '' then
        return nil
    end

    return aT
end
local function setKeybindAction(aR, aS, aT)
    aT = aT or aQ[aR] or 'G'

    local aU = normalizeKeybind(aS)

    if not aU then
        aU = aT
    end

    aP[aR] = aU

    if p and p.Config then
        p.Config[aR] = aU
    end

    return aU
end
local function getBoundKey(aR)
    local aS = normalizeKeybind(aP[aR])

    if aS then
        return aS
    end

    local aT

    pcall(function()
        local aU = ay and ay.Flags and ay.Flags[aR]

        if aU and aU.GetValue then
            aT = normalizeKeybind(aU:GetValue())
        end
    end)

    if aT then
        aP[aR] = aT

        return aT
    end
    if p and p.Config and p.Config[aR] then
        local aU = normalizeKeybind(p.Config[aR])

        if aU then
            aP[aR] = aU

            return aU
        end
    end

    local aU = aQ[aR] or 'G'

    aP[aR] = aU

    return aU
end
local function keyMatches(aR, aS)
    if not aS then
        return false
    end

    aR = normalizeKeybind(aR)

    if not aR then
        return false
    end
    if aR == 'M1B' then
        return aS.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    end
    if aR == 'M2B' then
        return aS.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
    end
    if aS.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        return false
    end
    if aS.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
        return false
    end

    local aT = aS.KeyCode.Name

    if not aT then
        return false
    end

    return aT == aR or aT:lower() == tostring(aR):lower()
end
local function isTypingInTextBox()
    local aR, aS = pcall(function()
        return H:GetFocusedTextBox()
    end)

    if not aR or not aS then
        return false
    end
    if not aS.Parent then
        return false
    end
    if aS.Visible == false then
        return false
    end

    local aT = aS.AbsoluteSize

    if aT and aT.X <= 0 and aT.Y <= 0 then
        return false
    end

    return true
end

local aR, aS

local function bindKeybindHandlers()
    if aR then
        pcall(function()
            if aR.Connected then
                aR:Disconnect()
            end
        end)

        aR = nil
    end
    if aS then
        pcall(function()
            if aS.Connected then
                aS:Disconnect()
            end
        end)

        aS = nil
    end

    aR = H.InputBegan:Connect(function(aT, aU)
        if isTypingInTextBox() then
            return
        end
        if keyMatches(getBoundKey'GrabGunKey', aT) then
            pcall(function()
                p.GrabGun()
            end)
        end
        if keyMatches(getBoundKey'SpeedGlitchKey', aT) then
            pcall(function()
                local aV = not p.Config.SpeedGlitch

                p.ToggleSpeedGlitch(aV)

                if aD and aD.SpeedGlitchToggle then
                    aD.SpeedGlitchToggle.Value = aV

                    if aD.SpeedGlitchToggle.SetValue then
                        pcall(function()
                            aD.SpeedGlitchToggle:SetValue(aV)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if keyMatches(getBoundKey'InvisKey', aT) then
            pcall(function()
                if p.ToggleInvisibility then
                    p.ToggleInvisibility()
                end
            end)
        end
        if keyMatches(getBoundKey'CamLockKey', aT) then
            pcall(function()
                if p.ToggleCamLock then
                    p.ToggleCamLock()
                end
            end)
        end
        if keyMatches(getBoundKey'VoteMapKey', aT) then
            pcall(function()
                if getgenv().candyware_VoteMap then
                    getgenv().candyware_VoteMap()
                end
            end)
        end
        if keyMatches(getBoundKey'AutoGrabGunKey', aT) then
            pcall(function()
                local aV = not (p.Config and p.Config.AutoGrabGun)

                if p.ToggleAutoGrabGun then
                    p.ToggleAutoGrabGun(aV)
                end
                if aD and aD.AutoGrabGunToggle then
                    aD.AutoGrabGunToggle.Value = aV

                    if aD.AutoGrabGunToggle.SetValue then
                        pcall(function()
                            aD.AutoGrabGunToggle:SetValue(aV)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if keyMatches(getBoundKey'FlingMurdererKey', aT) then
            pcall(function()
                p.FlingMurdererRuz()
            end)
        end
        if keyMatches(getBoundKey'FlingSheriffKey', aT) then
            pcall(function()
                p.FlingSheriffRuz()
            end)
        end
    end)
    aS = H.InputEnded:Connect(function(aT, aU) end)

    TrackConnection(aR)
    TrackConnection(aS)
end

bindKeybindHandlers()
task.spawn(function()
    for aT = 1, 10 do
        task.wait(0.3)

        for aU, aV in pairs(aQ)do
            pcall(function()
                getBoundKey(aU)
            end)
        end
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(4)

        local aT, aU = aR and aR.Connected, aS and aS.Connected

        if not aT or not aU then
            pcall(bindKeybindHandlers)
        end
    end
end)

getgenv().candyware_GetKeybind = getBoundKey
getgenv().candyware_KeybindActions = aP

function setKeybindAction(aT, aU, aV)
    local aW = getgenv().candyware_SetKeybind or _G.candyware_SetKeybind

    if type(aW) == 'function' then
        return aW(aT, aU, aV)
    end
end
