            end

            bh.FilterDescendantsInstances = bi

            local bo = workspace:Raycast(bk + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -(bl + 2), 0), bh)

            if bo then
                return bo.Position.Y
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function clamp_vel(bj)
            local bk, bl = bj.X, bj.Z
            local bm = math.sqrt(bk * bk + bl * bl)

            if bm > a5 then
                local bn = a5 / bm

                bk = bk * bn
                bl = bl * bn
            end

            return Vector3.new(bk, math.clamp(bj.Y, -a6, a6), bl)
        end
        local function engine_vel(bj)
            local bk, bl = pcall(function()
                return bj.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            end)

            if bk and typeof(bl) == 'Vector3' then
                return clamp_vel(bl)
            end

            return Vector3.zero
        end
        local function merge_vel(bj, bk, bl)
            if not bj then
                return bl
            end

            bj = clamp_vel(bj)

            local bm, bn = Vector3.new(bj.X, 0, bj.Z), Vector3.new(bl.X, 0, bl.Z)
            local bo, bp, bq = bm.Magnitude, bn.Magnitude, nil

            if bo < 1 and bp < 1 then
                bq = Vector3.zero
            elseif bp < 1 then
                bq = bm
            elseif bo < 1 then
                bq = bn
            elseif bm.Unit:Dot(bn.Unit) < 0.25 then
                bq = bm
            else
                bq = bn * 0.75 + bm * 0.25
            end

            local br

            if math.abs(bl.Y) > 0.5 then
                br = bl.Y
            elseif math.abs(bj.Y) > 1 then
                br = math.clamp(bj.Y - a4 * (bk or 0), -a6, a6)
            else
                br = 0
            end

            return Vector3.new(bq.X, br, bq.Z)
        end
        local function new_tracker()
            return {
                t = table.create(a7, 0),
                p = table.create(a7, Vector3.zero),
                n = 0,
                i = 0,
                part = nil,
                pos = nil,
                time = 0,
                vel = Vector3.zero,
                gap = 0.05,
                jitter = 0,
                ready = false,
                stab = 1,
                rest_gap = 3,
                rest_ready = false,
            }
        end
        local function snap_push(bj, bk, bl)
            bj.i = bj.i % a7 + 1
            bj.t[bj.i] = bk
            bj.p[bj.i] = bl

            if bj.n < a7 then
                bj.n = bj.n + 1
            end
        end
        local function snap_get(bj, bk)
            local bl = (bj.i - bk - 1) % a7 + 1

            return bj.t[bl], bj.p[bl]
        end
        local function fit_velocity(bj)
            if bj.n < 3 then
                return nil
            end

            local bk, bl, bm = snap_get(bj, 0), 0, 0

            for bn = 0, bj.n - 1 do
                local bo = snap_get(bj, bn)

                if bk - bo > a8 then
                    break
                end

                bl = bl + 1
                bm = bm + (bo - bk)
            end

            if bl < 3 then
                return nil
            end

            local bn, bo, bp = bm / bl, Vector3.zero, 0

            for bq = 0, bl - 1 do
                local br, bs = snap_get(bj, bq)
                local bt = (br - bk) - bn

                bo = bo + bs * bt
                bp = bp + bt * bt
            end

            if bp < 1e-8 then
                return nil
            end

            return bo / bp, -bn
        end
        local function path_stability(bj)
            if bj.n < 4 then
                return 1
            end

            local bk, bl = snap_get(bj, 0)
            local bm, bn, bo, bp = 0, bl, bl, 0

            for bq = 1, bj.n - 1 do
                local br, bs = snap_get(bj, bq)

                if bk - br > a9 then
                    break
                end

                local bt = bn - bs

                bm = bm + Vector3.new(bt.X, 0, bt.Z).Magnitude
                bn = bs
                bo = bs
                bp = bp + 1
            end

            if bp < 3 or bm < 1 then
                return 1
            end

            local bq = bl - bo

            return math.clamp(Vector3.new(bq.X, 0, bq.Z).Magnitude / bm, 0, 1)
        end
        local function tracker_seed(bj, bk, bl, bm)
            bj.part = bk
            bj.pos = bl
            bj.time = bm
            bj.vel = Vector3.zero
            bj.gap = 0.05
            bj.jitter = 0
            bj.ready = false
            bj.stab = 1
            bj.n = 0
            bj.i = 0

            snap_push(bj, bm, bl)
        end
        local function update_tracker(bj, bk, bl, bm)
            local bn = bl.Position

            if bl ~= bj.part or not bj.pos then
                tracker_seed(bj, bl, bn, bm)

                return
            end

            local bo, bp = bm - bj.time, (bn - bj.pos).Magnitude

            if bo > 0.75 or bp > 140 then
                tracker_seed(bj, bl, bn, bm)

                return
            end
            if bp < 0.004 or bo <= 0 then
                if bj.ready and bo > 0.12 and engine_vel(bl).Magnitude < 1 then
                    bj.vel = bj.vel * 0.6
                end

                return
            end

            local bq = bj.gap

            bj.gap = math.clamp(bq * 0.8 + bo * 0.2, 0.012, 0.25)
            bj.jitter = math.clamp(bj.jitter * 0.8 + math.abs(bo - bq) * 0.2, 0, 0.15)

            snap_push(bj, bm, bn)

            bj.pos = bn
            bj.time = bm

            local br, bs = fit_velocity(bj)
            local bt = merge_vel(br, bs, engine_vel(bl))

            if bj.ready then
                local bu, bv, bw = 0.45, Vector3.new(bj.vel.X, 0, bj.vel.Z), Vector3.new(bt.X, 0, bt.Z)

                if bv.Magnitude > 1 and bw.Magnitude > 1 and bv.Unit:Dot(bw.Unit) < 0.5 then
                    bu = 0.85
                end

                local bx, by, bz = bj.vel.X + (bt.X - bj.vel.X) * bu, bj.vel.Z + (bt.Z - bj.vel.Z) * bu, nil

                if math.abs(bt.Y) > 3 then
                    bz = bt.Y
                else
                    bz = bj.vel.Y + (bt.Y - bj.vel.Y) * 0.6
                end

                bj.vel = Vector3.new(bx, bz, by)
            else
                bj.vel = bt
                bj.ready = true
            end

            bj.stab = path_stability(bj)

            if math.abs(bt.Y) < 3 then
                local bu = ground_below(bk, bn, 12)

                if bu then
                    local bv = bn.Y - bu

                    if bv > 0.5 and bv < 8 then
                        if bj.rest_ready then
                            bj.rest_gap = bj.rest_gap * 0.85 + bv * 0.15
                        else
                            bj.rest_gap = bv
                            bj.rest_ready = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function clear_trackers()
            table.clear(bg)
        end

        local bj, bk = 0, false

        local function sample_ping()
            local bl, bm, bn = 0, pcall(function()
                return a0.Network.ServerStatsItem['Data Ping']:GetValue()
            end)

            if bm and type(bn) == 'number' then
                bl = bn
            end

            local bo = math.clamp(bl / 1000, 0, 1)

            if bk then
                bj = bj * 0.85 + bo * 0.15
            else
                bj = bo
                bk = true
            end
        end
        local function target_part_of(bl)
            if not bl then
                return nil
            end

            return bl:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or bl:FindFirstChild'UpperTorso' or bl:FindFirstChild'Torso' or bl:FindFirstChild'Head'
        end
        local function player_alive(bl)
            local bm = bl.Character

            if not bm then
                return false
            end

            local bn = bm:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

            if not bn or bn.Health <= 0 then
                return false
            end

            local bo = be and be.PlayerData

            if type(bo) == 'table' then
                local bp = bo[bl.Name]

                if bp and bp.Dead then
                    return false
                end
            end

            return true
        end
        local function update_trackers(bl)
            for bm in pairs(bg)do
                if bm.Parent ~= aZ then
                    bg[bm] = nil
                end
            end
            for bm, bn in ipairs(aZ:GetPlayers())do
                local bo = false

                repeat
                    if bn == a2 then
                        bo = true

                        break
                    end
                    if not player_alive(bn) then
                        bg[bn] = nil
                        bo = true

                        break
                    end

                    local bp = bn.Character
                    local bq = target_part_of(bp)

                    if not bq then
                        bg[bn] = nil
                        bo = true

                        break
                    end

                    local br = bg[bn]

                    if not br then
                        br = new_tracker()
                        bg[bn] = br
                    end

                    update_tracker(br, bp, bq, bl)

                    bo = true
                until true

                if not bo then
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local function pick_target()
            local bl = a2.Character
            local bm = bl and bl:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

            if not bm then
                return nil, nil, nil
            end

            local bn, bo, bp, bq, br = bm.Position, nil, nil, nil, a3.range

            for bs, bt in ipairs(aZ:GetPlayers())do
                local bu = false

                repeat
                    if bt == a2 then
                        bu = true

                        break
                    end
                    if not player_alive(bt) then
                        bu = true

                        break
                    end

                    local bv = bt.Character
                    local bw = target_part_of(bv)

                    if not bw then
                        bu = true

                        break
                    end

                    local bx = (bw.Position - bn).Magnitude

                    if bx <= br then
                        br = bx
                        bo = bv
                        bp = bw
                        bq = bg[bt]
                    end

                    bu = true
                until true

                if not bu then
                    break
                end
            end

            return bo, bp, bq
        end
        local function lead_offset(bl, bm, bn, bo)
            if not a3.predict or not bl or not bl.ready then
                return Vector3.zero
            end
            if bo <= 0 then
                return Vector3.zero
            end

            local bp, bq = bl.vel, math.clamp(bl.stab, 0.3, 1) * bo
            local br, bs, bt, bu = bp.X * bq, bp.Z * bq, bp.Y, 0
            local bv = math.max(24, math.abs(bt) * bo + bl.rest_gap + 12)
            local bw, bx = ground_below(bm, bn + Vector3.new(br, 0, bs), bv), nil

            if bw then
                local by = bw + bl.rest_gap

                if by <= bn.Y + 0.5 then
                    bx = by
                end
            end

            local by = math.abs(bt) < 3

            if by and bx then
                by = (bn.Y - bx) <= 1.5
            end
            if not by and math.abs(bt) < bd then
                local bz = bo * a3.air_scale

                bu = math.clamp(bt * bz - 0.5 * a4 * bz * bz, -bc, bc)
            end

            local bz = Vector3.new(br, bu, bs)

            if bz.Magnitude > bb then
                return Vector3.zero
            end
            if bx and bn.Y + bz.Y < bx then
                return Vector3.new(bz.X, bx - bn.Y, bz.Z)
            end

            return bz
        end
        local function throw_aim(bl, bm, bn, bo)
            local bp, bq = bn.Position, 0
            local br = bp

            for bs = 1, 3 do
                local bt = math.clamp(bj * a3.lead_scale + a3.lead_add + bq, 0, ba)

                br = bp + lead_offset(bl, bm, bp, bt)

                if not bo or a3.throw_speed <= 1 then
                    break
                end

                bq = math.clamp((br - bo).Magnitude / a3.throw_speed, 0, 0.7)
            end

            return br
        end
        local function get_knife()
            local bl = a2.Character

            if bl then
                local bm = bl:FindFirstChild'Knife'

                if bm then
                    return bm, true
                end
            end

            local bm = a2:FindFirstChildOfClass'Backpack'

            if bm then
                local bn = bm:FindFirstChild'Knife'

                if bn then
                    return bn, false
                end
            end

            return nil, false
        end
        local function knife_events()
            local bl = get_knife()

            if not bl then
                return nil
            end

            return bl:FindFirstChild'Events'
        end
        local function direct_kill(bl)
            if not bl or not bl.Parent then
                return false
            end

            local bm = knife_events()

            if not bm then
                return false
            end

            local bn, bo = bm:FindFirstChild'KnifeStabbed', bm:FindFirstChild'HandleTouched'

            if not bn or not bo then
                return false
            end

            local bp = pcall(function()
                bn:FireServer()
                bo:FireServer(bl)
            end)

            return bp
        end

        local bl

        local function clear_pending()
            bl = nil
        end
        local function projectile_position(bm)
            if not bm or not bm.Parent then
                return nil
            end
            if bm:IsA'BasePart' then
                return bm.Position
            end

            local bn = bm:FindFirstChild'BladePosition'

            if bn and bn:IsA'BasePart' then
                return bn.Position
            end

            local bo, bp = pcall(function()
                return bm:GetPivot()
            end)

            if bo and typeof(bp) == 'CFrame' then
                return bp.Position
            end

            local bq = bm:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'BasePart'

            if bq then
                return bq.Position
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function target_still_alive()
            if not bl then
                return false
            end

            local bm = bl.char

            if not bm or not bm.Parent then
                return false
            end

            local bn = bm:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

            if not bn or bn.Health <= 0 then
                return false
            end

            return true
        end
        local function resolve_impact()
            if not bl then
                return
            end
            if not target_still_alive() then
                clear_pending()

                return
            end

            local bm = bl.part

            if not bm or not bm.Parent then
                bm = target_part_of(bl.char)
                bl.part = bm
            end
            if not bm then
                clear_pending()

                return
            end

            local bn = bl.last_pos or bl.aim

            if bn and (bn - bm.Position).Magnitude <= a3.impact_radius then
                direct_kill(bm)
            end

            clear_pending()
        end
        local function adopt_projectile()
            if not bl or bl.knife then
                return
            end

            local bm = a2.Character
            local bn = bm and bm:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

            if not bn then
                return
            end

            local bo, bp = pcall(function()
                return a1:GetTagged'ThrowingKnife'
            end)

            if not bo or type(bp) ~= 'table' then
                return
            end

            local bq, br = 24

            for bs = 1, #bp do
                local bt = bp[bs]

                if bt and bt.Parent then
                    local bu = projectile_position(bt)

                    if bu then
                        local bv = (bu - bn.Position).Magnitude

                        if bv < bq then
                            bq = bv
                            br = bt
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if br then
                bl.knife = br
                bl.last_pos = projectile_position(br)
            end
        end
        local function segment_gap(bm, bn, bo)
            if not bm then
                return (bn - bo).Magnitude
            end

            local bp = bn - bm
            local bq = bp:Dot(bp)

            if bq < 1e-6 then
                return (bn - bo).Magnitude
            end

            local br = math.clamp((bo - bm):Dot(bp) / bq, 0, 1)

            return (bm + bp * br - bo).Magnitude
        end
        local function pending_part()
            if not bl then
                return nil
            end

            local bm = bl.part

            if not bm or not bm.Parent then
                bm = target_part_of(bl.char)
                bl.part = bm
            end

            return bm
        end
        local function try_flyby(bm)
            if not bl or bl.fired then
                return
            end

            local bn = pending_part()

            if not bn then
                return
            end
            if segment_gap(bl.last_pos, bm, bn.Position) > a3.impact_radius then
                return
            end
            if direct_kill(bn) then
                bl.fired = true
            end
        end
        local function watch_pending(bm)
            if not bl then
                return
            end
            if bm - bl.time > 6 then
                clear_pending()

                return
            end
            if not target_still_alive() then
                clear_pending()

                return
            end

            adopt_projectile()

            local bn = bl.knife

            if not bn then
                if bm - bl.time > 1 then
                    clear_pending()
                end

                return
            end
            if bn.Parent then
                local bo = projectile_position(bn)

                if bo then
                    try_flyby(bo)

                    bl.last_pos = bo
                end

                bl.gone_at = nil

                return
            end
            if not bl.gone_at then
                bl.gone_at = bm

                return
            end

            resolve_impact()
        end
        local function refresh_role()
            if not be then
                local bm, bn = pcall(function()
                    return require(aY:WaitForChild'Modules':WaitForChild'CurrentRoundClient')
                end)

                if bm and type(bn) == 'table' then
                    be = bn
                end
            end

            local bm = be and be.PlayerData

            if type(bm) == 'table' then
                local bn = bm[a2.Name]

                if bn then
                    bf = bn.Role == 'Murderer' and not bn.Dead

                    return
                end
            end

            bf = get_knife() ~= nil
        end
        local function resolve_throw_aim()
            if not a3.silent then
                return nil
            end

            local bm = a2.Character

            if not bm or not bm:FindFirstChild'Knife' then
                return nil
            end

            local bn, bo, bp = pick_target()

            if not bo then
                return nil
            end

            local bq = bm:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'
            local br = bq and bq.Position or nil
            local bs = throw_aim(bp, bn, bo, br)

            if a3.instance_kill then
                bl = {
                    char = bn,
                    part = bo,
                    time = os.clock(),
                    aim = bs,
                    knife = nil,
                    last_pos = nil,
                    gone_at = nil,
                    fired = false,
                }
            else
                clear_pending()
            end

            return CFrame.new(bs)
        end

        getgenv().KNIFE_AIM_RESOLVE = function()
            local bm, bn = pcall(resolve_throw_aim)

            if bm then
                return bn
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function ensure_hooks()
            local bm = getgenv().SILENT_INSTALL_HOOKS

            if type(bm) == 'function' then
                pcall(bm)
            end
        end

        local bm, bn, bo = 0, 0, 0

        local function tick()
            if not (a3.silent or bl) then
                return
            end

            local bp = os.clock()

            if bp >= bm then
                bm = bp + 0.25

                refresh_role()
            end
            if bp >= bn then
                bn = bp + 0.25

                sample_ping()
            end
            if bp >= bo then
                bo = bp + 1

                ensure_hooks()
            end

            update_trackers(bp)
            watch_pending(bp)
        end

        local bp, bq = a_.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            pcall(tick)
        end), aU:AddLabel'Throw Silent'

                        ensure_hooks()
                        refresh_role()
                    end)
                else
                    clear_trackers()
                    clear_pending()
                end
            end,
        }

        getgenv().KNIFE_UNLOAD = function()
            a3.silent = false
            a3.predict = false
            a3.instance_kill = false

            pcall(function()
                if knife_ind then
                    knife_ind:Set(false)
                end
            end)
            clear_trackers()
            clear_pending()

            getgenv().KNIFE_AIM_RESOLVE = nil

            if bp then
                pcall(function()
                    bp:Disconnect()
                end)

                bp = nil
            end
        end

        local function cleanName(ba)
            local bb = tostring(ba):gsub('%s*%b()%s*$', '')

            return bb:match'^%s*(.-)%s*$' or bb
        end
        local function getCleanNameLower(ba)
            if a6[ba] then
                return a6[ba]
            end

            local bb = cleanName(ba):lower()

            a6[ba] = bb

            return bb
        end

        local ba = {}

        local function getRarity(bb)
            if not bb then
                return 'unknown'
            end

            local bc, bd, be = math.round(bb.R * 255), math.round(bb.G * 255), math.round(bb.B * 255)
            local bf = bc .. ',' .. bd .. ',' .. be

            if ba[bf] then
                return ba[bf]
            end

            local bg, bh = 'unknown', math.huge

            for bi, bj in pairs(a9)do
                local bk, bl, bm = math.round(bj.R * 255), math.round(bj.G * 255), math.round(bj.B * 255)
                local bn = (bc - bk) ^ 2 + (bd - bl) ^ 2 + (be - bm) ^ 2

                if bn < bh then
                    bh = bn
                    bg = bi
                end
            end

            local bi = (bh < 225) and bg or 'unknown'

            ba[bf] = bi

            return bi
        end

                    if bf and type(bg) == 'table' then

                                for bg, bh in pairs(be)do
                                    local bi = bd .. '_' .. bg

                                    a3[bi] = bh
                                    a4[bi:lower()] = bh
                                end
                            else
                                flattenPrices(be)
                            end
                        else
                            a5[bd:lower()] = true
                            a5[cleanName(bd):lower()] = true
                            a3[bd] = be
                            a4[bd:lower()] = be
                        end
                    end
                end

                flattenPrices(bb)

                a7 = true
            end
        end)

        local function getPrice(bb, bc)
            if not bb or bb == '' then
                return nil
            end

            local bd = cleanName(bb)
            local be = {
                bd .. '_' .. bc,
                bb .. '_' .. bc,
                bd .. '_unknown',
                bd,
                bb,
            }

            for bf, bg in ipairs(be)do
                if a3[bg] ~= nil then
                    return a3[bg]
                end
                if a4[bg:lower()] ~= nil then
                    return a4[bg:lower()]
                end
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function updatePriceTag(bb, bc)
            local bd = bb.Parent

            if not bd then
                return
            end

            local be = bd.Parent

            if not be or not be:IsA'GuiObject' or be.AbsoluteSize.X > 350 or be.AbsoluteSize.Y > 350 then
                be = bd
            end

            local bf = be:FindFirstChild'MM2_PriceTag'

            if not bf then
                bf = Instance.new'TextLabel'
                bf.Name = 'MM2_PriceTag'
                bf.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
                bf.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
                bf.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                bf.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
                bf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                bf.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                bf.TextSize = 16
                bf.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                bf.ZIndex = 100
                bf.BorderSizePixel = 0
                bf.Parent = be
            end

            local bg, bh

            if type(bc) == 'number' then
                bg = bc == 0 and '0' or tostring(bc)
                bh = bc == 0 and Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
            elseif type(bc) == 'string' then
                bg = bc

    local function normalizeKeybind(a1)
        if a1 == nil then
            return nil
        end
        if typeof(a1) == 'EnumItem' then
            return a1.Name
        end

        local a2 = tostring(a1)

        a2 = a2:gsub('^Enum%.KeyCode%.', ''):gsub('^KeyCode%.', '')

        if a2:find'MouseButton1' or a2 == 'MouseButton1' or a2 == 'M1' or a2 == 'LMB' then
            return 'M1B'
        end
        if a2:find'MouseButton2' or a2 == 'MouseButton2' or a2 == 'M2' or a2 == 'RMB' then
            return 'M2B'
        end

        return a2
    end
    local function setKeybindAction(a1, a2, a3)
        local a4 = normalizeKeybind(a2) or a3

        a0[a1] = a4

        return a4
    end
    local function keyMatches(a1, a2)
        if not a1 or not a2 then
            return false
        end

        a1 = normalizeKeybind(a1)

        if not a1 then
            return false
        end
        if a1 == 'M1B' then
            return a2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        end
        if a1 == 'M2B' then
            return a2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
        end
        if a2.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            return false
        end

        local a3 = a2.KeyCode.Name

        return a3 == a1 or a3:lower() == a1:lower()
    end
    local function isTypingInTextBox()
        local a1, a2 = pcall(function()
            return e:GetFocusedTextBox()
        end)

        if not a1 or not a2 then
            return false
        end
        if not a2.Parent then
            return false
        end
        if a2.Visible == false then
            return false
        end

        local a3 = a2.AbsoluteSize

        if a3 and a3.X <= 0 and a3.Y <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        return true
    end

    local function bindKeybindHandlers()
        if a1 then
            pcall(function()
                if a1.Connected then
                    a1:Disconnect()
                end
            end)

            a1 = nil
        end
        if a2 then

                if a2.Connected then
                    a2:Disconnect()
                end
            end)

            a2 = nil

                    p.WallBangShoot()

                pcall(function()
                    p.SetPredictionESPVisible(true)
                end)
            end
        end)
        a2 = e.InputEnded:Connect(function(a3, a4)
            if keyMatches(a0.PredictionESPKey, a3) then
                if p.Config and not p.Config.PredictionESPAlways then
                    pcall(function()
                        p.SetPredictionESPVisible(false)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)

        TrackConnection(a1)
        TrackConnection(a2)
    end

        end
    end)

    local bc = aK:AddSection{
        Name = 'CHINA HAT',
        Position = 'left',
    }

    do
        local bd, be = makeToggleProxy('HatToggle', false), bc:AddLabel'China Hat'

        local function hatReadOpt(bf, bg)
            local bh = aE and aE[bf]

            if not bh then
                return bg
            end
            if bh.GetValue then
                local bi, bj = pcall(function()
                    return bh:GetValue()
                end)

                if bi and bj ~= nil then
                    return bj
                end
            end
            if bh.Value ~= nil then
                return bh.Value
            end

            return bg
        end
        local function hatReadToggle(bf, bg)
            local bh = aD and aD[bf]

            if not bh then
                return bg and true or false
            end
            if bh.GetValue then
                local bi, bj = pcall(function()
                    return bh:GetValue()
                end)

                if bi and bj ~= nil then
                    return bj and true or false
                end
            end

            return bh.Value and true or false
        end
        local function hatSyncVarsFromFlags()
            if not ax.HatVariables then
                return
            end

            local bf = ax.HatVariables
            local bg = hatReadOpt('HatTransparency', bf.transparency)

            if typeof(bg) == 'number' then
                bf.transparency = math.clamp(bg, 0, 1)
            end

            local bh = hatReadOpt('HatRadius', bf.radius)

            if typeof(bh) == 'number' then
                bf.radius = bh
            end

            local bi = hatReadOpt('HatHeight', bf.height)

            if typeof(bi) == 'number' then
                bf.height = bi
            end

            local bj = hatReadOpt('HatReflectance', bf.reflectance)

            if typeof(bj) == 'number' then
                bf.reflectance = bj
            end

            local bk = hatReadOpt('HatRainbowSpeed', bf.rainbowSpeed)

            if typeof(bk) == 'number' then
                bf.rainbowSpeed = bk
            end

            local bl = hatReadOpt('HatColor', bf.color)

            if typeof(bl) == 'Color3' then
                bf.color = bl
            end

            bf.rainbow = hatReadToggle('HatRainbow', bf.rainbow)
        end

        do
            local bf = bd.SetValue

            function bd.SetValue(bg, bh)
                if bf then
                    bf(bg, bh)
                else
                    bg.Value = bh
                end

                local bi = bh and true or false

                hatSyncVarsFromFlags()

                if ax.Hat_ToggleEnabled then
                    pcall(ax.Hat_ToggleEnabled, bi)
                end
            end
        end

        be:AddToggle{
            Default = false,
            Flag = 'HatToggle',
            Callback = function(bf)
                bd.Value = bf

                hatSyncVarsFromFlags()

                if ax.Hat_ToggleEnabled then
                    ax.Hat_ToggleEnabled(bf)
                end
            end,
        }

    local bg = aK:AddSection{
        Name = 'HIT EFFECT',
        Position = 'right',
    }

    do
        local bh = {
            enabled = false,
            duration = 5,
            fadeTime = 1.8,
            color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255),
            conns = {},
            playerConns = {},
            active = {},
            recent = {},
        }

        local function DeathFF_CleanupClone(bi)
            if not bi then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                if bi.Parent then
                    bi:Destroy()
                end
            end)
        end
        local function DeathFF_FadeOut(bi)
            if not bi or not bi.Parent then
                DeathFF_CleanupClone(bi)

                return
            end

            local bj, bk, bl = math.clamp(tonumber(bh.fadeTime) or 1.8, 0.3, 8), {}, {}

            pcall(function()
                for bm, bn in ipairs(bi:GetDescendants())do
                    if bn:IsA'BasePart' then
                        table.insert(bk, bn)
                    elseif bn:IsA'Decal' or bn:IsA'Texture' then
                        table.insert(bl, bn)
                    end
                end
            end)

            local bm = TweenInfo.new(bj, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

            for bn, bo in ipairs(bk)do
                pcall(function()
                    f:Create(bo, bm, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
                end)
            end
            for bn, bo in ipairs(bl)do
                pcall(function()
                    f:Create(bo, bm, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
                end)
            end

            task.delay(bj + 0.05, function()
                DeathFF_CleanupClone(bi)
            end)
        end
        local function DeathFF_ClearAll()
            for bi, bj in pairs(bh.active)do
                DeathFF_CleanupClone(bj)
            end

            bh.active = {}
            bh.recent = {}
        end
        local function DeathFF_SpawnAt(bi, bj)
            if not bh.enabled then
                return
            end
            if not bj then
                return
            end

            local bk, bl = bi and bi.UserId or 0, os.clock()

            if bh.recent[bk] and (bl - bh.recent[bk]) < 1.5 then
                return
            end

            bh.recent[bk] = bl

            local bm = bj:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or bj:FindFirstChild'Torso' or bj.PrimaryPart

            if not bm then
                return
            end

            local bn, bo = (bm.CFrame)

            pcall(function()
                bj.Archivable = true
                bo = bj:Clone()
                bj.Archivable = false
            end)

            if not bo and bi then
                pcall(function()
                    local bp = E:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(bi.UserId)

                    if bp then
                        bo = E:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(bp, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not bo then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                for bp, bq in ipairs(bo:GetDescendants())do
                    if bq:IsA'BaseScript' or bq:IsA'LocalScript' or bq:IsA'Script' or bq:IsA'Animator' or bq:IsA'Sound' or bq:IsA'Fire' or bq:IsA'Smoke' or bq:IsA'ParticleEmitter' then
                        bq:Destroy()
                    elseif bq:IsA'BasePart' then
                        bq.Anchored = true
                        bq.CanCollide = false
                        bq.CanQuery = false
                        bq.CanTouch = false
                        bq.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                        bq.Color = bh.color or Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255)

                        if bq.Name == 'HumanoidRootPart' then
                            bq.Transparency = 1
                        elseif bq.Transparency < 0.2 then
                            bq.Transparency = 0.2
                        end

                        pcall(function()
                            bq.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            bq.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        end)
                    elseif bq:IsA'Humanoid' then
                        bq:Destroy()
                    elseif bq:IsA'Highlight' or bq:IsA'BillboardGui' or bq:IsA'ForceField' then
                        bq:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                for bp, bq in ipairs(bo:GetDescendants())do
                    if bq:IsA'ForceField' or bq:IsA'Highlight' or bq:IsA'BillboardGui' or bq.Name == 'CandyHighlight' or bq.Name == 'CandyInfoESP' or bq.Name == 'CandyGunHighlight' or bq.Name == 'CandyGunInfo' then
                        bq:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                for bp, bq in ipairs(bo:GetChildren())do
                    if bq:IsA'Highlight' or bq:IsA'BillboardGui' or bq:IsA'Humanoid' or bq.Name == 'CandyHighlight' or bq.Name == 'CandyInfoESP' then
                        bq:Destroy()
                    end
                end

                bo.Name = 'HitEffect_' .. (bi and bi.Name or 'Unknown')

                pcall(function()
                    bo:SetAttribute('IsHitEffect', true)
                    bo:SetAttribute('NoESP', true)
                end)

                if bo.PrimaryPart then
                    bo:PivotTo(bn)
                else
                    local bp = bo:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or bo:FindFirstChildWhichIsA'BasePart'

                    if bp then
                        bp.CFrame = bn
                    end
                end

                bo.Parent = F

                if bi and A and A[bi] then
                    pcall(function()
                        A[bi].Box.Visible = false
                        A[bi].Tracer.Visible = false

                        for bp, bq in ipairs(A[bi].Skeleton or {})do
                            bq.Visible = false
                        end

                        if A[bi].HealthBar then
                            A[bi].HealthBar.Visible = false
                        end
                        if A[bi].HealthBarOutline then
                            A[bi].HealthBarOutline.Visible = false
                        end
                    end)
                end
                if bj then
                    pcall(function()
                        for bp, bq in ipairs(bj:GetChildren())do
                            if bq:IsA'Highlight' or bq.Name == 'CandyHighlight' or bq.Name == 'CandyInfoESP' then
                                bq:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            table.insert(bh.active, bo)

            local bp = math.clamp(tonumber(bh.duration) or 5, 0.5, 60)

            task.delay(bp, function()
                DeathFF_FadeOut(bo)

                for bq = #bh.active, 1, -1 do
                    if bh.active[bq] == bo then
                        table.remove(bh.active, bq)

                        break
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local function DeathFF_HookCharacter(bi, bj)
            if not bj then
                return
            end

            local bk = bj:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

            if not bk then
                bk = bj:WaitForChild('Humanoid', 5)
            end
            if not bk then
                return
            end

            local bl

            bl = bk.Died:Connect(function()
                pcall(function()
                    DeathFF_SpawnAt(bi, bj)
                end)
            end)

            table.insert(bh.conns, bl)

            local bm

            bm = bj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(bn, bo)
                if bo == nil and bh.enabled then
                    pcall(function()
                        if bk and bk.Health <= 0 then
                            DeathFF_SpawnAt(bi, bj)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)

            table.insert(bh.conns, bm)
        end
        local function DeathFF_HookPlayer(bi)
            if not bi or bi == K then
            end
            if bh.playerConns[bi] then
                return
            end

            local bj = {}

            if bi.Character then
                task.spawn(function()
                    DeathFF_HookCharacter(bi, bi.Character)
                end)
            end

            bj.charAdded = bi.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(bk)
                if not bh.enabled then
                    return
                end

                task.defer(function()
                    DeathFF_HookCharacter(bi, bk)
                end)
            end)
            bh.playerConns[bi] = bj

            table.insert(bh.conns, bj.charAdded)
        end
        local function DeathFF_DisconnectAll()
            for bi, bj in ipairs(bh.conns)do
                pcall(function()
                    if bj and bj.Disconnect then
                        bj:Disconnect()
                    end
                end)
            end

            bh.conns = {}
            bh.playerConns = {}

            DeathFF_ClearAll()
        end
        local function DeathFF_SetEnabled(bi)
            bh.enabled = bi and true or false

            DeathFF_DisconnectAll()

            if bi then
                for bj, bk in ipairs(E:GetPlayers())do
                    DeathFF_HookPlayer(bk)
                end

                local bj = E.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(bj)
                    if not bh.enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    DeathFF_HookPlayer(bj)
                end)

                table.insert(bh.conns, bj)

                local bk = E.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(bk)
                    bh.playerConns[bk] = nil
                end)

                table.insert(bh.conns, bk)
                TrackConnection(bj)
                TrackConnection(bk)
            end
        end

        local bi, bj = makeToggleProxy('HitEffectEnabled', false), bg:AddLabel'Hit Effect'

        bj:AddToggle{
            Default = false,
            Flag = 'HitEffectEnabled',
            Callback = function(bk)
                bi.Value = bk

                DeathFF_SetEnabled(bk)
            end,
        }

        local bk, bl = bj:AddOption(), makeOptionProxy('HitEffectDuration', 5)

        bk:AddLabel'Duration (sec)':AddSlider{

            Flag = 'HitEffectFade',
            Size = 80,
            Callback = function(bn)
                bm.Value = bn
                bh.fadeTime = bn

        }

        local bn = makeOptionProxy('HitEffectColor', Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))

        bk:AddLabel'Hit Effect Color':AddColorPicker{
            Default = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

    local bi = aK:AddSection{
        Name = 'JUMP CIRCLE',
        Position = 'right',
    }

    do
        local bj = {
            enabled = false,
            conns = {},
            charConn = nil,
            folder = nil,
        }

        local function jcGetFolder()
            if bj.folder and bj.folder.Parent then
                return bj.folder
            end

            local bk = a:FindFirstChild'CandyJumpCircles'

            if not bk then
                bk = Instance.new'Folder'
                bk.Name = 'CandyJumpCircles'
                bk.Parent = a
            end

            bj.folder = bk

            return bk
        end
        local function jcClearAll()
            local bk = jcGetFolder()

            for bl, bm in ipairs(bk:GetChildren())do
                pcall(function()
                    bm:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
        local function jcFindFloor(bk, bl)
            local bm = RaycastParams.new()

            bm.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            bm.FilterDescendantsInstances = bl or {}
            bm.IgnoreWater = true

            local bn, bo = tonumber(p.Config.JumpCircleMaxRayDist) or 15, tonumber(p.Config.JumpCircleRingLift) or 0.1
            local bp = a:Raycast(bk.Position, Vector3.new(0, -bn, 0), bm)

            if bp then
                return bp.Position + Vector3.new(0, bo, 0)
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function jcSpawnRing(bk)
            if not p.Config.JumpCircleEnabled then
                return
            end

            local bl, bm = jcGetFolder(), Instance.new'Model'

            bm.Name = 'JumpRing'
            bm.Parent = bl

            local bn = Instance.new'Part'

            bn.Name = 'Center'
            bn.Anchored = true
            bn.CanCollide = false
            bn.CanQuery = false
            bn.CanTouch = false
            bn.CastShadow = false
            bn.Transparency = 1
            bn.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
            bn.CFrame = CFrame.new(bk)
            bn.Parent = bm

            local bo, bp, bq, br, bs, bt, bu = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(p.Config.JumpCircleSegments) or 64), 16, 128), tonumber(p.Config.JumpCircleStartRadius) or 0.8, tonumber(p.Config.JumpCircleEndRadius) or 3.5, tonumber(p.Config.JumpCircleThickness) or 0.18, tonumber(p.Config.JumpCircleExpandTime) or 0.7, tonumber(p.Config.JumpCircleStartAlpha) or 0.15, (typeof(p.Config.JumpCircleColor) == 'Color3') and p.Config.JumpCircleColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            local bv = 2 * math.pi * bp
            local bw, bx = (bv / bo) * 1.5, {}

            for by = 1, bo do
                local bz, bA = (by / bo) * math.pi * 2, Instance.new'Part'

                bA.Name = 'Seg'
                bA.Anchored = true
                bA.CanCollide = false
                bA.CanQuery = false
                bA.CanTouch = false
                bA.CastShadow = false
                bA.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                bA.Color = bu
                bA.Transparency = bt
                bA.Size = Vector3.new(bw, 0.02, br)
                bA.Parent = bm

                local bB, bC = bn.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.cos(bz) * bp, 0, math.sin(bz) * bp), bz + math.pi / 2

                bA.CFrame = CFrame.new(bB.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, -bC, 0)
                bx[by] = {
                    part = bA,
                    angle = bz,
                }
            end

            local by, bz = TweenInfo.new(bs, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), 2 * math.pi * bq
            local bA = (bz / bo) * 1.5

            for bB, bC in ipairs(bx)do
                local bD = bC.angle
                local bE, bF = bn.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.cos(bD) * bq, 0, math.sin(bD) * bq), bD + math.pi / 2
                local bG = CFrame.new(bE.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, -bF, 0)

                f:Create(bC.part, by, {
                    CFrame = bG,
                    Size = Vector3.new(bA, 0.02, br),
                    Transparency = 1,
                }):Play()
            end

            task.delay(bs + 0.3, function()
                if bm and bm.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        bm:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
        local function jcHookHumanoid(bk, bl)
            if not bk or not bl then
                return
            end

            local bm, bn = bk.Parent, true
            local bo = bk.StateChanged:Connect(function(bo, bp)
                if not p.Config.JumpCircleEnabled then
                    return
                end
                if bp == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and bo ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and bn then
                    bn = false

                    local bq = {
                        bm,
                        jcGetFolder(),
                    }
                    local br = jcFindFloor(bl.CFrame, bq)

                    if br then
                        jcSpawnRing(br)
                    end
                end
                if bp == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or bp == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or bp == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics then
                    bn = true
                end
            end)

            table.insert(bj.conns, bo)
            TrackConnection(bo)
        end
        local function jcOnCharacter(bk)
            if not bk then
                return
            end

            local bl, bm = bk:WaitForChild('Humanoid', 8), bk:WaitForChild('HumanoidRootPart', 8)

            if bl and bm then
                jcHookHumanoid(bl, bm)
            end
        end
        local function jcEnable()
            bj.enabled = true
            p.Config.JumpCircleEnabled = true

            for bk, bl in ipairs(bj.conns)do
                pcall(function()
                    if typeof(bl) == 'RBXScriptConnection' and bl.Connected then
                        bl:Disconnect()
                    end
                end)
            end

            bj.conns = {}

            if bj.charConn then
                pcall(function()
                    if bj.charConn.Connected then
                        bj.charConn:Disconnect()
                    end
                end)

                bj.charConn = nil
            end
            if n and n.Character then
                jcOnCharacter(n.Character)
            end
            if n then
                bj.charConn = n.CharacterAdded:Connect(jcOnCharacter)

                TrackConnection(bj.charConn)
            end
        end
        local function jcDisable()
            bj.enabled = false
            p.Config.JumpCircleEnabled = false

            for bk, bl in ipairs(bj.conns)do
                pcall(function()
                    if typeof(bl) == 'RBXScriptConnection' and bl.Connected then
                        bl:Disconnect()
                    end
                end)
            end

            bj.conns = {}

            if bj.charConn then
                pcall(function()
                    if bj.charConn.Connected then
                        bj.charConn:Disconnect()
                    end
                end)

                bj.charConn = nil
            end

            jcClearAll()
        end

        function p.ToggleJumpCircle(bk)
            if bk ~= nil then
                if bk then
                    jcEnable()
                else
                    jcDisable()
                end
            else
                if p.Config.JumpCircleEnabled then
                    jcDisable()
                else
                    jcEnable()
                end
            end

            return p.Config.JumpCircleEnabled
        end

        local bk, bl = makeToggleProxy('JumpCircleEnabled', false), bi:AddLabel'Jump Circle'

        bl:AddToggle{
            Default = false,
            Flag = 'JumpCircleEnabled',
            Callback = function(bm)
                bk.Value = bm

                p.ToggleJumpCircle(bm)
            end,
        }

        local bm, bn = bl:AddOption(), makeOptionProxy('JumpCircleColor', Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))

        bm:AddLabel'Ring Color':AddColorPicker{

            Flag = 'JumpCircleColor',

                p.Config.JumpCircleColor = bo

        }

        local bo = makeOptionProxy('JumpCircleStartRadius', 0.8)

        bm:AddLabel'Start Radius':AddSlider{

            Max = 5,
            Rounding = 2,
            Flag = 'JumpCircleStartRadius',

            Callback = function(bp)
                bo.Value = bp
                p.Config.JumpCircleStartRadius = bp
            end,
        }

        local bp = makeOptionProxy('JumpCircleEndRadius', 3.5)

        bm:AddLabel'End Radius':AddSlider{
            Default = 3.5,
            Min = 1,
            Max = 12,
            Rounding = 2,
            Flag = 'JumpCircleEndRadius',
            Size = 80,
            Callback = function(bq)
                bp.Value = bq
                p.Config.JumpCircleEndRadius = bq
            end,
        }

        local bq = makeOptionProxy('JumpCircleThickness', 0.18)

        bm:AddLabel'Thickness':AddSlider{
            Default = 0.18,
            Min = 0.05,
            Max = 1,
            Rounding = 2,
            Flag = 'JumpCircleThickness',
            Size = 80,
            Callback = function(br)
                bq.Value = br
                p.Config.JumpCircleThickness = br
            end,
        }

        local br = makeOptionProxy('JumpCircleExpandTime', 0.7)

        bm:AddLabel'Expand Time':AddSlider{
            Default = 0.7,
            Min = 0.2,
            Max = 2.5,
            Rounding = 2,
            Flag = 'JumpCircleExpandTime',

                p.Config.JumpCircleExpandTime = bs

        }

            Min = 0,
            Max = 0.8,
            Rounding = 2,
            Flag = 'JumpCircleStartAlpha',
            Size = 80,
            Callback = function(bt)
                bs.Value = bt
                p.Config.JumpCircleStartAlpha = bt

        }

        bm:AddLabel'Segments':AddSlider{

            Min = 16,
            Max = 96,
            Rounding = 0,
            Flag = 'JumpCircleSegments',
            Size = 80,
            Callback = function(bu)
                bt.Value = bu
                p.Config.JumpCircleSegments = math.floor(bu)
            end,
        }

    local bj = aK:AddSection{
        Name = 'MOTION GRAPH',
        Position = 'right',
    }

    do
        local bk, bl, bm, bn, bo, bp, bq, br, bs, bt, bu, bv, bw, bx, by, bz = false, Color3.fromRGB(242, 242, 242), 280, 72, 180, 1, 2.8, 2.2222222222222223E-2, 0, 0, {}, {}, {}, {}, nil, nil

        local function mg_remove(bA)
            if not bA then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                if typeof(bA) == 'Instance' then
                    bA:Destroy()
                elseif bA.Remove then
                    bA:Remove()
                end
            end)
        end
        local function mg_speed()
            local bA = n and n.Character
            local bB = bA and bA:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

            if not bB then
                return 0
            end

            local bC = bB.AssemblyLinearVelocity

            return Vector3.new(bC.X, 0, bC.Z).Magnitude
        end
        local function mg_reference()
            local bA = n and n.Character
            local bB = bA and bA:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

            return math.max(1, bB and bB.WalkSpeed or 16)
        end
        local function mg_new_line(bA, bB, bC, bD)
            local bE = Drawing.new'Line'

            bE.Color = bA
            bE.Thickness = bB
            bE.Transparency = bD
            bE.ZIndex = bC
            bE.Visible = false

            return bE
        end
        local function mg_new_text()
            local bA = Drawing.new'Text'

            bA.Center = true
            bA.Outline = true
            bA.Color = bl
            bA.Size = 12
            bA.ZIndex = 904
            bA.Visible = false

            return bA
        end
        local function mg_sync_pool(bA)
            while#bv < bA do
                bw[#bw + 1] = mg_new_line(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), bp + 2, 901, 0.45)
                bv[#bv + 1] = mg_new_line(bl, bp, 902, 1)
            end
            while#bv > bA do
                mg_remove(table.remove(bv))
                mg_remove(table.remove(bw))
            end
        end
        local function mg_create()
            if by then
                return
            end

            by = mg_new_text()
            by.Center = false

            for bA = 1, 6 do
                bx[bA] = mg_new_text()
            end
        end
        local function mg_hide()
            if by then
                by.Visible = false
            end

            for bA = 1, #bv do
                bv[bA].Visible = false
                bw[bA].Visible = false
            end
            for bA = 1, #bx do
                bx[bA].Visible = false
            end
        end
        local function mg_clear()
            if bz then
                DisconnectConnection(bz)

                bz = nil
            end

            mg_remove(by)

            by = nil

            for bA = 1, #bv do
                mg_remove(bv[bA])
                mg_remove(bw[bA])
            end
            for bA = 1, #bx do
                mg_remove(bx[bA])
            end

            table.clear(bv)
            table.clear(bw)
            table.clear(bx)
            table.clear(bu)

            bs = 0
        end
        local function mg_reset_history()
            table.clear(bu)

            local bA, bB = os.clock(), mg_speed()

            bt = bB

            local bC = math.ceil(bq / br)

            for bD = 0, bC do
                bu[#bu + 1] = {
                    t = bA - bq + bD * br,
                    v = bB,
                }
            end

            mg_sync_pool(#bu)
        end
        local function mg_apply_style()
            if by then
                by.Color = bl
            end

            for bA = 1, #bv do
                bv[bA].Color = bl
                bv[bA].Thickness = bp
                bw[bA].Thickness = bp + 2
            end
            for bA = 1, #bx do
                bx[bA].Color = bl
            end
        end
        local function mg_y(bA, bB, bC, bD)
            local bE = math.clamp(bA / bD - 1, -1, 1)

            return bB - bE * bC * 0.44
        end
        local function mg_render(bA)
            local bB = a and a.CurrentCamera

            if not bk or not bB or #bu < 2 then
                mg_hide()

                return
            end

            local bC = bB.ViewportSize
            local bD, bE = math.min(bm, math.max(120, bC.X - 48)), math.min(bn, math.max(36, bC.Y - 32))
            local bF, bG, bH, bI, bJ = math.floor(bC.X * 0.5 - bD * 0.5), math.clamp(math.floor(bC.Y * 0.5 + bo), bE * 0.5 + 8, bC.Y - bE * 0.5 - 8), mg_reference(), bA - bq, #bu

            mg_sync_pool(bJ)

            for bK = 1, bJ - 1 do
                local bL, bM = bu[bK], bu[bK + 1]
                local bN, bO = math.clamp((bL.t - bI) / bq, 0, 1), math.clamp((bM.t - bI) / bq, 0, 1)
                local bP, bQ, bR, bS, bT = math.clamp(math.min((bN + bO) * 6, (2 - bN - bO) * 5), 0, 1), Vector2.new(bF + bN * bD, mg_y(bL.v, bG, bE, bH)), Vector2.new(bF + bO * bD, mg_y(bM.v, bG, bE, bH)), bv[bK], bw[bK]

                bS.From, bS.To = bQ, bR
                bS.Transparency = bP
                bS.Visible = bP > 0.02
                bT.From, bT.To = bQ, bR
                bT.Transparency = bP * 0.42
                bT.Visible = bP > 0.02
            end

            local bK = bu[bJ]
            local bL = math.clamp((bK.t - bI) / bq, 0, 1)
            local bM, bN, bO, bP = Vector2.new(bF + bL * bD, mg_y(bK.v, bG, bE, bH)), Vector2.new(bF + bD, mg_y(bt, bG, bE, bH)), bv[bJ], bw[bJ]

            bO.From, bO.To = bM, bN
            bO.Transparency = 0.72
            bO.Visible = true
            bP.From, bP.To = bM, bN
            bP.Transparency = 0.3
            bP.Visible = true

            for bQ = bJ + 1, #bv do
                bv[bQ].Visible = false
                bw[bQ].Visible = false
            end

            by.Text = tostring(math.floor(bt + 0.5))
            by.Position = Vector2.new(bF + bD + 5, bN.Y - 7)
            by.Color = bl
            by.Visible = true

            while#bx < 12 do
                bx[#bx + 1] = mg_new_text()
            end

            local bQ, bR = math.max(0.8, bH * 0.08), 0.42

            for bS = 5, bJ - 4 do
                local bT = bu[bS]

                if not bT.checked then
                    bT.checked = true

                    local bU, bV = bT.v - bu[bS - 4].v, bu[bS + 4].v - bT.v

                    if math.abs(bU) >= bQ and (bU * bV <= 0 or math.abs(bV) < bQ * 0.35) then
                        local bW

                        for bX = bS - 1, 1, -1 do
                            local bY = bu[bX]

                            if bT.t - bY.t > bR then
                                break
                            end
                            if bY.label ~= nil then
                                bW = bY

                                break
                            end
                        end

                        local bX = math.abs(bU) - math.abs(bV)

                        if not bW then
                            bT.label = math.floor(bT.v + 0.5)
                            bT.label_score = bX
                        elseif bX > (bW.label_score or -math.huge) then
                            bW.label = nil
                            bW.label_score = nil
                            bT.label = math.floor(bT.v + 0.5)
                            bT.label_score = bX
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for bS = 1, #bx do
                bx[bS].Visible = false
            end

            local bS, bT = {}, 0

            for bU = bJ, 1, -1 do
                local bV = bu[bU]

                if bV.label ~= nil and bT < #bx then
                    local bW = (bV.t - bI) / bq

                    if bW > 0.04 and bW < 0.82 then
                        local bX, bY, bZ = tostring(bV.label), bF + bW * bD, mg_y(bV.v, bG, bE, bH) - 15
                        local b_, b0 = math.max(8, #bX * 3.5 + 2), false

                        for b1 = 1, #bS do
                            local b2 = bS[b1]

                            if bY + b_ + 5 > b2.x1 and bY - b_ - 5 < b2.x2 and bZ + 13 > b2.y1 and bZ - 3 < b2.y2 then
                                b0 = true

                                break
                            end
                        end

                        if not b0 then
                            bT = bT + 1

                            local b1 = bx[bT]

                            b1.Text = bX
                            b1.Position = Vector2.new(bY, bZ)
                            b1.Color = bl
                            b1.Visible = true
                            bS[#bS + 1] = {
                                x1 = bY - b_,
                                x2 = bY + b_,
                                y1 = bZ - 3,
                                y2 = bZ + 13,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function mg_start()
            mg_clear()
            mg_create()
            mg_reset_history()
            mg_apply_style()

            bz = TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function(bA)
                if not bk then
                    mg_hide()

                    return
                end

                local bB = mg_speed()

                bt = bt + (bB - bt) * (1 - math.exp(-bA * 18))
                bs = bs + bA

                local bC = os.clock()

                if bs >= br then
                    bs = bs % br
                    bu[#bu + 1] = {
                        t = bC,
                        v = bt,
                    }

                    local bD = bC - bq

                    while#bu > 2 and bu[2].t < bD do
                        table.remove(bu, 1)
                    end
                end

                mg_render(bC)
            end))
        end

        function p.ToggleMotionGraph(bA)
            if bA ~= nil then
                p.Config.MotionGraphEnabled = bA and true or false
            end

            bk = p.Config.MotionGraphEnabled and true or false

            if bk then
                mg_start()
            else
                mg_clear()
            end
        end

        end

        if n then
            TrackConnection(n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.4)

                if bk then
                    mg_reset_history()
                end
            end))
        end

        do
            local bA = p.Config

            bm = tonumber(bA.MotionGraphWidth) or bm
            bn = tonumber(bA.MotionGraphHeight) or bn
            bo = tonumber(bA.MotionGraphOffset) or bo
            bp = tonumber(bA.MotionGraphThickness) or bp
        end

        local bA, bB = makeToggleProxy('MotionGraphEnabled', false), bj:AddLabel'Motion Graph'

        bB:AddToggle{
            Default = false,
            Flag = 'MotionGraphEnabled',

                p.ToggleMotionGraph(bC)
            end,

        local bC, bD = bB:AddOption(), makeOptionProxy('MotionGraphColor', Color3.fromRGB(242, 242, 242))

        bC:AddLabel'Color':AddColorPicker{

            Flag = 'MotionGraphColor',

                p.SetMotionGraphColor(bE)

                p.SetMotionGraphWidth(bF)

        local bF = makeOptionProxy('MotionGraphHeight', 72)

        bC:AddLabel'Height':AddSlider{

                bF.Value = bG

                p.SetMotionGraphHeight(bG)

        local bG = makeOptionProxy('MotionGraphOffset', 180)

        bC:AddLabel'Offset':AddSlider{

            Flag = 'MotionGraphOffset',
            Size = 80,
            Callback = function(bH)
                bG.Value = bH

                p.SetMotionGraphOffset(bH)

        local bH = makeOptionProxy('MotionGraphThickness', 1)

        bC:AddLabel'Thickness':AddSlider{

            Flag = 'MotionGraphThickness',
            Size = 80,

                bH.Value = bI

                p.SetMotionGraphThickness(bI)

        }

    local bk = aK:AddSection{
        Name = 'TARGET HUD',
        Position = 'left',
    }

    do
        local bl, bm = {
            gui = nil,
            frame = nil,
            stroke = nil,
            strokeInner = nil,
            corner = nil,
            glass = nil,
            glass2 = nil,
            sheen = nil,
            sheenGrad = nil,
            glow = nil,
            topLine = nil,

            avatarStroke = nil,
            avatarCorner = nil,
            nameLabel = nil,
            distanceLabel = nil,
            healthBg = nil,
            healthFill = nil,
            healthBgCorner = nil,
            healthFillCorner = nil,
            frameGrad = nil,
            currentTarget = nil,
            healthConn = nil,
            visible = false,
            dragging = false,
            dragStart = nil,
            frameStart = nil,
            hasTarget = false,
            renderConn = nil,
            inputBeganConn = nil,
            inputChangedConn = nil,
            frameInputConn = nil,
            sheenConn = nil,
            design = 'Classic',
            shownTrans = {},
        }, {
            Classic = true,
            Minimal = true,
            Neon = true,
            Soft = true,
            ['Liquid Glass'] = true,
        }

        local function thAccent()
            local bn = p.Config and p.Config.TargetHudAccent

            if typeof(bn) == 'Color3' then
                return bn
            end

            return Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255)
        end
        local function thDesign()
            local bn = tostring(p.Config and p.Config.TargetHudDesign or 'Classic')

            if not bm[bn] then
                bn = 'Classic'
            end

            return bn
        end
        local function thFade()
            return math.clamp(tonumber(p.Config and p.Config.TargetHudFade) or 0.18, 0.05, 1)
        end
        local function thStopSheen()
            if bl.sheenConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.sheenConn)

                bl.sheenConn = nil
            end
        end
        local function thStartSheen()
            thStopSheen()

            if not bl.sheen or not bl.sheenGrad then
                return
            end

            local bn = os.clock()

            bl.sheenConn = TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not bl.sheen or not bl.sheen.Parent or not bl.visible then
                    return
                end

                local bo = ((os.clock() - bn) * 0.35) % 1
                local bp, bq, br = math.clamp(bo - 0.18, 0, 1), math.clamp(bo, 0, 1), math.clamp(bo + 0.18, 0, 1)

                bl.sheenGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new{
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(math.max(0.001, bp), 1),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(math.clamp(bq, 0.002, 0.998), 0.55),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(math.min(0.999, br), 1),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                }
            end))
        end
        local function thApplySize()
            if not bl.frame then
                return
            end

            local bn, bo = math.clamp(tonumber(p.Config.TargetHudSizeX) or 220, 140, 420), math.clamp(tonumber(p.Config.TargetHudSizeY) or 64, 48, 120)

            bl.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bn, bo)

            if bl.glow then
                bl.glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 28, 1, 28)
            end
            if bl.sheen then
                bl.sheen.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            end
        end
        local function thApplyPos()
            if not bl.frame then
                return
            end

            local bn, bo = tonumber(p.Config.TargetHudPosX) or 24, tonumber(p.Config.TargetHudPosY) or -110

            bl.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, bn, 1, bo)
        end
        local function thClearDecor()
            thStopSheen()

            for bn, bo in ipairs{
                'glass',
                'glass2',
                'sheen',
                'glow',
                'topLine',
                'strokeInner',
                'frameGrad',
            }do
                local bp = bl[bo]

                if bp then
                    pcall(function()
                        bp:Destroy()
                    end)
                end

                bl[bo] = nil
            end

            if bl.sheenGrad then
                bl.sheenGrad = nil
            end
        end

        local function thCreateGui()
            if bl.gui and bl.gui.Parent then
                return
            end

            local bn

            pcall(function()
                if k then
                    bn = k
                end
            end)

            if not bn and n then
                bn = n:FindFirstChild'PlayerGui' or n:WaitForChild('PlayerGui', 2)
            end
            if not bn then
                return
            end

            local bo = Instance.new'ScreenGui'

            bo.Name = 'CandyTargetHUD'
            bo.ResetOnSpawn = false
            bo.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            bo.DisplayOrder = 100
            bo.Parent = bn

            local bp = Instance.new'Frame'

            bp.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
            bp.Position = UDim2.new(0, tonumber(p.Config.TargetHudPosX) or 24, 1, tonumber(p.Config.TargetHudPosY) or -110)
            bp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tonumber(p.Config.TargetHudSizeX) or 220, tonumber(p.Config.TargetHudSizeY) or 64)

            br.Transparency = 1
            br.Parent = bp
