                bl.frameInputConn = nil
            end

            bl.frameInputConn = TrackConnection(bp.InputBegan:Connect(function(bB)
                if not bl.dragging then
                    return
                end
                if bB.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or bB.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    bl.dragStart = bB.Position
                    bl.frameStart = bp.Position

                    bB.Changed:Connect(function()
                        if bB.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                            bl.dragStart = nil
                            bl.frameStart = nil

                            if bl.frame then
                                local bC, bD = bl.frame.Position.X.Offset, bl.frame.Position.Y.Offset

                                p.Config.TargetHudPosX = bC
                                p.Config.TargetHudPosY = bD

                                pcall(function()
                                    if aE and aE.TargetHudPosX then
                                        if aE.TargetHudPosX.SetValue then
                                            aE.TargetHudPosX:SetValue(bC)
                                        else
                                            aE.TargetHudPosX.Value = bC
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if aE and aE.TargetHudPosY then
                                        if aE.TargetHudPosY.SetValue then
                                            aE.TargetHudPosY:SetValue(bD)
                                        else
                                            aE.TargetHudPosY.Value = bD
                                        end
                                    end
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end))

            thApplyDesign(true)
        end
        local function thShow()
            if bl.visible or not bl.frame then
                return
            end

            bl.visible = true

            local bn, bo, bp, bq, br, bs = TweenInfo.new(thFade(), Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), bl.design or thDesign(), 0.08, 0.35, 0, 0

            if bo == 'Minimal' then
                bp, bq = 0.12, 0.55
            elseif bo == 'Neon' then
                bp, bq = 0.05, 0.15
            elseif bo == 'Soft' then
                bp, bq = 0.1, 0.4
            elseif bo == 'Liquid Glass' then
                bp, bq, br, bs = 0.82, 0.45, 0.55, 0.45
            end

            f:Create(bl.frame, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = bp}):Play()

            if bl.stroke then
                f:Create(bl.stroke, bn, {Transparency = bq}):Play()
            end

            f:Create(bl.avatarHolder, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = br}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.avatar, bn, {ImageTransparency = 0}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.nameLabel, bn, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.distanceLabel, bn, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.healthBg, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = bs}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.healthFill, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()

            if bl.glow then
                f:Create(bl.glow, bn, {ImageTransparency = 0.72}):Play()
            end
            if bl.topLine then
                f:Create(bl.topLine, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.25}):Play()
            end
            if bl.glass then
                f:Create(bl.glass, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.78}):Play()
            end
            if bl.glass2 then
                f:Create(bl.glass2, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.9}):Play()
            end
            if bl.sheen then
                f:Create(bl.sheen, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.35}):Play()
            end
            if bl.strokeInner then
                f:Create(bl.strokeInner, bn, {Transparency = 0.35}):Play()
            end
            if bl.avatarStroke then
                f:Create(bl.avatarStroke, bn, {Transparency = 0.4}):Play()
            end
            if bo == 'Liquid Glass' then
                thStartSheen()
            end
        end
        local function thHide()
            if not bl.visible or not bl.frame then
                return
            end

            bl.visible = false

            thStopSheen()

            local bn = TweenInfo.new(thFade(), Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

            f:Create(bl.frame, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()

            if bl.stroke then
                f:Create(bl.stroke, bn, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            end

            f:Create(bl.avatarHolder, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.avatar, bn, {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.nameLabel, bn, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.distanceLabel, bn, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.healthBg, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            f:Create(bl.healthFill, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()

            if bl.glow then
                f:Create(bl.glow, bn, {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
            end
            if bl.topLine then
                f:Create(bl.topLine, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            end
            if bl.glass then
                f:Create(bl.glass, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            end
            if bl.glass2 then
                f:Create(bl.glass2, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            end
            if bl.sheen then
                f:Create(bl.sheen, bn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            end
            if bl.strokeInner then
                f:Create(bl.strokeInner, bn, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            end
            if bl.avatarStroke then
                f:Create(bl.avatarStroke, bn, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            end
        end
        local function thAlivePlayer(bn)
            if not bn or bn == n then
                return false
            end

            local bo = bn.Character

            if not bo then
                return false
            end

            local bp, bq = bo:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid', bo:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or bo.PrimaryPart

            return bp and bq and bp.Health > 0 and true or false
        end
        local function thWorldPos(bn)
            local bo

            if typeof(bn) == 'Instance' then
                if bn:IsA'Player' then
                    bo = bn.Character
                elseif bn:IsA'Model' then
                    bo = bn
                end
            end
            if not bo then
                return nil
            end

            local bp = bo:FindFirstChild'Head'

            if bp and bp:IsA'BasePart' then
                return bp.Position
            end

            local bq = bo:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

            if bq and bq:IsA'BasePart' then
                return bq.Position
            end

            local br = bo:FindFirstChild'Torso' or bo:FindFirstChild'UpperTorso'

            if br and br:IsA'BasePart' then
                return br.Position
            end
            if bo.PrimaryPart then
                return bo.PrimaryPart.Position
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function thDistanceTo(bn)
            local bo, bp = thWorldPos(n), thWorldPos(bn)

            if not bo or not bp then
                return nil
            end

            return (bp - bo).Magnitude
        end
        local function thNearest()
            local bn = thWorldPos(n)

            if not bn then
                return nil
            end

            local bo, bp = (math.huge)

            for bq, br in ipairs(b:GetPlayers())do
                if thAlivePlayer(br) then
                    local bs = thWorldPos(br)

                    if bs then
                        local bt = (bs - bn).Magnitude

                        if bt < bo then
                            bo = bt
                            bp = br
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return bp
        end
        local function thLocalRole()
            if p.FindMurderer and p.FindMurderer() == n then
                return 'Murderer'
            end
            if p.FindSheriff and p.FindSheriff() == n then
                return 'Sheriff'
            end
            if p.PlayerData and n then
                local bn = p.PlayerData[n.Name]

                if type(bn) == 'table' and bn.Role then
                    local bo = tostring(bn.Role)

                    if bo == 'Murderer' then
                        return 'Murderer'
                    end
                    if bo == 'Sheriff' or bo == 'Hero' then
                        return 'Sheriff'
                    end
                end
            end

            local bn, bo = n and n.Character, n and n:FindFirstChild'Backpack'

            if (bn and bn:FindFirstChild'Knife') or (bo and bo:FindFirstChild'Knife') then
                return 'Murderer'
            end
            if (bn and bn:FindFirstChild'Gun') or (bo and bo:FindFirstChild'Gun') then
                return 'Sheriff'
            end

            return 'Innocent'
        end
        local function thResolveTarget()
            local bn = tostring(p.Config.TargetHudMode or 'Auto')

            if bn == 'Auto' then
                local bo = thLocalRole()

                if bo == 'Murderer' then
                    return thNearest()
                elseif bo == 'Sheriff' then
                    local bp = p.FindMurderer and p.FindMurderer()

                    if thAlivePlayer(bp) then
                        return bp
                    end

                    return nil
                end

                return thNearest()
            elseif bn == 'Murderer' then
                local bo = p.FindMurderer and p.FindMurderer()

                if thAlivePlayer(bo) then
                    return bo
                end

                return nil
            elseif bn == 'Sheriff' then
                local bo = p.FindSheriff and p.FindSheriff()

                if thAlivePlayer(bo) then
                    return bo
                end

                return nil
            end

            return thNearest()
        end
        local function thSetTarget(bn)
            if bn == bl.currentTarget and bl.healthConn then
                return
            end

            bl.currentTarget = bn

            if bl.healthConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.healthConn)

                bl.healthConn = nil
            end
            if not bn then
                bl.hasTarget = false

                if bl.avatar then
                    bl.avatar.Image = ''
                end
                if bl.healthFill then
                    bl.healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
                end
                if bl.distanceLabel then
                    bl.distanceLabel.Text = ''
                end
                if bl.dragging then
                    thShow()

                    if bl.nameLabel then
                        bl.nameLabel.Text = 'move mode'
                    end
                else
                    thHide()
                end

                return
            end

            bl.hasTarget = true

            thShow()

            local bo, bp = pcall(function()
                return b:GetUserThumbnailAsync(bn.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
            end)

            if bl.avatar then
                bl.avatar.Image = (bo and bp) or ''
            end
            if bl.nameLabel then
                if bl.dragging then
                    bl.nameLabel.Text = 'move mode'
                else
                    bl.nameLabel.Text = bn.DisplayName or bn.Name
                end
            end

            local function updateHealth()
                if not bl.healthFill then
                    return
                end

                local bq = bn.Character
                local br = bq and bq:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

                if not br then
                    bl.healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)

                    if bl.distanceLabel then
                        bl.distanceLabel.Text = ''
                    end

                    return
                end

                local bs = math.clamp(br.Health / math.max(br.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)

                bl.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = thAccent()

                f:Create(bl.healthFill, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(bs, 1),
                }):Play()

                if bl.distanceLabel then
                    local bt = thDistanceTo(bn)

                    if bt then
                        bl.distanceLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(bt + 0.5)) .. ' studs'
                    else
                        bl.distanceLabel.Text = ''
                    end
                end
            end

            updateHealth()

            bl.healthConn = TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(updateHealth))
        end
        local function thSetMoveMode(bn)
            bl.dragging = bn and true or false

            if bl.dragging then
                thShow()

                if bl.nameLabel then
                    bl.nameLabel.Text = 'move mode'
                end
                if not bl.hasTarget and bl.distanceLabel then
                    bl.distanceLabel.Text = ''
                end
            else
                if bl.hasTarget and bl.currentTarget then
                    if bl.nameLabel then
                        bl.nameLabel.Text = bl.currentTarget.DisplayName or bl.currentTarget.Name
                    end
                else
                    thHide()
                end
            end
        end
        local function thBindInput()
            if bl.inputChangedConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.inputChangedConn)

                bl.inputChangedConn = nil
            end

            bl.inputChangedConn = TrackConnection(e.InputChanged:Connect(function(bn)
                if not bl.dragging then
                    return
                end
                if not bl.dragStart or not bl.frameStart or not bl.frame then
                    return
                end
                if bn.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and bn.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    return
                end

                local bo = bn.Position - bl.dragStart

                bl.frame.Position = UDim2.new(bl.frameStart.X.Scale, bl.frameStart.X.Offset + bo.X, bl.frameStart.Y.Scale, bl.frameStart.Y.Offset + bo.Y)
            end))
        end
        local function thStart()
            thCreateGui()
            thApplySize()
            thApplyPos()
            thApplyDesign(not bl.visible)
            thBindInput()
            thSetMoveMode(p.Config.TargetHudMoveMode and true or false)

            if bl.renderConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.renderConn)

                bl.renderConn = nil
            end

            bl.renderConn = TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not (p.Config and p.Config.TargetHudEnabled) then
                    return
                end

                thSetTarget(thResolveTarget())
            end))
        end
        local function thStop()
            thStopSheen()

            if bl.renderConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.renderConn)

                bl.renderConn = nil
            end
            if bl.healthConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.healthConn)

                bl.healthConn = nil
            end
            if bl.inputBeganConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.inputBeganConn)

                bl.inputBeganConn = nil
            end
            if bl.inputChangedConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.inputChangedConn)

                bl.inputChangedConn = nil
            end
            if bl.frameInputConn then
                DisconnectConnection(bl.frameInputConn)

                bl.frameInputConn = nil
            end

            bl.currentTarget = nil
            bl.hasTarget = false
            bl.dragging = false
            bl.visible = false

            if bl.gui then
                pcall(function()
                    bl.gui:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            bl.gui = nil
            bl.frame = nil
            bl.stroke = nil
            bl.strokeInner = nil
            bl.corner = nil
            bl.glass = nil
            bl.glass2 = nil
            bl.sheen = nil
            bl.sheenGrad = nil
            bl.glow = nil
            bl.topLine = nil
            bl.frameGrad = nil
            bl.avatar = nil
            bl.avatarHolder = nil
            bl.avatarStroke = nil
            bl.avatarCorner = nil
            bl.nameLabel = nil
            bl.distanceLabel = nil
            bl.healthBg = nil
            bl.healthFill = nil
            bl.healthBgCorner = nil
            bl.healthFillCorner = nil
        end

        function p.ToggleTargetHud(bn)
            if bn ~= nil then
                p.Config.TargetHudEnabled = bn and true or false
            end
            if p.Config.TargetHudEnabled then
                thStart()
            else
                thStop()
            end
        end
        function p.SetTargetHudMode(bn)
            local bo = tostring(bn or 'Auto')

            if bo ~= 'Auto' and bo ~= 'Nearest' and bo ~= 'Murderer' and bo ~= 'Sheriff' then
                bo = 'Auto'
            end

            p.Config.TargetHudMode = bo
        end
        function p.SetTargetHudDesign(bn)
            local bo = tostring(bn or 'Classic')

            if not bm[bo] then
                bo = 'Classic'
            end

            p.Config.TargetHudDesign = bo

            if bl.frame then
                local bp = bl.visible

                thApplyDesign(not bp)

                if bp then
                    bl.visible = false

                    thShow()
                end
            end
        end
        function p.SetTargetHudAccent(bn)
            if typeof(bn) == 'Color3' then
                p.Config.TargetHudAccent = bn

                if bl.healthFill then
                    bl.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = bn
                end
                if bl.design == 'Neon' or bl.design == 'Liquid Glass' then
                    if bl.frame then
                        local bo = bl.visible

                        thApplyDesign(not bo)

                        if bo then
                            bl.visible = false

                            thShow()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

    local bl = aK:AddSection{
        Name = 'BACKTRACK',
        Position = 'left',
    }

    do
        local bm, bn, bo, bp = false, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), nil, 256
        local bq = table.create(bp)

        for br = 1, bp do
            bq[br] = {
                0,
                CFrame.identity,
            }
        end

        local br, bs, bt, bu, bv, bw, bx = 1, 0, 0.15, 0, {}, nil, nil

        local function bt_read_ping()
            return l.Network.ServerStatsItem['Data Ping']:GetValue() / 1000
        end
        local function bt_destroy()
            if bo then
                if _G.BACKTRACK_CLONES then
                    _G.BACKTRACK_CLONES[bo] = nil
                end

                pcall(function()
                    bo:Destroy()
                end)

                bo = nil
            end

            bv = {}
            br = 1
            bs = 0
        end
        local function bt_build()
            bt_destroy()

            local by = n and n.Character

            if not by then
                return
            end

            local bz = by:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

            if not bz then
                return
            end

            by.Archivable = true

            local bA, bB = pcall(function()
                return by:Clone()
            end)

            by.Archivable = false

            if not bA or not bB then
                return
            end

            _G.BACKTRACK_CLONES = _G.BACKTRACK_CLONES or {}

            local bC = {}

            for bD, bE in by:GetDescendants()do
                if bE:IsA'BasePart' then
                    bC[#bC + 1] = bE
                end
            end

            local bD = 0

            for bE, bF in bB:GetDescendants()do
                if bF:IsA'Script' or bF:IsA'LocalScript' then
                    pcall(function()
                        bF:Destroy()
                    end)
                elseif bF:IsA'Decal' or bF:IsA'Texture' or bF:IsA'SurfaceAppearance' then
                    pcall(function()
                        bF:Destroy()
                    end)
                elseif bF:IsA'ParticleEmitter' or bF:IsA'Beam' or bF:IsA'Trail' or bF:IsA'PointLight' or bF:IsA'SpotLight' or bF:IsA'SurfaceLight' then
                    pcall(function()
                        bF:Destroy()
                    end)
                elseif bF:IsA'BasePart' then
                    bF.Anchored = true
                    bF.CanCollide = false
                    bF.CanQuery = false
                    bF.Massless = true
                    bF.CastShadow = false

                    if bF.Name == 'HumanoidRootPart' then
                        bF.Transparency = 1
                    else
                        bF.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                        bF.Color = bn
                        bF.Transparency = 0
                    end

                    bD = bD + 1
                    bv[#bv + 1] = {
                        bF,
                        bC[bD],
                    }
                end
            end

            local bE = bB:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

            if bE then
                pcall(function()
                    bE:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            bB.Parent = a
            bo = bB
            _G.BACKTRACK_CLONES[bB] = true
        end
        local function bt_update()
            local by = n and n.Character
            local bz = by and by:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart'

            if not bz then
                return
            end
            if getgenv().FAKE_POS_ACTIVE then
                if bo and bo.Parent then
                    bo.Parent = nil
                end

                return
            end
            if not bo then
                bt_build()

                if not bo then
                    return
                end
            end
            if not bo.Parent then
                bo.Parent = a
            end

            local bA, bB = os.clock(), bz.CFrame

            if bs < bp then
                bs = bs + 1
            else
                br = br % bp + 1
            end

            local bC = bq[(br + bs - 2) % bp + 1]

            bC[1] = bA
            bC[2] = bB

            if bA - bu >= 0.2 then
                bu = bA

                local bD, bE = pcall(bt_read_ping)

                bt = math.clamp((bD and bE) or 0.15, 0.05, 0.6)
            end

            local bD = bt
            local bE, bF = bA - bD, bB

            for bG = bs, 1, -1 do
                local bH = bq[(br + bG - 2) % bp + 1]

                if bH[1] <= bE then
                    bF = bH[2]

                    break
                end
            end

            while bs > 0 and bq[br][1] < bA - 1 do
                br = br % bp + 1
                bs = bs - 1
            end

            local bG = bz.CFrame:Inverse()

            for bH = 1, #bv do
                local bI, bJ = bv[bH][1], bv[bH][2]

                if bI and bI.Parent and bJ and bJ.Parent then
                    bI.CFrame = bF * (bG * bJ.CFrame)
                end
            end
        end
        local function bt_start()
            if bw then
                return
            end

            bw = TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if bm then
                    bt_update()
                end
            end))

            if n then
                bx = TrackConnection(n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    task.wait(0.4)

                    if bm then
                        bt_build()
                    end
                end))
            end
        end
        local function bt_stop()
            if bw then
                DisconnectConnection(bw)

                bw = nil
            end
            if bx then
                DisconnectConnection(bx)

                bx = nil
            end

            bt_destroy()
        end

        local by, bz = makeToggleProxy('backtrack', false), bl:AddLabel'Backtrack'

        bz:AddToggle{

            Flag = 'backtrack',
            Callback = function(bA)
                by.Value = bA

                else
                    bt_stop()
                end
            end,

    local bm = aK:AddSection{

        local function restoreKorblox()
            for bu, bv in pairs(bp)do
                if bu.Parent then
                    for bw, bx in pairs(bv)do
                        pcall(function()
                            bu[bw] = bx
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end

            table.clear(bp)
        end
        local function applyKorblox()
            if not bn then
                return
            end

            local bu = n and n.Character

            if not bu then
                return
            end

            restoreKorblox()

            for bv, bw in pairs(bs)do
                local bx = bu:FindFirstChild(bv)

                if bx then
                    local by = {}

                    for bz in pairs(bw)do
                        local bA, bB = pcall(function()
                            return bx[bz]
                        end)

                        if bA then
                            by[bz] = bB
                        end
                    end

                    bp[bx] = by

                    for bz, bA in pairs(bw)do
                        pcall(function()
                            bx[bz] = bA
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function restoreHeadless()
            for bu, bv in pairs(bq)do
                if bu.Parent then
                    for bw, bx in pairs(bv)do
                        pcall(function()
                            bu[bw] = bx
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end

            table.clear(bq)
        end
        local function applyHeadless()
            if not bo then
                return
            end

            local bu = n and n.Character
            local bv = bu and bu:FindFirstChild'Head'

            if not bv then
                return
            end

            restoreHeadless()

            bq[bv] = {
                MeshId = (pcall(function()
                    return bv.MeshId
                end)) and bv.MeshId or nil,
                TextureID = (pcall(function()
                    return bv.TextureID
                end)) and bv.TextureID or nil,
                Transparency = bv.Transparency,
            }

            pcall(function()
                bv.MeshId = bt
            end)
            pcall(function()
                bv.TextureID = bt
            end)
            pcall(function()
                bv.Transparency = 1
            end)

            for bw, bx in ipairs(bv:GetDescendants())do
                local by, bz = pcall(function()
                    return bx.Transparency
                end)

                if by and type(bz) == 'number' then
                    bq[bx] = {Transparency = bz}

                    pcall(function()
                        bx.Transparency = 1
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        local function reapply()
            task.wait(1)
            pcall(applyKorblox)
            pcall(applyHeadless)
        end
        local function watchCharacter()
            if br then
                return
            end
            if not n then
                return
            end

            br = TrackConnection(n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.spawn(reapply)
            end))
        end

    local bo = aK:AddSection{

            bt:AddToggle{

    do
        local bp, bq, br, bs, bt = aM:AddSection{
            Name = 'Map Voter',
            Position = 'left',
        }, 12, 0.3

        local function voteMap()
            if not n or not n.Character or not n.Character:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' then
                pcall(function()
                    if az and az.new then
                        az.new{
                            Title = 'Error',
                            Content = 'Character not found',
                            Duration = 3,
                        }
                    end
                end)

                return
            end

            bs = n.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            bt = true

            local bu = 0

            pcall(function()
                if az and az.new then
                    az.new{
                        Title = 'Vote Map',
                        Content = 'Starting ' .. bq .. ' respawns...',
                        Duration = 3,
                    }
                end
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while bu < bq and bt do
                    if n.Character and n.Character:FindFirstChild'Humanoid' then
                        n.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
                        bu = bu + 1
                    end

                    task.wait(br)
                end

                bt = false
                bs = nil

                pcall(function()
                    if az and az.new then
                        az.new{
                            Title = 'Vote Map',
                            Content = 'Completed ' .. bu .. ' votes!',
                            Duration = 3,
                        }
                    end
                end)
            end)

            local bv

            bv = n.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(bw)
                if bs then
                    bw:WaitForChild'HumanoidRootPart'.CFrame = CFrame.new(bs)
                else
                    bv:Disconnect()
                end
            end)

            TrackConnection(bv)
        end

        bp:AddButton{
            Name = 'Vote Map',
            Callback = voteMap,
        }

    local bp = aM:AddSection{
        Name = 'SKYBOX',
        Position = 'left',
    }

    do
        local bq = {}

        if ax.SkyboxAssets then
            for br in pairs(ax.SkyboxAssets)do
                table.insert(bq, br)
            end

            table.sort(bq)

            for br, bs in ipairs(bq)do
                if bs == 'Roblox Default' then
                    table.remove(bq, br)
                    table.insert(bq, 1, 'Roblox Default')

                    break
                end
            end
        end

        local br, bs = makeOptionProxy('SkyboxDropdown', 'Roblox Default'), makeToggleProxy('SkyboxToggle', false)

        local function skyboxReadName()
            local bt

            pcall(function()
                if aE and aE.SkyboxDropdown then
                    if aE.SkyboxDropdown.GetValue then
                        bt = aE.SkyboxDropdown:GetValue()
                    else
                        bt = aE.SkyboxDropdown.Value
                    end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if (not bt or bt == '') and ay and ay.Flags and ay.Flags.SkyboxDropdown then
                    local bu = ay.Flags.SkyboxDropdown

                    if bu.GetValue then
                        bt = bu:GetValue()
                    else
                        bt = bu.Value
                    end
                end
            end)

            if type(bt) ~= 'string' or bt == '' then
                bt = (ax.SkyboxVariables and ax.SkyboxVariables.current) or 'Roblox Default'
            end

            return bt
        end
        local function skyboxReadEnabled()
            local bt

            pcall(function()
                if aD and aD.SkyboxToggle then
                    if aD.SkyboxToggle.GetValue then
                        bt = aD.SkyboxToggle:GetValue()
                    else
                        bt = aD.SkyboxToggle.Value
                    end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if bt == nil and ay and ay.Flags and ay.Flags.SkyboxToggle then
                    local bu = ay.Flags.SkyboxToggle

                    if bu.GetValue then
                        bt = bu:GetValue()
                    else
                        bt = bu.Value
                    end
                end
            end)

            if bt == nil and ax.SkyboxVariables then
                bt = ax.SkyboxVariables.customEnabled
            end

            return bt and true or false
        end
        local function skyboxApplyFromState(bt)
            local bu, bv = skyboxReadEnabled(), bt or skyboxReadName()

            if ax.SkyboxVariables then
                ax.SkyboxVariables.current = bv
                ax.SkyboxVariables.customEnabled = bu
            end

            br.Value = bv
            bs.Value = bu

            if bu then
                if ax.Skybox_Apply then
                    ax.Skybox_Apply(bv)
                end
            else
                if ax.Skybox_RestoreDefault then
                    ax.Skybox_RestoreDefault()
                end
            end
        end

        p.ApplySkyboxFromConfig = skyboxApplyFromState

        if ax then
            ax.ApplySkyboxFromConfig = skyboxApplyFromState
        end

        local bt = bp:AddLabel'Skybox'

        bt:AddToggle{
            Default = false,
            Flag = 'SkyboxToggle',
            Callback = function(bu)
                bs.Value = bu

                if ax.SkyboxVariables then
                    ax.SkyboxVariables.customEnabled = bu and true or false
                end
                if bu then
                    local bv = skyboxReadName()

                    if ax.SkyboxVariables then
                        ax.SkyboxVariables.current = bv
                    end
                    if ax.Skybox_Apply then
                        ax.Skybox_Apply(bv)
                    end
                else
                    if ax.Skybox_RestoreDefault then
                        ax.Skybox_RestoreDefault()
                    end
                end
            end,
        }

        local bu = bt:AddOption()

        bu:AddLabel'Select Skybox':AddDropdown{
            Values = bq,
            Default = 'Roblox Default',
            Flag = 'SkyboxDropdown',
            Callback = function(bv)
                br.Value = bv

                if ax.SkyboxVariables then
                    ax.SkyboxVariables.current = bv
                end
                if not (aD and aD.SkyboxToggle and aD.SkyboxToggle.Value) then
                    bs.Value = true

                    if ax.SkyboxVariables then
                        ax.SkyboxVariables.customEnabled = true
                    end

                    pcall(function()
                        if aD.SkyboxToggle then
                            aD.SkyboxToggle.Value = true
                        end
                        if ay and ay.Flags and ay.Flags.SkyboxToggle then
                            ay.Flags.SkyboxToggle.Value = true
                        end
                    end)
                end
                if ax.Skybox_Apply then
                    ax.Skybox_Apply(bv)
                end
            end,
        }
        task.defer(function()
            local function hookFlag(bv, bw)
                local bx

                pcall(function()
                    bx = ay and ay.Flags and ay.Flags[bv]
                end)

                if not bx then
                    return
                end
                if bx.__SkyboxHooked then
                    return
                end

                bx.__SkyboxHooked = true

                local by = bx.SetValue

                bx.SetValue = function(bz, bA, ...)
                    local bB

                    if type(by) == 'function' then
                        bB = by(bz, bA, ...)
                    else
                        bz.Value = bA
                    end

                    pcall(bw, bA)

                    return bB
                end
            end

            hookFlag('SkyboxDropdown', function(bv)
                if type(bv) == 'string' then
                    br.Value = bv

                    if ax.SkyboxVariables then
                        ax.SkyboxVariables.current = bv
                    end

                    task.defer(function()
                        skyboxApplyFromState(bv)
                    end)
                end
            end)
            hookFlag('SkyboxToggle', function(bv)
                bs.Value = bv and true or false

                task.defer(function()
                    skyboxApplyFromState()
                end)
            end)

            if br and not br.__SkyboxHooked then
                br.__SkyboxHooked = true

                local bv = br.SetValue

                function br.SetValue(bw, bx)
                    if bv then
                        bv(bw, bx)
                    else
                        bw.Value = bx
                    end

                    task.defer(function()
                        skyboxApplyFromState(bx)
                    end)
                end
            end
            if bs and not bs.__SkyboxHooked then
                bs.__SkyboxHooked = true

                local bv = bs.SetValue

                function bs.SetValue(bw, bx)
                    if bv then
                        bv(bw, bx)
                    else
                        bw.Value = bx
                    end

                    task.defer(function()
                        skyboxApplyFromState()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            for bv, bw in ipairs{0.5, 1.25, 2.5}do
                task.wait(bw)
                pcall(skyboxApplyFromState)
            end
        end)
    end

    local bw = aM:AddSection{
        Name = 'SPACE PARTICLES',
        Position = 'left',
    }

    do
        local bx = {
            enabled = false,
            particles = {},
            folder = nil,
            hbConn = nil,
        }

        local function spGetCfg()
            local by = p.Config or {}

            return {
                Color = (typeof(by.SpaceParticlesColor) == 'Color3') and by.SpaceParticlesColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                AreaSize = tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesAreaSize) or 200,
                HeightTop = tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesHeightTop) or 80,
                Count = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesCount) or 150), 10, 400),
                FallSpeed = tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesFallSpeed) or 6,
                RiseSpeed = tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesRiseSpeed) or 3,
                RiseDistance = tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesRiseDistance) or 15,
                DriftSpeed = tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesDriftSpeed) or 0.8,
                Size = tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesSize) or 0.35,
                Transparency = tonumber(by.SpaceParticlesTransparency) or 0.2,
                FollowPlayer = by.SpaceParticlesFollowPlayer ~= false,
                RecycleDist = 250,
                Accel = 4,
            }
        end
        local function spGetFolder()
            if bx.folder and bx.folder.Parent then
                return bx.folder
            end

            local by = a:FindFirstChild'CandySpaceParticles'

            if by then
                pcall(function()
                    by:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            local bz = Instance.new'Folder'

            bz.Name = 'CandySpaceParticles'
            bz.Parent = a
            bx.folder = bz

            return bz
        end
        local function spCreateParticle(by)
            local bz = Instance.new'Part'

            bz.Name = 'SpaceParticle'
            bz.Anchored = true
            bz.CanCollide = false
            bz.CanQuery = false
            bz.CanTouch = false
            bz.CastShadow = false
            bz.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            bz.Color = by.Color
            bz.Transparency = by.Transparency
            bz.Size = Vector3.new(by.Size, by.Size, by.Size)
            bz.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            bz.Parent = spGetFolder()

            return bz
        end
        local function spRandomSpawn(by, bz)
            return Vector3.new(by.X + (math.random() - 0.5) * bz.AreaSize, by.Y + math.random(10, bz.HeightTop), by.Z + (math.random() - 0.5) * bz.AreaSize)
        end
        local function spLerpVec(by, bz, bA)
            return by + (bz - by) * bA
        end
        local function spCheckFloor(by, bz)
            local bA = RaycastParams.new()

            bA.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

            local bB = {
                spGetFolder(),
            }

            if n and n.Character then
                table.insert(bB, n.Character)
            end

            bA.FilterDescendantsInstances = bB
            bA.IgnoreWater = true

            local bC = a:Raycast(by, Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0), bA)

            return bC ~= nil
        end
        local function spDestroyAll()
            if bx.hbConn then
                pcall(function()
                    if typeof(bx.hbConn) == 'RBXScriptConnection' and bx.hbConn.Connected then
                        bx.hbConn:Disconnect()
                    end
                end)

                bx.hbConn = nil
            end

            for by, bz in ipairs(bx.particles)do
                if bz.part then
                    pcall(function()
                        bz.part:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end

            bx.particles = {}

            if bx.folder then
                pcall(function()
                    bx.folder:Destroy()
                end)

                bx.folder = nil
            end

            local by = a:FindFirstChild'CandySpaceParticles'

            if by then
                pcall(function()
                    by:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
        local function spSpawnAll()
            spDestroyAll()

            local by = spGetCfg()

            spGetFolder()

            local bz = a.CurrentCamera
            local bA = (bz and bz.CFrame.Position) or Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)

            bx.particles = {}

            for bB = 1, by.Count do
                local bC = spCreateParticle(by)

                bC.CFrame = CFrame.new(spRandomSpawn(bA, by))

                local bD, bE = (math.random() - 0.5) * by.DriftSpeed, (math.random() - 0.5) * by.DriftSpeed

                bx.particles[bB] = {
                    part = bC,
                    velocity = Vector3.new(bD, -by.FallSpeed, bE),
                    targetVel = Vector3.new(bD, -by.FallSpeed, bE),
                    rising = false,
                    riseTargetY = nil,
                    driftTimer = math.random() * 3,
                }
            end
        end
        local function spStartHeartbeat()
            if bx.hbConn then
                return
            end

            bx.hbConn = TrackConnection(d.Heartbeat:Connect(function(by)
                if not p.Config.SpaceParticlesEnabled then
                    return
                end

                local bz, bA = spGetCfg(), a.CurrentCamera
                local bB = (bA and bA.CFrame.Position) or Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)

                for bC, bD in ipairs(bx.particles)do
                    local bE = false

                    repeat
                        local bF = bD.part

                        if not bF or not bF.Parent then
                            bE = true

                            break
                        end

                        local bG = bF.Position

                        if bD.rising then
                            bD.targetVel = Vector3.new(0, bz.RiseSpeed, 0)
                        else
                            bD.driftTimer = bD.driftTimer - by

                            if bD.driftTimer <= 0 then
                                bD.driftTimer = 2 + math.random() * 2
                                bD.targetVel = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * bz.DriftSpeed, -bz.FallSpeed, (math.random() - 0.5) * bz.DriftSpeed)
                            else
                                bD.targetVel = Vector3.new(bD.targetVel.X, -bz.FallSpeed, bD.targetVel.Z)
                            end
                        end

                        local bH = math.clamp(bz.Accel * by, 0, 1)

                        bD.velocity = spLerpVec(bD.velocity, bD.targetVel, bH)

                        local bI = bG + bD.velocity * by

                        if bD.rising then
                            if bI.Y >= (bD.riseTargetY or bI.Y) then
                                bD.rising = false
                                bD.velocity = Vector3.new(0, bz.RiseSpeed * 0.3, 0)
                            end
                        else
                            if spCheckFloor(bI, bz) then
                                bD.rising = true
                                bD.riseTargetY = bI.Y + bz.RiseDistance
                            end
                        end
                        if bF.Color ~= bz.Color then
                            bF.Color = bz.Color
                        end
                        if bF.Transparency ~= bz.Transparency then
                            bF.Transparency = bz.Transparency
                        end

                        local bJ = bz.Size

                        if bF.Size.X ~= bJ then
                            bF.Size = Vector3.new(bJ, bJ, bJ)
                        end

                        bF.CFrame = CFrame.new(bI)

                        if bz.FollowPlayer then
                            local bK = Vector3.new(bI.X - bB.X, 0, bI.Z - bB.Z)

                            if bK.Magnitude > bz.RecycleDist then
                                bF.CFrame = CFrame.new(spRandomSpawn(bB, bz))
                                bD.rising = false
                                bD.velocity = Vector3.new(0, -bz.FallSpeed, 0)
                                bD.targetVel = bD.velocity
                            end
                        end

                        bE = true
                    until true

                    if not bE then
                        break
                    end
                end
            end))
        end

        function p.ToggleSpaceParticles(by)
            if by ~= nil then
                p.Config.SpaceParticlesEnabled = by and true or false
            else
                p.Config.SpaceParticlesEnabled = not p.Config.SpaceParticlesEnabled
            end
            if p.Config.SpaceParticlesEnabled then
                spSpawnAll()
                spStartHeartbeat()
            else
                spDestroyAll()
            end

            return p.Config.SpaceParticlesEnabled
        end
        function p.RefreshSpaceParticles()
            if p.Config.SpaceParticlesEnabled then
                spSpawnAll()
                spStartHeartbeat()
            end
        end

        local function _Reset_DisableFeatures()
            local bx = {
                'EnableNoclip',
                'EnableWalkSpeed',
                'EnableJumpPower',
                'ToggleFly',
                'EnableFOV',
                'ToggleAvatarChanger',
                'InfiniteJump',
                'ToggleSpeedGlitch',
                'ToggleAutoGrabGun',
                'ToggleAutoFarm',
                'ToggleGunDropNotification',
                'ToggleGunBeam',
                'ToggleJumpCircle',
                'ToggleSpaceParticles',
            }

            for by, bz in ipairs(bx)do
                local bA = p[bz]

                if type(bA) == 'function' then
                    pcall(bA, p, false)
                    pcall(bA, false)
                end
            end

            local by = p.VisualFns or (rawget(_G, 'VisualFns')) or ax

            if type(by) == 'table' then
                pcall(function()
                    if by.ShiftLock_SetEnabled then
                        by.ShiftLock_SetEnabled(false)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.Crosshair_SetEnabled then
                        by.Crosshair_SetEnabled(false)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.Hat_ToggleEnabled then
                        by.Hat_ToggleEnabled(false)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.Trail_ToggleEnabled then
                        by.Trail_ToggleEnabled(false)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.AuraTrailerVariables then
                        by.AuraTrailerVariables.enabled = false
                    end
                    if by.AuraTrailer_Toggle then
                        by.AuraTrailer_Toggle(false)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if aD and aD.ParticleAuraEnabled then
                        aD.ParticleAuraEnabled.Value = false
                    end
                    if by.ParticleAura_RefreshAll then
                        by.ParticleAura_RefreshAll()
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if aD and aD.HitEffectEnabled then
                        aD.HitEffectEnabled.Value = false

                        if aD.HitEffectEnabled.SetValue then
                            aD.HitEffectEnabled:SetValue(false)
                        end
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.Screen_Toggle then
                        by.Screen_Toggle(false)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.Anime_Toggle then
                        by.Anime_Toggle(false)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.SkyboxVariables then
                        by.SkyboxVariables.customEnabled = false
                    end
                    if by.Skybox_RestoreDefault then
                        by.Skybox_RestoreDefault()
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.WorldVariables then
                        by.WorldVariables.timeEnabled = false
                        by.WorldVariables.fullBrightEnabled = false
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if aD and aD.WorldAtmEnabled then
                        aD.WorldAtmEnabled.Value = false
                    end
                    if by.clearAtmosphere then
                        by.clearAtmosphere()
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if aD and aD.WorldFogEnabled then
                        aD.WorldFogEnabled.Value = false
                    end
                    if by.clearFog then
                        by.clearFog()
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.clearTexturePack then
                        by.clearTexturePack()
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if by.NebulaVariables then
                        by.NebulaVariables.enabled = false
                    end
                    if by.Nebula_Disable then
                        by.Nebula_Disable()
                    end
                end)
            end
            if getgenv().HitsoundData then
                getgenv().HitsoundData.enabled = false
                getgenv().HitsoundData.selectedGunshot = 'RPGS Candy'
                getgenv().HitsoundData.selectedKnifeKill = 'Golden Knife Kill'
            end
            if getgenv().ClearESP then
                pcall(getgenv().ClearESP)
            end
        end

                AuraTrailerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
                ParticleAuraColor = Color3.fromRGB(133, 220, 255),
                WorldAtmColor = Color3.fromRGB(199, 212, 255),
                WorldAtmDecay = Color3.fromRGB(106, 112, 125),
                WorldFogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192),
                NebulaColor = Color3.fromRGB(173, 216, 230),
            }

            if not aE then
                return
            end

            for bz, bA in pairs(bx)do
                local bB = aE[bz]

                if bB then
                    bB.Value = bA

                    pcall(function()
                        if bB.SetValue then
                            bB:SetValue(bA)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            for bz, bA in pairs(by)do
                local bB = aE[bz]

                if bB then
                    bB.Value = bA

                    pcall(function()
                        if bB.SetValue then
                            bB:SetValue(bA)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        function p.ResetAllToDefaults()
            _Reset_ApplyConfigDefaults()
            _Reset_DisableFeatures()
            _Reset_ApplyToggleDefaults()
            _Reset_ApplyOptionDefaults()
            pcall(function()
                az.new{
                    Title = 'candy.cc',
                    Content = 'All settings reset to defaults',
                    Duration = 4,
                }
            end)
        end
    end
end

__candyware_InitPlayerUI()

local aT, aU = false

local function SetCharacterTransparency(aV, aW)
    for aX, aY in ipairs(aV:GetDescendants())do
        if aY:IsA'BasePart' or aY:IsA'Decal' then
            if aY.Name ~= 'HumanoidRootPart' then
                aY.Transparency = aW
            end
        end
    end
end
local function EnableInvisibility()
    local aV = n and n.Character

    if not aV then
        return
    end

    local aW, aX = aV:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart', aV:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

    if not aW or not aX then
        return
    end

    SetCharacterTransparency(aV, 0.5)

    aU = d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if aT and aW and aX then
            local aY, aZ = aW.CFrame, aX.CameraOffset
            local a_ = aY * CFrame.new(0, -2E5, 0)

            aW.CFrame = a_
            aX.CameraOffset = (a_:ToObjectSpace(aY)).Position

            d.RenderStepped:Wait()

            aW.CFrame = aY
            aX.CameraOffset = aZ
        end
    end)
end
local function DisableInvisibility()
    if aU then
        aU:Disconnect()

        aU = nil
    end

    local aV = n and n.Character

    if aV then
        SetCharacterTransparency(aV, 0)

        local aW = aV:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'

        if aW then
            aW.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
    end
end

function p.ToggleInvisibility()
    aT = not aT
    getgenv().candyware_InvisActive = aT and true or false

    if aT then
        EnableInvisibility()
    else
        DisableInvisibility()
    end

    return aT
end

local function __candyware_InitButtonsTab()
    p.Config.MobileBtnCfg = p.Config.MobileBtnCfg or {}

        locked = false,
        sizeX = 80,
        sizeY = 80,
        transparency = 0.4,
        corner = 20,
        style = 'Glass',
        posSX = 0.5,
        posOX = 0,
        posSY = 0.5,
        posOY = 0,
    }

    local function getBtnCfg(aW)
        p.Config.MobileBtnCfg = p.Config.MobileBtnCfg or {}

        local aX = p.Config.MobileBtnCfg[aW]

        if type(aX) ~= 'table' then
            aX = {}
            p.Config.MobileBtnCfg[aW] = aX
        end

        for aY, aZ in pairs(aV)do
            if aX[aY] == nil then
                aX[aY] = aZ
            end
        end

        aX.sizeX = math.clamp(tonumber(aX.sizeX) or 80, 80, 400)
        aX.sizeY = math.clamp(tonumber(aX.sizeY) or 80, 36, 200)
        aX.transparency = math.clamp(tonumber(aX.transparency) or 0.08, 0, 0.9)
        aX.corner = math.clamp(tonumber(aX.corner) or 16, 0, 40)
        aX.style = 'Glass'
        aX.locked = aX.locked and true or false
        aX.posSX = tonumber(aX.posSX)

        if aX.posSX == nil then
            aX.posSX = 0.5

        aX.posOX = tonumber(aX.posOX)

        if aX.posOX == nil then
            aX.posOX = 0
        end

        aX.posSY = tonumber(aX.posSY)

        if aX.posSY == nil then
            aX.posSY = 0.5
        end

        aX.posOY = tonumber(aX.posOY)

        if aX.posOY == nil then
            aX.posOY = 0
        end

        return aX
    end

    local function ensureRootGui()

        a1.ResetOnSpawn = false

    local function cancelEntryTweens(a0)
        if not a0 or not a0.tweens then
            return
        end

        for a1, a2 in ipairs(a0.tweens)do
            pcall(function()
                if a2 then
                    a2:Cancel()
                end
            end)
        end

        a0.tweens = {}
    end
    local function trackTween(a0, a1)
        if not a0.tweens then
            a0.tweens = {}
        end

        table.insert(a0.tweens, a1)

        return a1
    end
    local function tween(a0, a1, a2, a3)
        if not a1 or not f then
            return nil
        end

        local a4 = f:Create(a1, a2, a3)

        trackTween(a0, a4)
        a4:Play()

        return a4
    end

    local a0, a1, a2, a3 = TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), TweenInfo.new(0.38, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

    local function destroyEntry(a4, a5)
        local a6 = aW[a4]

        if not a6 then
            return
        end
        if a6.shell then
            a6.savedPos = a6.shell.Position
        end

        cancelEntryTweens(a6)

        local function finish()
            if a6.glow then
                pcall(function()
                    a6.glow:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            if a6.shell then
                pcall(function()
                    a6.shell:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            if aW[a4] == a6 then
                aW[a4] = nil
            end

            local a7 = false

            for a8 in pairs(aW)do
                a7 = true

                break
            end

            if not a7 and aY then
                pcall(function()
                    aY:Destroy()
                end)

                aY = nil
            end
        end

        if a5 or not a6.shell or not a6.shell.Parent then
            finish()

            return
        end

        a6.hiding = true

        local a7 = getBtnCfg(a4)
        local a8, a9 = math.clamp(tonumber(a7.sizeX) or 80, 80, 400), math.clamp(tonumber(a7.sizeY) or 80, 36, 200)

        tween(a6, a6.shell, a3, {
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(8, a8 * 0.82), math.max(8, a9 * 0.82)),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        })

        if a6.btn then
            tween(a6, a6.btn, a3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.shellStroke then
            tween(a6, a6.shellStroke, a3, {Transparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.btnStroke then
            tween(a6, a6.btnStroke, a3, {Transparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.innerStroke then
            tween(a6, a6.innerStroke, a3, {Transparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.label then
            tween(a6, a6.label, a3, {TextTransparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.caption then
            tween(a6, a6.caption, a3, {TextTransparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.icon then
            tween(a6, a6.icon, a3, {ImageTransparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.accentBar then
            tween(a6, a6.accentBar, a3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.shadow then
            tween(a6, a6.shadow, a3, {ImageTransparency = 1})
        end
        if a6.glow then
            tween(a6, a6.glow, a3, {
                ImageTransparency = 1,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(a8 * 0.7, a9 * 0.7),
            })
        end

        task.delay(0.28, finish)
    end
    local function destroyAllMobileButtons()

            aZ = nil

        a_ = nil

        if aY then

            end)

            aY = nil
        end
    end
    local function applyEntryVisuals(a4)
        if not a4 or not a4.shell or not a4.btn then
            return

                return
            end

            local a6 = a5.entry

            if not a6 or not a6.shell then
                return
            end

            local a8 = UDim2.new(a5.origin.X.Scale, a5.origin.X.Offset + a7.X, a5.origin.Y.Scale, a5.origin.Y.Offset + a7.Y)

                a6.glow.Position = a8

            if a6.def then
                syncBtnCfgToFlags(a6.id, a6.def)
            end
        end))
    end

                cfgFromUdim(getBtnCfg(a4.id), a7.shell.Position)

        end
    end

        if not h then
            return ''
        end

        local a5, a6 = pcall(function()
            return h:JSONEncode(p.Config.MobileBtnCfg or {})
        end)

        return (a5 and a6) or ''
    end, function(a5)
        if type(a5) ~= 'string' or a5 == '' or not h then
            return
        end

        local a6, a7 = pcall(function()
            return h:JSONDecode(a5)
        end)

        if not a6 or type(a7) ~= 'table' then
            return
        end

        p.Config.MobileBtnCfg = p.Config.MobileBtnCfg or {}

        for a8, a9 in pairs(a7)do
            if type(a9) == 'table' then
                p.Config.MobileBtnCfg[a8] = p.Config.MobileBtnCfg[a8] or {}

                for ba, bb in pairs(a9)do
                    p.Config.MobileBtnCfg[a8][ba] = bb
                end

                applyLiveButtonPos(a8)
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if ay and ay.Flags and aE.MobileBtnCfgJson then
            ay.Flags.MobileBtnCfgJson = aE.MobileBtnCfgJson
        end
    end)

        loadAllBtnCfgFromJson()

        for a5, a6 in ipairs(aX)do
            loadBtnCfgFromFlags(a6.id, a6)
            applyLiveButtonPos(a6.id)
        end

        task.wait(1)
        loadAllBtnCfgFromJson()

        for a5, a6 in ipairs(aX)do
            loadBtnCfgFromFlags(a6.id, a6)
            applyLiveButtonPos(a6.id)

            local a7, a8, a9 = aD[a6.toggleFlag], p.Config[a6.flag], getBtnCfg(a6.id)

            if a9.enabled ~= nil then
                a8 = a9.enabled and true or false
            elseif a7 then
                local ba = a7.Value

                if a7.GetValue then
                    local bb, bc = pcall(function()
                        return a7:GetValue()
                    end)

                    if bb and bc ~= nil then
                        ba = bc
                    end
                end

                a8 = ba and true or false
            end

            p.Config[a6.flag] = a8

            if a8 then
                pcall(function()
                    toggleEntry(a6, true)
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

    local a0, a1, a2, a3 = 'Default', true, Color3.fromRGB(78, 127, 252), Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 13)
    local a4, a5, a6 = a2, a3, aZ.Default

    local function colorDistance(a7, a8)
        if typeof(a7) ~= 'Color3' or typeof(a8) ~= 'Color3' then
            return 1
        end

        local a9, ba, bb = a7.R - a8.R, a7.G - a8.G, a7.B - a8.B

        return math.sqrt(a9 * a9 + ba * ba + bb * bb)
    end
    local function stripInjectedThemeDecor(a7)
        if not a7 then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            for a8, a9 in ipairs(a7:GetDescendants())do
                if a9.Name == 'CandyThemeGradient' or a9.Name == 'CandyThemeStroke' then
                    pcall(function()
                        a9:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function mapThemeColor(a7, a8, a9)
        if typeof(a7) ~= 'Color3' or not a8 or not a9 then
            return nil
        end

        local ba = {
            {
                a8.Accent,
                a9.Accent,
            },
            {
                a8.AccentSoft or a8.Accent,
                a9.AccentSoft or a9.Accent,
            },
            {
                a8.Glow or a8.Accent,
                a9.Glow or a9.Accent,
            },
            {
                a8.Main,
                a9.Main,
            },
            {
                a8.Secondary or a8.Main,
                a9.Secondary or a9.Main,
            },
            {
                a8.Panel or a8.Secondary or a8.Main,
                a9.Panel or a9.Secondary or a9.Main,
            },
            {
                a8.Text,
                a9.Text,
            },
            {
                a8.TextDim or a8.Text,
                a9.TextDim or a9.Text,
            },
            {
                a8.Outline,
                a9.Outline,
            },
        }

        table.insert(ba, {
            Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 13),
            a9.Main,
        })
        table.insert(ba, {
            Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 14),
            a9.Main,
        })
        table.insert(ba, {
            Color3.fromRGB(10, 11, 14),
            a9.Main,
        })
        table.insert(ba, {
            Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16),
            a9.Main,
        })
        table.insert(ba, {
            Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22),
            a9.Secondary or a9.Main,
        })
        table.insert(ba, {
            Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 24),
            a9.Secondary or a9.Main,
        })
        table.insert(ba, {
            Color3.fromRGB(18, 14, 22),
            a9.Secondary or a9.Main,
        })
        table.insert(ba, {
            Color3.fromRGB(78, 127, 252),
            a9.Accent,
        })

        local bb, bc = 0.12

        for bd, be in ipairs(ba)do
            local bf, bg = be[1], be[2]

            if typeof(bf) == 'Color3' and typeof(bg) == 'Color3' then
                local bh = colorDistance(a7, bf)

                if bh < bb then
                    bb = bh
                    bc = bg
                end
            end
        end

        return bc
    end
    local function applyThemeToDescendants(a7, a8, a9)
        if not a7 then
            return
        end

        for ba, bb in ipairs(a7:GetDescendants())do
            if bb:IsA'Frame' or bb:IsA'TextButton' or bb:IsA'ImageButton' or bb:IsA'ScrollingFrame' then
                if bb.BackgroundTransparency < 0.98 then
                    local bc = mapThemeColor(bb.BackgroundColor3, a8, a9)

                    if bc then
                        bb.BackgroundColor3 = bc
                    end
                end
            end
            if bb:IsA'TextLabel' or bb:IsA'TextButton' or bb:IsA'TextBox' then
                local bc = mapThemeColor(bb.TextColor3, a8, a9)

                if bc then
                    bb.TextColor3 = bc
                end
            end
            if bb:IsA'UIStroke' then
                local bc = mapThemeColor(bb.Color, a8, a9)

                if bc then
                    bb.Color = bc
                end
            end
            if bb:IsA'ImageLabel' or bb:IsA'ImageButton' then
                local bc = mapThemeColor(bb.ImageColor3, a8, a9)

                if bc then
                    bb.ImageColor3 = bc
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function applyMenuTheme(a7)
        local a8 = aZ[a7]

        if not a8 then
            return
        end

        local a9 = {
            prev = a6 or aZ.Default or a8,
            accent = a8.Accent,
            main = a8.Main,
            text = a8.Text or Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250),
            gui = ay and ay.ScreenGui,
        }

        stripInjectedThemeDecor(a9.gui)

        ay.AccentColor = a9.accent
        ay.MainColor = a9.main

        pcall(function()
            ay.IconColor = a9.text
        end)

        if a9.gui then
            pcall(applyThemeToDescendants, a9.gui, a9.prev, a8)
        end

        a4 = a9.accent
        a5 = a9.main
        a6 = a8
        a0 = a7

        pcall(function()
            if p and p.RefreshMobileButtonsTheme then
                p.RefreshMobileButtonsTheme()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function disableMenuTheme()
        a1 = false

        local a7 = ay and ay.ScreenGui

        stripInjectedThemeDecor(a7)
        applyMenuTheme'Default'
    end
    local function __candyware_SetupMenuPanel()
        local a7, a8, a9, ba, bb, bc, bd, be, bf = true, true, true, true, 'Default'

            if p and p.Config then

                    p.Config.MenuClickSoundEnabled = true

                bj = p.Config.MenuClickSoundEnabled ~= false

                if not p.Config.MenuClickSound or not (getgenv().MenuClickSoundAssets and getgenv().MenuClickSoundAssets[tostring(p.Config.MenuClickSound)]) then
                    p.Config.MenuClickSound = '1'
                else

                bi = p.Config.MenuClickSound
            end

                    end
                end,

                            end
                        end)

                end,

        local bj, bk, bl, bm, bn, bo, bp = makeToggleProxy('WatermarkEnabled', true), false, true, false

        local function wmIcon(bq, br)
            local bs = p and p.Config

            if bs then
                local bt = bs[bq]

                if type(bt) == 'string' and bt ~= '' then
                    return bt
                end
            end

            return br
        end
        local function wmSetBlockIcon(bq, br)
            if not bq or type(br) ~= 'string' or br == '' then
                return false
            end

            local bs = false

            pcall(function()
                if type(bq.SetIcon) == 'function' then
                    bq:SetIcon(br)

                    bs = true
                end
            end)

            if not bs then
                pcall(function()
                    if bq.Icon ~= nil then
                        bq.Icon = br
                        bs = true
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not bs then
                pcall(function()
                    if type(bq.Set) == 'function' then
                        bq:Set(br)

                        bs = true
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not bs then
                pcall(function()
                    local bt = bq.Instance or bq.Gui or bq.Frame or bq.Root

                    if bt and typeof(bt) == 'Instance' then
                        for bu, bv in ipairs(bt:GetDescendants())do
                            if bv:IsA'ImageLabel' or bv:IsA'ImageButton' then
                                bv.Image = br
                                bs = true

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            return bs
        end
        local function wmEnsureBlocks()
            local bq = ensureWatermark()

            if not bq then
                return
            end
            if not bd then
                pcall(function()
                    bd = bq:AddBlock(wmIcon('WatermarkIconName', 'cube-vertexes'), 'candy.cc')

                    if bd and bd.Input then
                        bd:Input(function()
                            aH:ToggleInterface()
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not be then
                pcall(function()
                    be = bq:AddBlock(wmIcon('WatermarkIconPing', 'chart-four-vertical-bars'), '0MS')
                end)
            end
            if not bf then
                pcall(function()
                    bf = bq:AddBlock(wmIcon('WatermarkIconFps', 'lightning-bolt'), '0FPS')
                end)
            end
            if not bn then
                pcall(function()
                    bn = bq:AddBlock(wmIcon('WatermarkIconTime', 'clock'), '00:00:00')

                    if bn and bn.SetVisible then
                        bn:SetVisible(bk)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not bo then
                pcall(function()
                    bo = bq:AddBlock(wmIcon('WatermarkIconPlayers', 'two-people'), '0/0')

                    if bo and bo.SetVisible then
                        bo:SetVisible(bl)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not bp then
                pcall(function()
                    local br = (K and (K.DisplayName or K.Name)) or 'Player'

                    bp = bq:AddBlock(wmIcon('WatermarkIconUser', 'person'), br)

                    if bp and bp.SetVisible then
                        bp:SetVisible(bm)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        local function getAvatarThumb()
            if bv and bv ~= '' then
                return bv
            end

            local bw = K and K.UserId

            if not bw or bw <= 0 then
                return ''
            end

            local bx, by = pcall(function()
                return E:GetUserThumbnailAsync(bw, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
            end)

            if bx and type(by) == 'string' and by ~= '' then
                bv = by

                return by
            end

            local bz = string.format('rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%d&w=150&h=150', bw)

            bv = bz

            return bz
        end

                end)
            end)
        end
