            local function applyStylePreset(bD)
                local bE = bz[bD] or bz['Liquid Glass']

                bB = bD

                for bF, bG in pairs(bE)do
                    bC[bF] = bG
                end

                bC.width = bC.badgeWidth + bC.gapX + bC.labelWidth + bC.gapX + bC.toggleWidth
            end

            applyStylePreset'Liquid Glass'

            local bD, bE, bF, bG, bH, bI, bJ, bK = {
                onlyActive = false,
                showActions = true,
                excluded = {},
            }, {}, nil, nil, nil, false, {
                active = false,
                pos = Vector2.zero,
                target = Vector2.zero,
                offset = Vector2.zero,
            }, nil

            local function mk(bL, bM)
                local bN = Instance.new(bL)

                for bO, bP in pairs(bM)do
                    bN[bO] = bP
                end

                return bN
            end
            local function panel(bL, bM, bN, bO)
                local bP = mk('Frame', {
                    BackgroundColor3 = bM,
                    BackgroundTransparency = bO or 0.08,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = bL,
                })

                mk('UICorner', {
                    CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, bN or bC.radius),
                    Parent = bP,
                })
                mk('UIStroke', {
                    Color = bC.stroke,
                    Thickness = 1.2,
                    Transparency = bC.strokeTrans or 0.35,
                    Parent = bP,
                })

                if bC.glow then
                    local bQ = Instance.new'UIGradient'

                    bQ.Color = ColorSequence.new{
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(200, 210, 230)),
                    }
                    bQ.Transparency = NumberSequence.new{
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 0.05),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.25),
                    }
                    bQ.Rotation = 110
                    bQ.Parent = bP
                end

                return bP
            end
            local function isFeatureOn(bL)
                local bM = p and p.Config

                if not bM then
                    return false
                end
                if bL == 'AutoGrabGunKey' then
                    return bM.AutoGrabGun and true or false
                elseif bL == 'SpeedGlitchKey' then
                    return bM.SpeedGlitch and true or false
                elseif bL == 'CamLockKey' then
                    return bM.CamLockEnabled and true or false
                elseif bL == 'InvisKey' then
                    local bN = false

                    pcall(function()
                        if getgenv().candyware_InvisActive ~= nil then
                            bN = getgenv().candyware_InvisActive and true or false
                        end
                    end)

                    return bN
                end

                return false
            end
            local function resolveKey(bL)
                local bM = '\u{2014}'

                pcall(function()
                    if ay and ay.Flags and ay.Flags[bL] then
                        local bN = ay.Flags[bL]
                        local bO = bN.Value

                        if bN.GetValue then
                            local bP, bQ = pcall(function()
                                return bN:GetValue()
                            end)

                            if bP then
                                bO = bQ
                            end
                        end
                        if bO ~= nil and tostring(bO) ~= '' and tostring(bO) ~= 'nil' and tostring(bO) ~= 'None' then
                            bM = tostring(bO)

                            if p and p.Config then
                                p.Config[bL] = bM
                            end

                            return
                        end
                    end
                    if p and p.Config and p.Config[bL] then
                        bM = tostring(p.Config[bL])
                    end
                end)

                return bM
            end
            local function keyShort(bL)
                bL = tostring(bL or '\u{2014}'):upper()

                if bL == 'INSERT' then
                    return 'INS'
                end
                if bL == 'DELETE' then
                    return 'DEL'
                end
                if bL == 'LEFTCONTROL' or bL == 'LEFTCTRL' then
                    return 'LCTRL'
                end
                if bL == 'RIGHTCONTROL' or bL == 'RIGHTCTRL' then
                    return 'RCTRL'
                end
                if bL == 'LEFTSHIFT' then
                    return 'LSHFT'
                end
                if bL == 'RIGHTSHIFT' then
                    return 'RSHFT'
                end
                if bL == 'LEFTALT' then
                    return 'LALT'
                end
                if bL == 'RIGHTALT' then
                    return 'RALT'
                end
                if #bL > 5 then
                    return bL:sub(1, 5)
                end

                return bL
            end
            local function animateToggle(bL, bM)
                if not bL or not bL.track or not bL.knob then
                    return
                end

                local bN, bO, bP = bC.toggleWidth - 8, bC.toggleHeight - 4, 2
                local bQ, bR, bS = bM and (bN - bO - bP) or bP, bM and bC.trackOn or bC.trackOff, bM and bC.knobOn or bC.knobOff

                if f then
                    f:Create(bL.knob, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, bQ, 0.5, 0),
                        BackgroundColor3 = bS,
                    }):Play()
                    f:Create(bL.track, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundColor3 = bR}):Play()
                else
                    bL.knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, bQ, 0.5, 0)
                    bL.knob.BackgroundColor3 = bS
                    bL.track.BackgroundColor3 = bR
                end
            end
            local function fitPanelHeight()
                if not bG or not bH then
                    return
                end

                local bL = 0

                for bM, bN in ipairs(bE)do
                    if bN.row and bN.row.Visible then
                        bL = bL + 1
                    end
                end

                local bM = 0

                if bL > 0 then
                    bM = bL * bC.rowHeight + (bL - 1) * bC.gapY
                end

                local bN = bC.headerHeight + (bL > 0 and bC.gapY or 0) + bM

                bG.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bC.width, math.max(bC.headerHeight, bN))
                bH.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bC.width, bM)
            end
            local function refreshKeybindList()
                if not bH then
                    return
                end

                local bL = 0

                for bM, bN in ipairs(bE)do
                    local bO, bP = isFeatureOn(bN.flag), true

                    if bD.excluded and bD.excluded[bN.flag] then
                        bP = false
                    elseif bD.onlyActive then
                        if bN.isAction then
                            bP = false
                        else
                            bP = bO
                        end
                    elseif bN.isAction and not bD.showActions then
                        bP = false
                    end
                    if bN.row then
                        bN.row.Visible = bP

                        if bP then
                            bN.row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, bL)
                            bL = bL + bC.rowHeight + bC.gapY
                        end
                    end

                    local bQ = keyShort(resolveKey(bN.flag))

                    if bN.keyLabel and bN.keyLabel.Text ~= bQ then
                        bN.keyLabel.Text = bQ
                    end
                    if not bN.isAction then
                        animateToggle(bN, bO)
                    end
                end

                fitPanelHeight()
            end
            local function destroyKeybindUI()
                if bF then
                    pcall(function()
                        bF:Destroy()
                    end)
                end

                bF = nil
                bG = nil
                bH = nil
                bK = nil
                bE = {}
            end

            function buildKeybindListUI()
                destroyKeybindUI()

                local bL

                pcall(function()
                    bL = ay and ay.ScreenGui
                end)

                if not bL then
                    pcall(function()
                        bL = (n and n:FindFirstChild'PlayerGui') or game:GetService'Players'.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild'PlayerGui'
                    end)
                end
                if not bL then
                    return
                end

                local bM = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
                local bN, bO = bM.X - bC.width - 20, bM.Y * 0.5 - 120

                if bJ.pos.X > 0 and bJ.pos.Y > 0 then
                    bN = bJ.pos.X
                    bO = bJ.pos.Y
                end

                bJ.pos = Vector2.new(bN, bO)
                bJ.target = bJ.pos
                bF = mk('ScreenGui', {
                    Name = 'CandyWare_KeybindList',
                    ResetOnSpawn = false,
                    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
                    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
                    Parent = bL,
                    Enabled = true,
                })
                bG = mk('Frame', {
                    Name = 'Root',
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bN, bO),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bC.width, bC.headerHeight),
                    Parent = bF,
                    Visible = false,
                })

                if bC.glow then
                    mk('ImageLabel', {
                        Name = 'GlassGlow',
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Image = 'rbxassetid://5028857084',
                        ImageColor3 = bC.accent or Color3.fromRGB(140, 180, 255),
                        ImageTransparency = 0.88,
                        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
                        SliceCenter = Rect.new(24, 24, 276, 276),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 28, 1, 28),
                        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-14, -14),
                        ZIndex = 0,
                        Parent = bG,
                    })
                end

                local bP = panel(bG, bC.bg, bC.radius, bC.bgTrans)

                bP.Name = 'Header'
                bP.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bC.headerHeight)
                bP.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                bK = bP

                local bQ = mk('Frame', {
                    Name = 'AccentLine',
                    BackgroundColor3 = bC.accent or Color3.fromRGB(140, 180, 255),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 2),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 1, -3),
                    Parent = bP,
                })

                mk('UICorner', {
                    CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0),
                    Parent = bQ,
                })
                mk('TextLabel', {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Font = bC.fontBold,
                    Text = 'KEYBINDS',
                    TextColor3 = bC.text,
                    TextSize = 13,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                    Parent = bP,
                })

                bH = mk('Frame', {
                    Name = 'List',
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, bC.headerHeight + bC.gapY),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bC.width, 0),
                    Parent = bG,
                })
                bE = {}

                for bR, bS in ipairs(by)do
                    local bT = mk('Frame', {
                        Name = bS.flag,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bC.rowHeight),
                        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (bR - 1) * (bC.rowHeight + bC.gapY)),
                        Parent = bH,
                    })
                    local bU = panel(bT, bC.badge, bC.radius, bC.badgeTrans)

                    bU.Name = 'KeyBadge'
                    bU.Size = UDim2.new(0, bC.badgeWidth, 1, 0)
                    bU.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)

                    local bV, bW = mk('TextLabel', {
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Font = bC.fontBold,
                        Text = '\u{2014}',
                        TextColor3 = bC.text,
                        TextSize = 11,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                        Parent = bU,
                    }), panel(bT, bC.row, bC.radius, bC.rowTrans)

                    bW.Name = 'LabelBox'
                    bW.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bC.badgeWidth + bC.gapX, 0)
                    bW.Size = UDim2.new(0, bC.labelWidth, 1, 0)

                    local bX, bY = mk('TextLabel', {
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Font = bC.font,
                        Text = bS.name,
                        TextColor3 = bC.text,
                        TextSize = 12,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, 0),
                        Parent = bW,
                    }), panel(bT, bC.row, bC.radius, bC.rowTrans)

                    bY.Name = 'ToggleBox'
                    bY.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bC.badgeWidth + bC.gapX + bC.labelWidth + bC.gapX, 0)
                    bY.Size = UDim2.new(0, bC.toggleWidth, 1, 0)

                    local bZ = mk('Frame', {
                        Name = 'Track',
                        BackgroundColor3 = bC.trackOff,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bC.toggleWidth - 8, bC.toggleHeight),
                        Parent = bY,
                    })

                    mk('UICorner', {
                        CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0),
                        Parent = bZ,
                    })
                    mk('UIStroke', {
                        Color = bC.stroke,
                        Thickness = 1,
                        Transparency = (bC.strokeTrans or 0.35) + 0.1,
                        Parent = bZ,
                    })

                    local b_ = bC.toggleHeight - 4
                    local b0 = mk('Frame', {
                        Name = 'Knob',
                        BackgroundColor3 = bC.knobOff,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(b_, b_),
                        Parent = bZ,
                    })

                    mk('UICorner', {
                        CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0),
                        Parent = b0,
                    })

                    if bS.isAction then
                        bZ.BackgroundColor3 = bC.trackOff
                        b0.BackgroundColor3 = bC.knobOff
                    end

                    table.insert(bE, {
                        flag = bS.flag,
                        name = bS.name,
                        isAction = bS.isAction and true or false,
                        row = bT,
                        keyLabel = bV,
                        nameLabel = bX,
                        track = bZ,
                        knob = b0,
                    })
                end

                bP.InputBegan:Connect(function(bR)
                    if bR.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or bR.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        bJ.active = true

                        local bS, bT = e:GetMouseLocation(), 0

                        pcall(function()
                            bT = game:GetService'GuiService':GetGuiInset().Y
                        end)

                        local bU = Vector2.new(bS.X, bS.Y - bT)

                        bJ.offset = bU - bJ.pos
                        bJ.target = bJ.pos
                    end
                end)
                e.InputChanged:Connect(function(bR)
                    if not bJ.active then
                        return
                    end
                    if bR.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or bR.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        local bS, bT = e:GetMouseLocation(), 0

                        pcall(function()
                            bT = game:GetService'GuiService':GetGuiInset().Y
                        end)

                        local bU = Vector2.new(bS.X, bS.Y - bT)

                        bJ.target = bU - bJ.offset
                    end
                end)
                e.InputEnded:Connect(function(bR)
                    if bR.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or bR.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        bJ.active = false
                        bJ.target = bJ.pos
                    end
                end)
                TrackConnection(d.RenderStepped:Connect(function(bR)
                    if not bJ.active and (bJ.pos - bJ.target).Magnitude < 0.5 then
                        return
                    end

                    local bS = 1 - math.exp(-(bR or 0.016) / (bC.dragSmooth * 0.5))

                    bJ.pos = bJ.pos:Lerp(bJ.target, bS)

                    if bG then
                        bG.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bJ.pos.X, bJ.pos.Y)
                    end
                end))
                refreshKeybindList()
                fitPanelHeight()
            end

            local function setPanelVisible(bL)
                bI = bL and true or false

                if bI then
                    buildKeybindListUI()

                    if bG then
                        bG.Visible = true
                    end
                    if bF then
                        bF.Enabled = true
                    end

                    refreshKeybindList()
                else
                    if bG then
                        bG.Visible = false
                    end
                end
            end
            local function rebuildWithStyle(bL)
                applyStylePreset(bL)

                if p and p.Config then
                    p.Config.KeybindListStyle = bL
                end
                if bI then
                    destroyKeybindUI()
                    setPanelVisible(true)
                end
            end

            local bL, bM = makeToggleProxy('KeybindListToggle', false), bx:AddLabel'Show Keybinds'

            bM:AddToggle{
                Default = false,
                Flag = 'KeybindListToggle',
                Callback = function(bN)
                    bL.Value = bN and true or false

                    setPanelVisible(bN and true or false)
                end,
            }

            local bN, bO = bM:AddOption(), makeToggleProxy('KeybindListOnlyActive', false)

            bN:AddLabel'Only Active Binds':AddToggle{
                Default = false,
                Flag = 'KeybindListOnlyActive',
                Callback = function(bP)
                    bO.Value = bP and true or false
                    bD.onlyActive = bP and true or false

                    if p and p.Config then
                        p.Config.KeybindListOnlyActive = bD.onlyActive
                    end

                    refreshKeybindList()
                end,
            }

            local bP = makeToggleProxy('KeybindListShowActions', true)

            bN:AddLabel'Show Action Keys':AddToggle{
                Default = true,
                Flag = 'KeybindListShowActions',
                Callback = function(bQ)
                    bP.Value = bQ and true or false
                    bD.showActions = bQ and true or false

                    if p and p.Config then
                        p.Config.KeybindListShowActions = bD.showActions
                    end

                    refreshKeybindList()
                end,
            }

            local bQ = makeOptionProxy('KeybindListStyle', 'Liquid Glass')

            bN:AddLabel'List Style':AddDropdown{
                Default = 'Liquid Glass',
                Values = bA,
                Flag = 'KeybindListStyle',
                Callback = function(bR)
                    bQ.Value = bR

                    rebuildWithStyle(bR)
                    pcall(function()
                        if az and az.new then
                            az.new{
                                Title = 'candy.cc',
                                Content = 'Keybind style \u{b7} ' .. tostring(bR),
                                Duration = 2,
                            }
                        end
                    end)
                end,
            }

            local bR = bx:AddLabel'Hide Keybinds'
            local bS = bR:AddOption()

            for bT, bU in ipairs(by)do
                local bV = 'KeybindExclude_' .. bU.flag
                local bW = makeToggleProxy(bV, false)

                bS:AddLabel(bU.name):AddToggle{
                    Default = false,
                    Flag = bV,
                    Callback = function(bX)
                        bW.Value = bX and true or false
                        bD.excluded[bU.flag] = bX and true or false

                        if p and p.Config then
                            p.Config.KeybindListExcluded = p.Config.KeybindListExcluded or {}
                            p.Config.KeybindListExcluded[bU.flag] = bX and true or false
                        end

                        refreshKeybindList()
                    end,
                }
            end

            pcall(function()
                if p and p.Config then
                    if p.Config.KeybindListOnlyActive ~= nil then
                        bD.onlyActive = p.Config.KeybindListOnlyActive and true or false
                    end
                    if p.Config.KeybindListShowActions ~= nil then
                        bD.showActions = p.Config.KeybindListShowActions and true or false
                    end
                    if type(p.Config.KeybindListExcluded) == 'table' then
                        for bT, bU in pairs(p.Config.KeybindListExcluded)do
                            if bU then
                                bD.excluded[bT] = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if type(p.Config.KeybindListStyle) == 'string' and bz[p.Config.KeybindListStyle] then
                        applyStylePreset(p.Config.KeybindListStyle)
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while true do
                    task.wait(0.35)

                    if bI then
                        pcall(refreshKeybindList)
                    end
                end
            end)

            getgenv().candyware_RefreshKeybindList = refreshKeybindList
            getgenv().candyware_ToggleKeybindList = function(bT)
                local bU = bT

                if bU == nil then
                    bU = not bI
                end

                setPanelVisible(bU)
                pcall(function()
                    if aD and aD.KeybindListToggle then
                        aD.KeybindListToggle.Value = bU

                        if aD.KeybindListToggle.SetValue then
                            aD.KeybindListToggle:SetValue(bU)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        aY:AddLabel'Turn Off & Rejoin To Trade Again'
        aY:AddLabel'Decline Trades':AddToggle{
            Default = false,
            Flag = 'MiscDeclineTrades',
            Callback = function(bx)
                if getgenv()._CandyTradeMaid then
                    pcall(function()
                        for by, bz in ipairs(getgenv()._CandyTradeMaid)do
                            if type(bz) == 'function' then
                                bz()
                            end
                        end
                    end)

                    getgenv()._CandyTradeMaid = nil
                end
                if bx then
                    getgenv()._CandyTradeMaid = {}

                    local by = c:FindFirstChild'Trade'

                    if by then
                        local bz, bA = by:FindFirstChild'SendRequest', by:FindFirstChild'DeclineRequest'

                        if bz and bA then
                            bz.OnClientInvoke = function()
                                bA:FireServer()
                            end

                            table.insert(getgenv()._CandyTradeMaid, function()
                                bz.OnClientInvoke = nil
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end,
        }
    end

    __candyware_SetupMenuPanel()
    pcall(function()
        local a7 = false

        if p and p.Config and p.Config.MuteFeatureNotifications then
            a7 = true
        end
        if aD and aD.MuteFeatureNotifications and aD.MuteFeatureNotifications.Value then
            a7 = true
        end

        getgenv().candyware_MuteFeatureNotifications = a7
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        for a7 = 1, 25 do
            if ay and ay.ScreenGui then
                break
            end

            task.wait(0.08)
        end

        task.wait(0.35)
        pcall(function()
            if a1 then
                applyMenuTheme(a0 or 'Default')
            end
        end)
    end)
end

__candyware_InitMenuPanel()

do
    local aV = {
        'Noclip',
        'EnableWalkSpeed',
        'EnableJumpPower',
        'FlyEnabled',
        'EnableFOV',
        'InfiniteJump',
        'SpeedGlitch',
        'SpinEnabled',
        'AutoGrabGun',
        'AutoFarmCoins',
        'CandyFarmEnabled',
        'NotifyGunDropped',
        'HighlightMurderer',
        'InfoMurderer',
        'HighlightSheriff',
        'InfoSheriff',
        'HighlightInnocent',
        'InfoInnocent',
        'ESPGunDropped',
        'HealthBarEnabled',
        'GunBeamEnabled',
        'JumpCircleEnabled',
        'MotionGraphEnabled',
        'TargetHudEnabled',
        'SpaceParticlesEnabled',
    }

    for aW, aX in ipairs(aV)do
        p.Config[aX] = false
    end

    if getgenv().HitsoundData then
        getgenv().HitsoundData.enabled = false
    end

    local aW = {
        WatermarkEnabled = true,
        WatermarkShowName = true,
        WatermarkShowPing = true,
        WatermarkShowFps = true,
        WatermarkShowPlayers = true,
        MenuClickSoundEnabled = true,
        MenuThemeEnabled = true,
    }

    for aX, aY in pairs(aD)do
        if type(aY) == 'table' and not aW[aX] then
            aY.Value = false
        end
    end
end

getgenv().Toggles = aD
getgenv().Options = aE
_G.Toggles = aD
_G.Options = aE

task.spawn(function()
    for aV = 1, 8 do
        task.wait(0.25)
        pcall(function()
            if not __candyware_IsMobileDevice then
                return
            end
            if not __candyware_IsMobileDevice() then
                return
            end
            if not ay or not ay.Scales or not aH or not aH.SetSize then
                return
            end

            local aW = ay.Scales.Mobile or ay.Scales.Small

            if aW then
                aH:SetSize(aW)
            end

            pcall(function()
                if aH.SetRender then
                    aH:SetRender(true)
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(aH.Status) ~= 'nil' then
                    aH.Status = true
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local aV, aW = K and K.UserId, ''

    if aV and aV > 0 then
        local aX, aY = pcall(function()
            return E:GetUserThumbnailAsync(aV, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
        end)

        if aX and type(aY) == 'string' and aY ~= '' then
            aW = aY
        else
            aW = string.format('rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%d&w=150&h=150', aV)
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        aH:SetAccount{
            Username = K and (K.DisplayName or K.Name) or 'Player',
            Profile = aW,
            Expires = 'Free',
        }
    end)
end)
